prātarutthāya japtavyaṃ madhyāhne 'hnakṣaye 'pi vā / asaṃśayaṃ sadā japyo japatāṃ puṣṭiśāntidaḥ
oṃ hariṃ kuṣṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam / praṇato 'smi jagannāthaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
carācarasuruṃ nāthaṃ govindaṃ śeṣaśāyinam / praṇato 'smi paraṃ devaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
śaṅkhinaṃ cakriṇaṃ śārṅgadhāriṇaṃ sragdharaṃ param / praṇato 'smi patiṃ lakṣmyāḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
dāmodaramudārākṣaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣamacyutam / praṇato 'smi stutaṃ stutyaiḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ śauriṃ mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam / praṇato 'smi dharādhāraṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
keśavaṃ candrasūryākṣaṃ kaṃsakeśiniṣūdanam / praṇato 'smi mahābāhuṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ śrīśaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīniketanam / praṇato 'smi śriyaḥ kāntaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
yamīśaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhyāyanti yatayo 'kṣaram / vāsudevamanirdeśyaṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
samastālambanebhyo yaṃ vyāvṛttya manaso gatim / dhyāyanti vāsudevākhyaṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
sarvagaṃ sarvabhūtaṃ ca sarvasyādhāramīśvaram / vāsudevaṃ paraṃ brahma tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
paramātmānamavyaktaṃ yaṃ prayānti sumedhasaḥ / karmakṣaye 'kṣayaṃ devaṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
puṇyapāpavinirmuktā yaṃ praviśya punarbhavam / na yoginaḥ prāpnuvanti tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
brahma bhūtvā jagat sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam / yaḥ sṛjatyacyuto devastamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
brahmatve yasya vaktrebhyaścaturvedamayaṃ vapuḥ / prabhuḥ purātano jajñe tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
brahmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ jagadyoni janārdanam / sraṣṭṛtve saṃsthitaṃ sṛṣṭau praṇato 'smi sanātanam
sraṣṭā bhūtvā sthito yogī sthitāvasurasūdanaḥ / tamādipuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ pramato 'smi janārdanam
dhṛtā mahī hatā daityāḥ paritrātāstathā surāḥ / yena taṃ viṣṇumādyeśaṃ praṇato 'smi janārdanam
yajñairyajanti yaṃ viprā yajñeśaṃ yajñabhāvanam / taṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇato 'smi sanātanam
pātālavīthībhūtānu tathā lokān nihanti yaḥ / tamantapuruṣaṃ rudraṃ praṇato 'smi sanātanam
saṃbhakṣayitvā sakalaṃ yathāsṛṣṭamidaṃ jagat / yo vai nṛtyati rudrātmā praṇato 'smi janārdanam
surāsurāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ / saṃbhūtā yasya devasya sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmyaham
samastadevāḥ sakalā manuṣyāṇāṃ ca jātayaḥ / yasyāṃśabhūtā devasya sarvagaṃ taṃ nato 'smayaham
vṛkṣagulmādayo yasya tathā paśumṛgādayaḥ / ekāṃśabhūtā devasya sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmyaham
yasmānnānyat paraṃ kiñcid yasmin sarvaṃ mahātmani / yaḥ sarvamadhyago 'nantaḥ sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmyaham
yathā sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍho 'gniriva dāruṣu / viṣṇurevaṃ tathā pāpaṃ mamāśeṣaṃ praṇaśyatu
yathā viṣṇumayaṃ sarvaṃ brahmadi sacarācaram / yacca jñānaparicchedyaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatu me tathā
śubhaśubhāni karmāṇi rajaḥsattvatamāṃsi ca / anekajanmakarmotthaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatu me tathā
yanniśāyāṃ ca yatprātaryanmadhyāhnāparāhṇayoḥ / saṃdhyayośca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā manasā girā
yat tiṣṭhatā yad vrajatā yacca śayyāgatena me / kṛtaṃ yadaśubhaṃ karma kāyena manasā girā
ajñānato jñānato vā madāccalitamānasaiḥ / tat kṣipraṃ vilayaṃ yātu vāsudevasya kīrtanāt
paradāraparadravyavāñchādrohodbhavaṃ ca yat / parapīḍodbhavāṃ nindāṃ kurvatā yanmahātmanām
yacca bhojye tathā peye bhakṣye coṣye vilehane / tad yātu vilayaṃ toye yathā lavaṇabhājanam
yad bālye yacca kaumāre yat pāpaṃ yauvane mama / vayaḥpariṇatau yacca yacca janmātare kṛtam
tannārāyaṇa govinda harikṛṣṇeśa kīrtanāt / prayātu vilayaṃ toye yathā lavaṇabhājanam
viṣṇave vāsudevāya haraye keśavāya ca / janārdanāya kṛṣṇāya namo bhūyo namo namaḥ
bhaviṣyannarakaghnāya namaḥ kaṃsavighātine / ariṣṭakeśicaṇūradevārikṣayiṇe namaḥ
ko 'nyo balervañcayitā tvāmṛte vai bhaviṣyati / ko 'nyo nāśayati balād darpaṃ haihayabhūpateḥ
kaḥ kariṣyatyathānyo vai sāgare setubandhanam / vadhiṣyati daśagrīvaṃ kaḥ sāmātyapuraḥsaram
kastvāmṛte 'nyo nandasya gokule ratimeṣyati / pralambapūtanādīnāṃ tvāmṛte madhusūdana / nihantāpyathabā śāstā devadeva bhaviṣyati
japannevaṃ naraḥ puṇyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dharmamuttamam / iṣṭāniṣṭaprasaṃgebhyo jñānato 'jñānato 'pi vā
kṛtaṃ tena tu yat pāpaṃ saptajanmāntarāṇi vai / mahāpātakasaṃjñaṃ vā tathā caivopapātakam
jajñādīni ca puṇyāni japahomavratāni ca / nāśayed yogināṃ sarvamāmapātramivāmbhasi
naraḥ saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ tilapātrāṇi ṣoḍaśa / ahanyahani yo dadyāt paṭhatyetacca tatsamam
aviluptabrahmacaryaṃ saṃprāpya smaraṇaṃ hareḥ / viṣṇulokamavāpnoti satyametanmayoditam
yathaitat stayamuktaṃ me na hyalpamapi me mṛṣā / rākṣasastrastasarvāṅgaṃ tathā māmeṣa muñcatu
pulastya uvāca / evamuccārite tena mukto viprastu rakṣasā / akāmena dvijo bhūyastamāha rajanīcaram
brahmaṇa uvāca / etad bhadra mayā khyātaṃ tava pātakanāśanam / viṣṇoḥ sārasvataṃ stotraṃ yajjagāda sarasvatī
hutāśanena prahitā mama jihvāgrasaṃsthitā / jagādainaṃ stavaṃ viṣṇoḥ sarveṣāṃ copaśāntidam
anenaiva jagannāthaṃ tvamārādhaya kesavam / tataḥ śāpāpanodaṃ tu stute lapsyasi keśave
aharniśaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ stavenānena rākṣasa / stuhi bhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā tataḥ pāpād vimokṣyase
stuto hi sarvapāpāni nāśayiṣyatyasaṃśayam / stuto hi bhaktyā nṝṇāṃ vai sarvapāpaharo hariḥ
pulastya uvāca / tataḥ praṇamya taṃ vipraṃ prasādya sa niśācaraḥ / tadaiva tapase śrīmān śālagrāmamagād vaśī
aharniśaṃ sa evainaṃ japan sārasvataṃ stavam / devakriyāratirbhūtvā tapastepe niśācaraḥ
samārādhya jagannāthaṃ sa tatra puraṣottamam / sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokamavāptavān
etat te kathitaṃ brahman viṣṇoḥ sārasvataṃ stavam / vipravaktrasthayā samyaksarasvatyā samīritam
ya etat paramaṃ stotraṃ vāsudevasya mānavaḥ / paṭhaṣyati sa sarvebhyaḥ pāpebhyo mokṣamāpsyati

iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe ekonaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ________________________________________________________________________ pulastya uvāca / namaste 'stu jagannātha devadevaṃ namo 'stu te / vāsudeva namaste 'stu bahurūpa namo 'stu te
ekaśṛṅga namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ vṛṣākape / śrīnivāsa namaste 'stu namaste bhūtabhāvana
viṣvaksena namastubhyaṃ nārāyaṇa namo 'stu te / dhruvadhvaja namasto 'stu satyadhvaja namo 'stu te
yajñadhvaja namastubhyaṃ dharmadhvaja namo 'stu te / tāladhvaja namaste 'stu namaste garuhadhvaja
vareṇya viṣṇo vaikuṇṭha namaste puruṣottama / namo jayanta vijaya jayānanta parājita
kṛtāvartada mahāvarta mahādeva namo 'stu te / anādyādyanta madhyānta namaste padmajapriya
purañjaya namastubhyaṃ śatruñjaya namo 'stu te / śubhañjaya namaste 'stu namaste 'stu dhanañjaya
sṛṣṭigarbha namastubhyaṃ śuciśravaḥ vṛthuśravaḥ / namo hiraṇyagarbhāya padmagarbhāya te namaḥ
namaḥ kamalanetrāya kālanetrāya te namaḥ / kālanābha namastubhyaṃ mahānābha namo namaḥ
vṛṣṭimūla mahāmūla mūlāvāsa namo 'stu te / dharmāvāsa jalāvāsa śrīnivāsa namo 'stu te
dharmādhyakṣa prajādhyakṣa lokādhyakṣa namo namaḥ / senādhyakṣa namastubhyaṃ kālādhyakṣa namo namaḥ
gadādhara śrutidhara cakradhārin śriyo dhara / vanamālādhara hare namaste dharaṇīdhara
ārciṣeṇa mahāsena namaste 'stu puruṣṭuta / vahukalpa mahākalpa namaste kalpanāmukha
sarvātman sarvaga vibho viriñce śveta keśava / nīla rakta mahānīla aniruddha namo 'stu te
dvādaśātmaka kālātman sāmātman paramātmaka / vyomakātmaka subrahman bhūtātmaka namo 'stu te
harikeśa mahākeśa guḍākeśa namo 'stu te / muñjakeśa hṛṣīkeśa sarvanātha mano 'stu te
sukṣma sthūla mahāsthūla mahāsūkṣma śubhaṅkara / śvetapītāmbaradhara nīlavāsa namo 'stu te
kuśeśaya namaste 'stu sīradhvaja najārdhana / govinda prītikartā ca haṃsa pītāmbarapriya
adhokṣaja namastubhyaṃ sīradhvaja janārdana / vāmanāya namaste 'stu namaste madhusūdana
sahasraśīrṣāya namo brahmaśīrṣāya te namaḥ / namaḥ sahasranetrāya somasūryānalekṣama /
namaścātharvaśirase mahāśīrṣāya te namaḥ / namaste dharmanetrāya mahānetrāya te namaḥ
namaḥ sahasrapādāya sahasrabhujamanyave / namo yajñavarāhāya mahārūpāya te namaḥ
namaste viśvadevāya viśvātman viśvasaṃbhava / viśvarūpa namaste 'stu tvatto viśvamabhūdidam
nyagrodhastavaṃ mahāśākhastvaṃ mūlakusumārcitaḥ / skandhapatrāṅkuralatāpallavāya namo 'stu te
mūlaṃ te brāhmaṇā brahman skandhaste kṣatriyordiśaḥ / nābhyā hyabhūdantarikṣaṃ śaśāṅko manasastava
brāhmaṇāḥ sāgnayo vaktrāḥ derdaṇḍāḥ sāyudhā nṛpāḥ / pārśvād viśaśceruyugājjātāḥ śūdrāśca pādataḥ
netrād bhānurabhūt tubhyaṃ padbhyāṃ bhūḥ śrotrayordiśaḥ / nābhyā hyabhūdantarikṣaṃ śaśāṅko manasastava
prāṇād vāyuḥ samabhavat kāmād brahmā pitāmahaḥ / krodhāt trinayano rudraḥ śīrṣṇoḥ dyauḥ samavartata
indrāgnī vadanāt tubhyaṃ paśavo malasaṃbhavāḥ / oṣadhyo romasaṃbhūtā virājastvaṃ namo 'stu te
puṣpahāsa namaste 'stu mahāhāsa namo 'stu te / oṅkārastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāro vauṣaṭ tvaṃ ca svadhā sudhā
svāhākāra namastubhyaṃ hantakāra namo 'stu te / sarvākāra nirākāra vedākāra namo 'stu te
tvaṃ hi vedamayo devaḥ sarvadevamayastathā / sarvatīrthamayaścaiva sarvayajñamayastathā
namaste yajñapuruṣa yajñabhāgabhuje namaḥ / namaḥ sahasradhārāya śatadhārāya te namaḥ
bhīrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvarūpāya godāyāmṛtadāyine / suvarṇabrahmadātre ca sarvadātre ca te namaḥ
brahmeśāya namastubhyaṃ brahmāde brahmarūpadhṛk / parabrahma namaste 'stu śabdabrahma namo 'stu te
vidyāstvaṃ vedyarūpastvaṃ vedanīyastvameva ca / buddhistvamapi bodhyaśca bodhastvaṃ ca namo 'stu te
hotā homaśca havyaṃ ca hūyamānaścahavyāvāṭ / pātā potā ca putaśca pāvanīyaśca oṃ namaḥ
hantā ca hanyamānaś ca hrimāṇastvameva ca / harttā netā ca nītiśca pūjyo 'gryo viśvadhāryasi
sruksruvau paradhāmāsi kapālolūkhalo 'raṇiḥ / yajñapātrāṇeyastvamekadhā bahudhā tridhā
yajñastvaṃ yajamānastvamīḍyastvamasi yājakaḥ / jñātā jñeyastathā jñānaṃ dhyeyo dhyātāsi ceśvara
dhyānayogaśca yogī ca gatirmokṣo dhṛtiḥ sukham / yogāṅgāni tvamīśānaḥ sarvagastvaṃ namo 'stu te
brahma hotā tathodgātā sāma yūpo 'ta dakṣiṇā / dīkṣā tvaṃ tvaṃ puroḍāśastvaṃ paśuḥ paśuvāhyasi
guhyo dhātā ca paramaḥ śivo nārāyaṇastathā / mahājano nirayanaḥ sahasrārkendurūpavān
dvādaśāro 'tha ṣaṇṇābhistrivyūho dviyugastathā / kālacakro bhavānīśo namaste puruṣottamaḥ
parākramo vikramastvaṃ hayagrīvo harīśvaraḥ / nareśvaro 'tha brahmeśaḥ sūryeśastvaṃ namo 'stu te
aśvavaktro mahāmedhāḥ śaṃbhuḥ śakraḥ prabhañjanaḥ / mitrāvaruṇamūrtistvamamūrtiranaghaḥ paraḥ
prāgvaṃśakāyo bhūtādirmahābhūto 'cyuto dvijaḥ / tvamūrdhvakarttā ūrdhvaś ca ūrdhvaretā namo 'stu te
mahāpātakahā tvaṃ ca upapātakahā tathā / anīśaḥ sarvapāpebhyastvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
ityetat paramaṃ stotraṃ sarvapāpapramocanam / maheśvareṇa kathitaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ purā mune
keśavasyāgrato gatvā snātvā tīrthe sitodake / upaśāntastathā jāto rudraḥ pāpavaśāt tataḥ
etat pavitraṃ tripuradhnabhāṣitaṃ paṭhan naro viṣṇuparo maharṣe / vimuktapāpo hyupaśāntamūrti saṃpūjyate devavaraiḥ prasiddhaiḥ

iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe ṣaṣṭhitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ________________________________________________________________________ pulastya uvāca / dvitīyaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ stavaṃ vakṣyāmi te mune / yena samyagadhītena pāpaṃ nāśaṃ tu gaccati
matsyaṃ namasye deveśaṃ kūrmaṃ govindameva ca / hayaśīrṣaṃ namaste 'haṃ bhavaṃ viṣṇuṃ trivikramam
namasye mādhaveśānau hṛṣīkaśakumāriṇau / nārāyaṇaṃ namasye 'haṃ namasye garuḍāsanam
ūrdhvakeśaṃ nṛsihaṃ ca rupadhāraṃ kurudhvajam / kāmapālamakhaṇḍaṃ ca namasye brāhmaṇapriyam
ajitaṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ dvijapriyam / haṃsaṃ śaṃbhuṃ namasye ca brahmāṇaṃ saprajāpatim
namasye śūlabāhuṃ ca devaṃ cakradharaṃ tathā / śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ suvarṇākṣaṃ gopatiṃ pītavāsasam
namasye ca gadāpāṇiṃ namasye ca kuśośayam / ardhanārīśvaraṃ devaṃ namasye pāpanāśanam
gopālaṃ ca saivakuṇṭhaṃ namasye cāparājitam / namasye viśvarūpaṃ ca saugandhiṃ sarvadāśivam
pāñcālikaṃ hayagrīvaṃ svayambhuvamamareśvaram / namasye puṣkarākṣaṃ ca payogandhiṃ ca keśavam
avimuktaṃ ca lolaṃ ca jyeṣṭheyaṃ madhyamaṃ tathā / upaśāntaṃ tamasye 'haṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ sajambukam
namasye padmakiraṇaṃ namasye vaḍavāmukham / kārttikeyaṃ namasye 'haṃ bāhlīkaṃ śikhinaṃ tathā
namasye sthāṇumanaghaṃ namasye vanamālinam / namasye lāṅgalīśaṃ ca namasye 'haṃ śriyaḥ patim
namasye ca trinayanaṃ namasye havyavāhanam / namasye ca trisauvarṇaṃ namasye śaśibhūṣaṇam
triṇāciketaṃ brahmeśaṃ namasye śaśibhūṣaṇam / kapardinaṃ namasye ca sarvāmayavināśanam
namasye śaśinaṃ sūryaṃ dhruvaṃ raudraṃ mahaujasam / padmanābhaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ namasye skandamavyayam
namasye bhīmahaṃsau ca namasye hāṭakeśvaram / sadā haṃsaṃ namasye ca namasye prāmatarpaṇam
namasye rukmakavacaṃ mahāyoginamīśvaram / namasye śrīnivāsaṃ ca namasye puruṣottamam
namasye ca caturbāhuṃ namasye vasudhādhipam / vanaspatiṃ paśupatiṃ namasye prabhumavyayām
śrīkaṇṭhaṃ vāsudevaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sadaṇḍinam / namasye sarvamanaghaṃ gaurīśaṃ nakulīsvaram
manoharaṃ kṛṣṇakeśaṃ namasye cakrapāṇinam / yaśodharaṃ mahābāhuṃ namasye ca kuśapriyam
bhūdharaṃ chāditagadaṃ sunetraṃ śūlaśaṅkhinam / bhadrākṣaṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca namasye śaṅkukarṇikam
vaṣadhvajaṃ maheśaṃ ca viśvāmitraṃ śaśiprabham / upendra caiva govindaṃ namaste paṅkajapriyam
sahasraśirsaṃ devaṃ namasye kundamālinam / kālāgniṃ rudradeveśaṃ namasye kṛttivāsasam
namasye chāgaleśaṃ ca namasye paṅkajāsanam / sahasrākṣaṃ kokanadaṃ namasye hariśaṅkaram
agastayaṃ garuḍaṃ viṣṇuṃ kapilaṃ brahmavāṅmayam / sanātanaṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ namasye brahmatatparam
apratarkyaṃ caturbāhuṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ tapomayam / namasye dharmarājānaṃ devaṃ garuḍavāhanam
sarvabūtagataṃ śāntaṃ nirmalaṃ sarvalakṣaṇam / mahāyoginamavyaktaṃ namasye pāpanāśanam
nirañjanaṃ nirākāraṃ nirguṇaṃ nirmalaṃ padam / namasye pāpahantāraṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje
etat pavitraṃ paramaṃ purāṇaṃ proktaṃ tvagastayena maharṣiṇā ca / dhnyaṃ yaśasyaṃ bahupāpanāśanaṃ saṃkartanāt smāraṇāt saṃśravācca

iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe ekaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ________________________________________________________________________ pulastya uvāca / gate 'tha tīrthayātrāyāṃ prahlāde dānaveśvare / kurukṣetraṃ samabhyāgād yaṣṭuṃ vairocano valiḥ
tasmin mahādharmayute tīrthe brāhmaṇapuṅgavaḥ / śukro dvijātipravarānāmantrayat bhārgavān
bhṛgūnāmantryamāṇān vai śrutvātreyāḥ sagautamāḥ / kauśikāṅgirasaścaiva tatyajuḥ kurujāṅgalān
uttarāśāṃ prajagmuste nadīmanu śatadrukām / śātadrave jale snātvā vipāśāṃ prayayustataḥ
vijñāya tatrāpyaratiṃ snātvār'cya pitṛdevatāḥ / prajagmuḥ kiraṇāṃ puṇyāṃ dineśakiraṇacyutām
tasyāṃ snātvār'cya deverṣe sarva eva maharṣayaḥ / airāvatīṃ supuṇyodāṃ snātvā jagmuratheśvarīm
devikāyā jale snātvā payoṣṇyāṃ caiva tāpasāḥ / avatīrṇā mune snātumātreyādyāḥ śubhāṃ nadīm
tato nimagnā dadṛśuḥ pratibimbamathātmanaḥ / antarjale dvijaśreṣṭha mahadāścaryakārakam
unmajjane ca dadṛśuḥ punarvismitamānasāḥ / tataḥ snātvā samuttīrṇā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva hi
jagamustato 'pi te brahman kathayantaḥ parasparam / cintayantaśca satataṃ kimetaditi vismitāḥ
tato dūrādapaśyanta vanaṣaṇḍaṃ suvistṛtam / vanaṃ haragalaśyāmaṃ khagadhvaninināditam
atituṅgatayā vayoma āvṛṇvānaṃ nagottamam / vistṛtābhirjaṭābhistu antarbhūmiñca nārada
kānanaṃ puṣpitairvṛkṣairatibhāti samantataḥ / daśārddhavarṇaiḥ sukhadairnabhastārāgaṇairiva
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kamalairvyāptaṃ puṇḍarīkaiśca śobhitam / tadvat kokanadairvyāptaṃ vanaṃ padmavanaṃ yathā
prajagmustuṣṭimatulāṃ te hlādaṃ paramaṃ yayaḥ / viviśuḥ prītamanaso haṃsā iva mahāsaraḥ
tanmadhye dadṛśuḥ puṇyamāśramaṃ lokapūjitam / caturṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ vargāṇāṃ munisattama / / 62.16 dharmāśramaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ tu palāśaviṭapāvṛtam / pratīcyabhimukhaṃ brahman arthasyekṣuvanāvṛtam
dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ kāmyaṃ rambhāśokavanāvṛtam / udaṅmukhaṃ ca mokṣasya śuddhasphaṭikavarcasam
kṛtānte tvāśramī mokṣaḥ kāmastretāntare śramī / āśramyartho dvāparānte tiṣyādau dharma āśramī
tānyāśramāṇi munayo dṛṣṭvātreyādayo 'vyayāḥ / tatraiva ca ratiṃ cakrurakhaṇḍe salilāplute
dharmādyairbhagavān viṣṇurakhaṇḍa viśrutaḥ / caturmurtirjagannāthaḥ purvameva pratiṣṭhitaḥ
tamarcayanti ṛṣayo yogātmāno bahuśrutāḥ / śuśrūṣayātha tapasā brahmacaryeṇa nārada
evaṃ te nyavasaṃstatra sametā munayo vane / asurebhyastadā bhītāḥ svāśrityākhaṇḍaparvatam
tathānye brāhmaṇā brahman aśmakuṭṭā marīcipāḥ / snātvā jale hi kālindyāḥ prajagmurdakṣiṇāmukhāḥ
avantiviṣayaṃ prāpya viṣṇumāsādya saṃsthitāḥ / viṣṇorapi prasādena duṣpraveśaṃ mahāsuraiḥ
bālakhilyādayo jagmuravaśā dānavād bhayāt / rudrakoṭiṃ samāśritya sthitāste brahmacāriṇaḥ
evaṃ gateṣu vipreṣu gautamāṅgirasādiṣu / śukrastu bhārgavān sarvān ninye yajñavidhau mune
adhiṣṭhite bhārgavaistu mahāyajñe 'mitadyute / yajñadīkṣāṃ baleḥ śukraścākāra vidhinā svayam
śvetāmbaradharo daityaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ / mṛgājināvṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhe barhipatravicitritaḥ
samāste vitate yajñe sadasyairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ / hayagrīvapralambādyairmayabāṇapurogamaiḥ
patnī vindhyāvalī cāsya dīkṣitā yajñakarmaṇi / lalanānāṃ sahasrasya pradhānā ṛṣikanyakā
śukreṇāśvaḥ śvetavarṇo madhumāse sulakṇaḥ / mahīṃ vihartumutsṛṣṭastārakākṣo 'nvagācca tam
evamaśve samutsṛṣṭe vitate yajñakarmaṇi / gate ca māsatritaye hūyamāne ca pāvake
pūjyamāneṣu daityeṣu miṣunasthe divākare / suṣuve devajananī mādhavaṃ vāmanākṛtim
taṃ jātamātraṃ bhagavantamīśaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ lokapatiṃ purāṇam / brahmā samabhyetya samaṃ maharṣibhiḥ stotraṃ jagādātha vibhormaharṣe
namo 'stu te mādhava sattvamūrtte namo 'stu te śāśvata viśvarūpa / namo 'stu te śatruvanendhanāgne namo 'stu vai pāpamahādavāgne
namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana / namaste jagādādhāra namaste puruṣottama
nārāyaṇa jaganmūrte jagannātha gadādhara / pītavāsaḥ śriyaḥkānta janārdana namo 'stu te
bhavāṃstrātā ca goptā ca viśvātmā sarvago 'vyayaḥ / sarvadhārī dharādhārī rūpadhārī namo 'stu te
vardhasva vardhitāśeṣatrailokya surapūjita / kuruṣva daivatapate maghono 'śrupramārjanam
tvaṃ dhātā ca vidhātā ca saṃhartā tvaṃ maheśvaraḥ / mahālaya mahāyogin yogaśāyin namo 'stu te / / 62.41 itthaṃ stuto jagannāthaṃ sarvātmā sarvago hariḥ / provāca bhagavān mahyaṃ kurūpanayanaṃ vibho
tataścakāra devasya jātakarmādikāḥ kriyāḥ / bharadvājo mahātejā bārhaspatyastapodhanaḥ
vratabandhaṃ tatheśasta kṛtavān sarvasāstravit / tato daduḥ prītiyutāḥ sarva eva varān kramāt
yajñopavītaṃ pulahastvahaṃ ca sitavāsasī / mṛgājinaṃ kumbhayonirbharadvājastu mekhalām
pālāśamadadad daṇḍaṃ marīcirbrahmaṇāḥ sutaḥ / akṣasūtraṃ vāruṇistu kauśyaṃ vedamathāṅgirāḥ
chatraṃ prādād raghū rājā upānadyugalaṃ nṛgaḥ / kamṇḍaluṃ bṛhattejāḥ prādādviṣṇorbṛhaspatiḥ
evaṃ kṛtopanayano bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ / saṃstūyamāno ṛṣibhiḥ sāṅgaṃ vedamadhīyata
bharadvājādāṅgirasāt sāmavedaṃ mahādhvanim / mahadākhyānasaṃyuktaṃ gandharvasahitaṃ mune
māsenaikena bagavān jñānaśrutimahārṇavaḥ / lokacārapravṛttyarthamabhūcchrutiviśāradaḥ
sarvaśāstreṣu naipuṇyaṃ gatvā devo 'kṣayo 'vyayaḥ / provāca brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ bharadvājamidaṃ vacaḥ
śrīvāmana uvāca / brahman vrajāmi dehyājñāṃ kurukṣetraṃ mahodayam / tatra daityapateḥ puṇyo hayamedhaḥ pravartate
samāviṣṭāni paśyasva tejāṃsi pṛthivītale / ye saṃnidhānāḥ satataṃ madaṃśāḥ puṇyavardhanāḥ / tenāhaṃ pratijānāmi kurukṣetraṃ gato baliḥ
bharadvāja uvāca / svecchayā tiṣṭha vā gaccha nāhamājñāpayāmi te / gamiṣyāmo vayaṃ viṣṇo baleradhvaraṃ mā khida
yad bhavantamahaṃ deva paripṛcchāmi tad vada / keṣu keṣu vibho nityaṃ sthāneṣu puruṣottama / sānnidhyaṃ bhavato brūhi jñātumicchāmi tattvataḥ
vāmana uvāca / śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi yeṣu yeṣu guro aham / nivāsāmi supuṇyeṣu sthāneṣu bahurūpavān
mamāvatārairvasudhā nabhastalaṃ pātālamambhonidhayo divañca / diśaḥ samastā girayo 'mbudāśca vyāptā bharadvāja mamānurūpaiḥ

ye divyā ye ca bhaumā jalagaganacarāḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāśca sendrāḥ sārkāḥ sacandrā yamavasuvaruṇā hyagnayaḥ sarvapālāḥ / brahmādyāḥ sthāvarāntā dvijakhagamahitā mūrtimanto hyamūrtāḥ te sarve matprasūtā bahu vividhaguṇāḥ pūraṇārthaṃ pṛthivyāḥ
ete hi mukhyāḥ surasiddhadānavaiḥ pujyāstathā saṃnihitā mahītale / yairdṛṣṭamātraiḥ sahasaiva nāśaṃ prayāti pāpaṃ dvijavarya kīrtanaiḥ

iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe dviṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ________________________________________________________________________ śrībhagavānuvāca / ādyaṃ mātsyaṃ mahadrupaṃ saṃsthitaṃ mānase hrade / sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ kīrtanasparśanādibhiḥ
kaurmamanyatsannidhānaṃ kośikyāṃ pāpanāśanam / hayaśīrṣaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśe govindaṃ hastināpure
tatrivikramaṃ ca kālindyāṃ liṅgabhede bhavaṃ vibhum / kedāre mādhavaṃ śauriṃ kubjāmre hṛṣṭamūrdhajam
nārāyaṇaṃ badarthāṃ ca vārāhe garuḍāsanam / jayeśaṃ bhadrakarṇe ca vipāśāyāṃ dvijapriyam
rūpadhāramirāvatyāṃ kurukṣetre kurudhvajam / kṛtaśauce nṛsiṃhaṃ ca gokarṇe viśvakarmiṇam
prācīne kāmapālaṃ ca puṇḍarīkaṃ mahāmbhasi / viśākhayūpe hyajitaṃ haṃsaṃ haṃsapade tathā
payoṣṇāyāmakhaṇḍaṃ ca vitastāyāṃ kumārilam / maṇimatparvate śaṃbhuṃ brahmaṇye ca prajāpatim
madhunadyāṃ cakradharaṃ śūlabāhuṃ himālaye / viddhi viṣṇuṃ muniśreṣṭa sthitamoṣadhisānuni
bhṛ-gutuṅge suvarṇāśraṃ naimiṣe pītavāsasam / gayāyāṃ gopatiṃ devaṃ gadāpāṇinamīśvaram
trailokyanāthaṃ varadaṃ gopratāre kuśeśayam / arddhanārīśvaraṃ puṇye māhendre dabhiṇe girau
gopālamuttare nityaṃ mahendre somapīthinam / vaikuṇṭhamapi sahyādrau pāriyātra'parājitam
kaśerudeśe deveśaṃ viśvarūpaṃ tapodhanam / malayādrau ca saugandhiṃ vindhyapāde sadāśivam
avanativiṣaye viṣṇuṃ niṣadheṣvamareśvaram / pāñcālikaṃ ca brahmarṣe pāñcāleṣu vyavasthitam
mahodaye hayagrīvaṃ prayāge yogaśāyinam / svayaṃbhuvaṃ madhuvate ayogandhiṃ ca puṣkare
tathaiva viprapravara vārāṇasyāṃ ca keśavam / avimuktakamatraiva lolaścātraiva gīyate
padmāyāṃ padmakiraṇaṃ samudre vaḍavāsukham / kumāradhāre bāhlīśaṃ kārtikeyaṃ ca barhiṇam
ajeśe śaṃbhumanaghaṃ sthāṇuṃ ca kurujāṅgale / vanamālinamāhurmāṃ diṣkindhāvāsino janāḥ
vīraṃ kuvalāyārūḍhaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam / śrīvatsāhkamudārāṅgaṃ narmadāyāṃ śriyaḥ patim
māhiṣmatyāṃ trinayanaṃ tatraiva ca hutāśanam / arbude ca trisauparṇa kṣmādharaṃ sūkarācale
triṇāciketaṃ brahmarṣe prabhāse ca kapardinam / tathaivātrāpi vikhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ śaśisekharam
udaye śaśinaṃ sūryaṃ dhruvaṃ ca tritayaṃ sthitam / hemakūṭe hiraṇyākṣaṃ skandaṃ śaravaṇe mune
mahālaye smṛtaṃ rudramuttareṣu kuruṣvatha / padmanābhaṃ muniśreṣṭha sarvasaukhyapradāyakam
saptagodāvare brahman vikhyātaṃ hāṭakeśvaram / tatraiva ca mahāhaṃsaṃ prayāge 'pi vaṭeśvaram
śoṇe ca rukmakavacaṃ kuṇḍine ghrāṇatarpaṇam / bhillīvane mahāyogaṃ mādreṣu puruṣottamam
plakṣāvataraṇe viśvaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ dvijottama / śūrpārake caturbāhuṃ magadhāyāṃ sudhāpatim
girivraje paśupatiṃ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ yamunātaṭe / vanaspatiṃ samākhyātaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinam
kāliñjare nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sarayvāṃ śaṃbhumuttamam / haṃsayuktaṃ mahākośyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
gokarṇe dakṣiṇe śarvaṃ vāsudevaṃ prajāmukhe / vinghyaśṛṅge mahāśairiṃ kanthāyāṃ madhusūdanam
trikūṭaśikhare brahman cakrapāṇinamīśvaram / lauhadaṇḍe hṛṣīkeśaṃ kosalāyāṃ manoharam
mahābāhuṃ surāṣṭre ca navarāṣṭre yaśodharam / bhūdharaṃ devakānadyāṃ mahodāyāṃ kuśapriyam
gomatyāṃ chāditagadaṃ śaṅkhoddhāre ca śaṅkhinam / sunetraṃ saindhavāraṇye śūraṃ śūrapure sthitam
rudrākhyaṃ ca haraṇvatyāṃ vīrabhadraṃ triviṣṭape / śaṅkukarṇaṃ ca bhīmāyāṃ bhīmaṃ śālavane viduḥ
viśvāmitraṃ ca gaditaṃ kailāse vṛṣabhadhvajam / maheśaṃ mahilāśaile kāmarūpe śaśiprabham
balabhyāmapi gomitraṃ kaṭāhe paṅkajapriyam / upendraṃ siṃhaladvīpe śakrāhve kundamālinam
rasātale ca vikhyātaṃ sahasraśirasaṃ mune / kālāgnirudraṃ tatraiva tathānyaṃ kṛttivāsasam
sutale kūrmamacalaṃ vitale paṅkajāsanam / mahātale guro khyātaṃ deveśaṃ chāgaleśvaram
tale sahasracaraṇaṃ sahasrabhujamīśvaram / sahasrākṣaṃ parikhyātaṃ musalākṛṣṭadānavam
pātāle yogināmīśaṃ sthitañca hariśaṅkaram / dharātale kokanadaṃ medinyāṃ cakrapāṇinam
bhuvarloke ca garuḍaṃ svarloke viṣṇumavyayam / maharlloke tathāgastyaṃ kapilaṃ ca jane sthitam
tapoloke 'khilaṃ brahman vāṅmayaṃ satyasaṃyutam / brahmāṇaṃ brahmaloke ca saptame vai pratiṣṭhitam
sanātanaṃ tathā śaive paraṃ brahma ca vaiṣṇave / apratarkyaṃ nirālambe nirākāśe tapomayam
jambudvīpe caturbāhuṃ kuśadvīpe kuśeśayam / plakṣadvipe muniśreṣṭha khyātaṃ garuḍavāhanam
padmanābhaṃ tathā krauñce śālmale vṛṣabhadhvajam / sahasrāṃśuḥ sthitaḥ śāke dharmarāṭ puṣkare sthitaḥ
tathā pṛthivyāṃ brahmarṣe śālagrāme sthito 'smayaham / sajalasthalaparyantaṃ careṣu stāvareṣu ca
etāni puṇyāni mamālayāni brahman purāṇāni sanātanāni / dharmapradānīha mahaujasāni saṃkīrtanīyanyaghanāśanāni

saṃkīrtanāt smāraṇād darśanācca saṃsparśanādeva ca devatāyāḥ / dharmārthakāmādyapavargameva labhanti devā manujāḥ sasādhyāḥ // 63.46 // etāni tubhyaṃ viniveditāni mamālayānīha tapomayāni / uttiṣṭha gacchāmi mahāsurasya yajñaṃ surāṇāṃ hi hitāya vipra
pulastya uvāca / ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ maharṣe viṣṇurbharadvājamṛṣiṃ mahātmā / vilāsalīlāgamano girīndrāt sa cābhyagacchat kurujāṅgalaṃ hi

baliruvāca / āyāte vāsudeve vada mama bhagavan dharmakāmarthattattvaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ kiṃ ca deyaṃ maṇikankamatho bhūgajāśvādikaṃ vā / kiṃ vā vācyaṃ murārernijahitamathavā taddhitaṃ vā prayuḍhañje tathyaṃ pathyaṃpriyabhomama vadaśubhadantatkariṣye na cānyat
pulastya uvāca / tad vākyaṃ bhārgavaṃ śrutvā daityanātheritaṃ varam / vicintya nārada prāha bhūtabhavyavidīśvaraḥ
tvāyā kṛtā yajñabhujo 'surendrā bahiṣkṛtā ye śrutidṛṣṭamārge / śrutipramāṇaṃ makhabhojino bahiḥ surāstadarthaṃ harir abhyupaiti
tasyādhvaraṃ daityasamāgatasya kāryaṃ hi kiṃ māṃ paripṛcchase yat / kāryaṃ na deyaṃ hi vibho tṛṇāgraṃ yadadhvare bhūkanakādikaṃ vā
vācyaṃ tathā sāma nirarthakaṃ vibho kaste varaṃ dātumalaṃ hi śaknuyāt / yasyodare bhūrbhuvanākapālarasātaleśā nivasanti nityaśaḥ
baliruvāca / mayā na coktaṃ vacanaṃ hi bhārgava na cāsti mahyaṃ na ca dātumutsahe / samāgate 'pyayarthini hīnavṛtte janārdane lokapatau kathaṃ tu
evaṃ ca śruyate ślokaḥ satāṃ kathayatāṃ vibho / sadbhāvo brāhmaṇeṣveva karttavyo bhūtimicchatā / dṛśyate hi tathā tacca satyaṃ brāhmaṇasattama
pūrvābhyāsena karmāṇi saṃbhavanti nṛṇāṃ sphuṭam / vākkāyamanasānīha yonyantaragatānyapi
kiṃ vā tvayā dvijaśreṣṭha paurāṇī na śrutā kathā / yā vṛttā malaye pūrvaṃ kośakārasutasya tu
śukra uvāca / kathayasva mahābāho kośakārasutāśrayām / kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ puṇyāṃ mahākautūhalaṃ hi me
baliruvāca / śṛṇuṣva kathayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ makhāntare / pūrvābhyāsanibaddhāṃ hi satyāṃ bhṛgukulodvaha
mudgalasya muneḥ putro jñānavijñānapāragaḥ / kośakāra iti khyāta āsīd brahmaṃstaporataḥ
tasyāsīd dayitā sādhvī dharmiṣṭhā nāmataḥ sutā / satī vātsyāyanasutā dharmaśīlā pativratā
tasyāmasya suto jātaḥ prakṛtyā vai jaḍākṛtiḥ / mūkavannālapati sa na ca paśyati cāndhavat
taṃ jātaṃ brāhmaṇī putraṃ jaḍaṃ mūkaṃ tvacakṣuṣam / manyamānā gṛhadvāri ṣaṣṭhe 'hani samutsṛjat
tato 'bhyāgād durācārā rākṣasī jātahāriṇī / svaṃ śiśuṃ kṛśamādāya sūrpākṣī nāma nāmataḥ
tatrotsṛjya svaputraṃ sā jagrāha dvijanandanam / tamādāya jagāmātha bhoktuṃ śālodare girau
tatastāmāgatāṃ vīkṣya tasyā bhartā ghaṭodaraḥ / netrahīnaḥ pratyuvāca kimānītastvayā priye
sābravīt rākṣasapate mayā sthāpya nijaṃ śiśum / kośakāradvijagṛhe tasyānītaḥ prabho sutaḥ
sa prāha na tvayā bhadre bhadramācaritaṃ tviti / mahājñānī dvijendro 'sau tataḥ śapsyati kopitaḥ
tasmācchīghramimaṃ tyaktvā manujaṃ ghorarupiṇam / anyasya kasyacit putraṃ śīghramānaya sundari
ityevamuktā sā raudrā rākṣasī kāmacāriṇī / samājagāma tvaritā samutpatya vihāyasam
sa cāpi rākṣasasuto nisṛṣṭo gṛhabāhyataḥ / ruroda susvaraṃ brahman prakṣipyāṅguṣṭhamānane
sā kranditaṃ cirācchrutvā dharmiṣṭhā patimabravīt / paśya svayaṃ muniśreṣṭha saśabdastanayastava
trastā sā nirjagāmātha gṛhamadhyāt tapasvinī / sa cāpi brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ samapaśyata taṃ śiśum
varṇarūpādisaṃyuktaṃ yathā svatanayaṃ tathā / tato vihasya provāca kośakāro nijāṃ priyām
etenāviśya dharmiṣṭhe bhāvyaṃ bhūtena sāmpratam / ko 'pyaṭasmākaṃ chalayituṃ surūpī bhuvi saṃsthitaḥ
ityuktvā vacanaṃ mantrī mantraistaṃ rākṣasātmajam / babandhollikhya vasudhāṃ sakuśenātha pāṇinā
etasminnantare prāptā sūrpākṣī viprabālakam / antardhānagatā bhūmau cikṣepa gṛhadūrataḥ
taṃ kṣiptamātraṃ jagrāha kośakāraḥ svakaṃ sutam / sā cābhyetya grahītuṃ svaṃ nāśakad rākṣasī sutam
itaścetaśca vibhraṣṭā sā bhartāramupāgamat / kathayāmāsā yad vṛttaṃ svadvijātmajahīriṇam
evaṃ gatāyaṃ rākṣasyāṃ brāhmaṇena mahātmanā / sa rābhasaśiśurbrahman bhāryāyai viniveditaḥ
sa cātmatanayaḥ pitrā kapilāyāḥ savatsayāḥ / dadhnā saṃyojito 'tyarthaṃ kṣīreṇekṣurasena ca
dvāveva vardhitau bālau saṃjātau saptavārṣikau / pitrā ca kṛtanāmānau niśākaradivākarau
naiśācarirdivākīrtirniśākīrtiḥ svaputrakaḥ / tayoścakāra vipro 'sau vratabandhakriyāṃ kramāt
vratabandhe kṛte vedaṃ papāṭhāsau divākaraḥ / niśākaro jaḍatayā na papāṭheti naḥ śrutam
taṃ bāndhavāśca pitarau mātā bhrātā gurustathā / paryanindaṃstathā ye ca janā malayavāsinaḥ
tataḥ sa pitrā kruddhena kṣiptaḥ kūpe nirūdake / mahāśilāṃ copari vai pidhānamavaropayat
evaṃ kṣiptastadā kūpe samatīteṣu bhārgava / tasya mātāgamat kūpaṃ tamandhaṃ śilayācitam
tato daśasu varṣeṣu samatīteṣu bhārgava / tasya mātāgamat kūpaṃ tamandhaṃ śilayācitam
sā dṛṣṭāvā nicitaṃ kūpaṃ śilayā girikalpayā / uccaiḥ provāca keneyaṃ kūpopari śilā kṛtā
kūpāntasthaḥ sa tāṃ vāṇīṃ śrutvā māturniśākaraḥ / prāha pradattā pitrā me kūpopari śilā tviyam
sātibhītābravīt ko 'si kūpāntastho 'dbhutasvaraḥ / so 'pyāha tava putro 'smi niśākareti viśrutaḥ
sābravīt tanayo mahyaṃ nāmnā khyāto divākaraḥ / niśākareti nāmnāho na kaścit tanayo 'sti me
sa cāha pūrvacaritaṃ māturniravaśeṣataḥ / sā śrutvā tāṃ śilāṃsubhraḥ samutkṣipyāntayo 'śripat
sottīrya kūpāt bhagavan mātuḥ pādāvavandata / sā svānurūpaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā svasutasya ca
tatastamādāya sutaṃ dharmiṣṭhā patimetya ca / kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ svasutasya ca
tato/nvapṛcchad vipro 'sau kimidaṃ tāta kāraṇam / noktavān yadbhavān pūrvaṃ mahatkautūhalaṃ mama
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ dhīmān kośakāraṃ dvijottamam / prāha putro 'dbhutaṃ vākyaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā
śrūyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ tāta yena mūkatvamāśritam / mayā jaḍatvamanagha tathāndhatvaṃ svacakṣuṣaḥ
pūrvamāsamahaṃ vipra kule vṛndārakasya tu / vṛṣākapeśca tanayo mālāgarbhasamudbhavaḥ
tataḥ pitā pāṭhayanmāṃ śāstraṃ dharmārthakāmadam / mokṣaśāstraṃ paraṃ tāta setihāsaśrutiṃ tathā
so 'haṃ tāta mahājñānī parāvaraviśāradaḥ / jāto madāndhastenāhaṃ duṣkarmābhirato 'bhavam
madāt samabhavallebhastena naṣṭā pragalbhatā / viveko nāśamagamat mūrkhabhāvamupāgataḥ
mūḍha bhāvatayā cātha jātaḥ pāparato 'smbhaham / paradāraparārtheṣu matirme ca sadābhavat
paradārābhimarśitvāt parārthaharaṇādapi / mṛto 'smyudbndhanenāhaṃ narakaṃ rauravaṃ gataḥ
tasmād varṣasahasrānte bhuktaśiṣṭe tadāgasi / araṇye mṛgahā pāpaḥ saṃjāto 'haṃ mṛgādhipaḥ
vyāghratve saṃsthitastāta baddhaḥ pañjaragaḥ kṛtaḥ / narādhipena vibhunā nītaśca nagaraṃ nijam
baddhasya piñjarasthasya vyāghratve 'dhiṣṭhitasya ha / dharmārthakāmaśāstrāṇi pratyabhāsanta sarvaśaḥ
tato nṛpatiśārdūlo gadāpāṇiḥ kadācana / ekavastraparīdhāno nagarānniryayau bahiḥ
tasya bhāryā jitā nāma rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi / sā nirgate tu ramaṇe mamāntikamupāgatā
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vavṛdhe mahyaṃ pūrvābhyāsānmanobhavaḥ / yathaiva dharmaśāstrāṇi tathāhamavadaṃ ca tām
rājaputri sukalyāṇi navayauvanaśālini / cittaṃ harasi me bhīru kokilā dhvaninā yathā
sā madvacanamākarṇya provāca tanumadhyamā / kathamevāvayorvyāghra ratiyogamupeṣyati
tato 'hamabruvaṃ tāta rājaputrīṃ sumadhyamām / dvāramudghāṭayasvādya nirgamiṣyāmi satvaram
sāpyayabravīd divā vyāghra loko 'yaṃ paripaśyati / rātrāvudghāṭayiṣyāma tato raṃsyāva svecchayā
tāmevāhamavocaṃ vai kālakṣepe 'hamakṣamaḥ / tasmādudghāṭaya dvāraṃ māṃ bandhācca vimocaya
tataḥ sā pīvaraśreṇī dvāramudghāṭayanmune / udghāṭite tato dvāre nirgato 'haṃ bahiḥ śraṇāt
pāśāni nigaḍādīni chinnāni hi balānmayā / sā gṛhītā ca nṛpaterbhāryā ramitumicchatā
tato dṛṣṭo 'smi nṛpaterbhṛtyairatulavikramaiḥ / śastrahastaiḥ sarvataśca tairahaṃ pariveṣṭitaḥ
mahāpāśaiḥ śṛṅkhalābhiḥ samāhatya ca mudgaraiḥ / vadhyamāno 'bruvamahaṃ mā mā hiṃsadhvamākulāḥ
te madvacanamākarṇya matvaiva rajanīcaram / dṛḍhaṃ vṛkṣe samudbdhya ghātayanta tapodhana
bhayo gataśca narakaṃ paradāraniṣevaṇāt / mukto varṣasahasrānte jāto 'haṃ śvetagardabhaḥ
brāhmaṇasyāgniveśyasya gehe bahukalatriṇaḥ / tatrāpi sarvavijñānaṃ pratyabhāsat tato mama
upavanāhyaḥ kṛtaścāsmi dvijayoṣidbhirādarāt / ekadā navarāṣṭrīyā bhāryā tasyāgrajanmanaḥ
vimatirnāmataḥ khyātā gantumaicchad gṛhaṃ pituḥ / tāmuvāca patirgaccha āruhyaṃ śvetagardabham
māsenāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ na stheyaṃ paratastataḥ / ityevamuktā sā bhartrā tanvī māmadhiruhya ca
bandhanādavamucyātha jagāma tvaritā mune / tator'dhapathi sā tanvī matpṛṣṭhādavaruhya vai
avatīrṇā nadīṃ snātuṃ svarūpā cārdravāsasā / sāṅgopāṅgāṃ rūpavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā tāmahamādravam
mayā cābhidrutā tūrṇaṃ patitā pṛthivītale / tasyāmupari bho tāta patito 'haṃ bhṛśāturaḥ
hṛṣṭo bhartrānusṛṣṭena nṛṇā tadanusāriṇā / protkṣipya yaṣṭiṃ māṃ brahman samādhāvat tvarānvitaḥ
tad bhayāt tāṃ parityajya pradruto dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ / tato 'bhidravatastūrṇa khalīnarasanā mune
mamāsaktā vaṃśagulme durmokṣe prāṇanāśane / tatrāsaktasya ṣaḍrātrānmamābhūjjīvitakṣayaḥ
gato 'smi narakaṃ bhūyastasmānmukto 'bhavaṃ śukaḥ / mahāraṇye tathā baddhaḥ śabareṇa durātmanā
pañjare kṣipya vikrīto vaṇikputrāya śāline / tenāpyantaḥ puravare yuvatīnāṃ samīpataḥ
śabdaśāstravidityeva doṣaghnaścetyavasthitaḥ / tatrāsatastaruṇyastā odanāmbuphalādibhiḥ
bhakṣyaiśca dāḍimaphalaiḥ puṣṇantyaharahaḥ pitaḥ / kadācit padmapatrākṣī śyāmā pīnapayodharā
suśroṇī tanumadhyā ca vaṇikputrapriyā śubhā / nāmnā candrāvalī nāma samudghāṭyātha pañjaram
māṃ jagrāha sucārvaṅgī karābhyāṃ cāruhāsinī / cakāropari pīnābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ cāruhāsinī / cakāropari pīnābhyāṃ stanābhyāṃ sā hi māṃ tataḥ
tato 'haṃ kṛtavān bhāvaṃ tasyāṃ vilasituṃ plavan / tato 'nuplapatastatra hāre markaṭabandhanam
baddho 'haṃ pāpasaṃyukto mṛśca tadanantaram / bhūyo 'pi narakaṃ ghoraṃ prapanno 'smi sudurmatiḥ
tasmāccāhaṃ vṛṣatvaṃ vai gataścāṇḍālapakvaṇe / sa caikadā māṃ śakaṭe niyojya svāṃ vilāsinīm
samāropya mahātejā gantuṃ kṛtamatirvanam / tato 'grataḥ sa caṇḍālo gatastvevāsya pṛṣṭhataḥ
gāyantī yāti tacchrutvā jāto 'haṃ vyathitendriyaḥ / pṛṣṭhastu samālokya viparyastastathotplutaḥ
patito bhūmimagamam tadakṣe kṣaṇavikramāt / yoktre subaddha evāsmi pañcatvamagamaṃ tataḥ
bhūyo nimagno narake daśavarṣaśatānyapi / atastava gṛhe jātastvahaṃ jātimanusmaran
tāvantyevādya janmāni smarāmi cānupūrvaśaḥ / pūrvābhyāsācca śāstrāṇi bandhanaṃ cāgataṃ mama
tadahaṃ jātavijñāno nācariṣye kathañcana / pāpāni ghorarūpāṇi manasā karmaṇā girā
śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāpi svādhyāyaṃ śāstrajīvikā / bandhanaṃ vā vadho vāpi pūrvābhyāsena jāyate
jātiṃ yadā paurvikīṃ tu smarate tāta mānavaḥ / tadā sa tebhyaḥ pāpebhyo śubhavardhanāya pāpakṣayāyātha mune hyaraṇyam / bhavān divākīrtimimaṃ suputraṃ gārhasthyadharme viniyojayasva
tasmād gamiṣye śubhavardhanāya pāpakṣayāyātha mune hyaraṇyam / bhavān divākīrtimimaṃ suputraṃ gārhasthyadharme viniyojayasva
baliruvāca / ityevamuktvā sa niśākarastadā praṇamya mātāpitarau maharṣe / jagāma puṇyaṃ sadanaṃ murāreḥ khyātaṃ badaryāśramamādyamīḍyam
evaṃ purābhyāsaratasya puṃso bhavanti dānādhyayanādikāni / tasmācca pūrvaṃ dvijavarya vai mayā abhyastamāsīnnanu te bravīmi
dānaṃ tapo vādhyayanaṃ maharṣe steyaṃ mahāpātakamagnidāham / jñānāni caivābyasaṃtāṃ hi pūrvaṃ bhavanti dharmārthaśāṃsi nātha
pulastya uvāca / ityevamuktvā balavān sa śukraṃ daityeśvaraḥ svaḥ gurumīśitāram / dhyāyaṃstadāste madhukaiṭabhaghnaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ cakragadāsipāṇim

iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe catuḥṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ________________________________________________________________________ pulastya uvāca / etasminnantare prāpto bhagavān vāmanākṛtiḥ / jajñavāṭamupāgam uccairvacanamabravīt
oṅkārapūrvāḥ śrutayo makhe 'smin tiṣṭhanti rūpeṇa tapodhanānām / yajño 'śvamedhaḥ pravaraḥ kratūnāṃ mukhyastathā satriṣu daityanāthaḥ
itthaṃ vacanamākarṇya dānavādhipatirvaśī / sārghapātraḥ samabhyāgādyatra devaḥ sthito 'bhavat
tator'cya. devadeveśamarcyamarghādināsuraḥ / bharadvājarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ yajñavāṭaṃ praveśayat
praviṣṭamātraṃ deveśaṃ pratipūjya vadhānataḥ / provāca bhagavan brūhi kiṃ dadmi tava mānada
tato 'bravīt suraśreṣṭho daityarājānamavyayaḥ / vihasya suciraṃ kālaṃ bharadvājamavekṣya ca
gurormadīyasya gurustasyāstyagniparigrahaḥ / na sa dhārayate bhūmyāṃ pārakyāṃ jātavedasam
tadarthamabhiyāc'haṃ mama dānavapārthiva / maccharīrapramāṇena dehi rājan padatrayam
surārervacanaṃ śrutvā balirbhāryāmavekṣya ca / bāṇaṃ ca tanayaṃ vīkṣya idaṃ vacanamabravīt
na kevalaṃ pramāṇena vāmano 'yaṃ laghuḥ priye / yena kramatrayaṃ maurkhyād yācate buddhito 'pi ca
prayo vidhātālpadhiyāṃ narāṇāṃ bahiṣkṛtānāṃ ca mahānubhāgyaiḥ / dhanādikaṃ bhūri na vai dadāti yatheha viṣṇorna bahuprayāsaḥ
na dadāti vidhistasya yasya bhāgyaviparyayaḥ / mayi dātari yaścāyamadya yācet padatrayam
ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ mahātmā bhūyo 'pyuvācātha hariṃ danūjaḥ / yācasva viṣṇo gajavājibhūmiṃ dāsīhiraṇyaṃ yadabhīpsitaṃ ca
bhavān yācayitā viṣṇo ahaṃ dātā jagatpatiḥ / dāturyācayiturlajjā kathaṃ na syāt padatraye
rasātalaṃ vā vṛthivīṃ bhuvaṃ nākamathāpi vā / etabhyaḥ katamaṃ dadyāṃ sthānaṃ yācasva vāmana
vāmana uvāca / gajāśvabhūhiraṇyādi tadarthibhyaḥ pradīyatām / etāvatā tvahaṃ cārthī dehi rājan padatrayam
ityevamukte vacane vāmanena mahāsuraḥ / balirbhṛṅgāramādāya dadau viṣṇoḥ kramatrayam
pāṇau tu patite toye divyaṃ rūpaṃ cakāra ha / trailokyakramaṇārthāya bahurūpaṃ jaganmayam
padbhyāṃ bhūmistathā jaṅghe nabhastrailokyavanditaḥ / satyaṃ tapo jānuyugme ūrubhyāṃ merumandarau
viśvedevā kaṭībhāge maruto vastiśīrṣagāḥ / liṅge sthito manmathaśca vṛṣaṇābhyāṃ prajāpatiḥ
kukṣibhyāmarṇavāḥ sapta jaṭhare bhuvanāni ca / valiṣu triṣu nadyaśca yajñāstu jaṭhare sthitāḥ
iṣṭāpūrtādayaḥ sarvāḥ kriyāstatra tu saṃsthitāḥ / pṛṣṭhasthā vasavo devāḥ skandhau rudrairadhiṣaṭhitau
bāhavaśca diśaḥ sarvā vasavo 'ṣṭau kare smṛtāḥ / hṛdaye saṃsthito brahmā kuliśo hṛdayāsthiṣu
śrīsamudrā uromadhye candramā manasi sthitaḥ / grīvāditirdevamātā vidyāstadvalayasthitāḥ
mukhe tu sāgnayo viprāḥ saṃskārā daśanacchadāḥ / dharmakāmārthamokṣīyāḥ śāstraḥ śaucasamanvitāḥ
lakṣmyā saha lalāṭasthāḥ śravaṇābhyāmathāśvinau / śvāsastho mātariśvā ca marutaḥ sarvasaṃdhiṣu
sarvasūktāni daśānā jihvā devī sarasvatī / candrādityau ca nayane pakṣmasthāḥ kṛttikādayaḥ
śikhāyāṃ devadevasya dhruvo rājā nyaṣīdata / tārakā romakūpebhyo romāṇi ca maharṣayaḥ
guṇaiḥ sarvamayo bhūtvā bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ / krameṇaikena jagatīṃ jahāra sacarācarām
bhūmiṃ vikramamāṇasya mahārūpasya tasya vai / dakṣiṇo 'bhūt stanaścandraḥ sūryo 'bhūdatha cottaraḥ / nakṣaścākramato nābhiṃ sūryendū savyadakṣiṇau
dvitīyena krameṇātha svarmaharjanatāpasāḥ / krāntārdhārdhena vairājaṃ madhyenāpūryatāmbaram
tataḥ pratāpinā brahman bṛhadviṣṇvaṅghriṇāmbare / brahmāṇḍodaramāhatya nirālokaṃ jagāma ha
viśvāṅghriṇā prasaratā kaṭāho bhedito balān / kuṭilā viṣṇupāde tu sametya kuṭilā tataḥ
tasyā viṣṇupadītyevaṃ nāmākhyātamabhūnmune / tathā suranadītyevaṃ tāmasevanta tāpasāḥ / bhagavānapyasaṃpūrṇe tṛtīye tu krame vibhuḥ
samabhyetya baliṃ prāha īṣat prasphuritādharaḥ / ṛmād bhavati daityendra bandhanaṃ ghoradarśanam / tvaṃ pūraya padaṃ tanme no ced bandhaṃ pratīccha bhoḥ
tanmurārivacaḥ śrutvā vihasyātha baleḥ sutaḥ / bāṇaḥ prāhāmarapatiṃ vacanaṃ hetusaṃyutam
bāṇa uvāca / kṛtvā mahīmalpatarāṃ jagatpate svāyaṃbhuvādibhuvanāni vai ṣaṭ / kathaṃ baliṃ prārthayase suvistṛtāṃ yāṃ prāgbhavān no vipulāmathākarot
vibho sahī yāvatīyaṃ tvayādya sṛṣṭacā sametā bhuvanāntarālaiḥ / dattā ca tātena hi tāvatīyaṃ kiṃ vākchalenaiṣa nibadhyate 'dya
yā naiva śakya bhavatā hi pūrituṃ kathaṃ vitanyād ditijeśvaro 'sau / śaktastu saṃpūjayituṃ murāre prasīda mā bandhanamādiśasva
proktaṃ śrutau bhavatāpīśa vākyaṃ dānaṃ pātre bhavate saukhyadāyi / deśe supuṇye varade yacca kāle taccāśeṣaṃ dṛśyate cakrapāṇe
dānaṃ bhūmiḥ sarvakāmapradeyaṃ bhavān pātraṃ devadevo jitātmā / kālo jyeṣṭhāmūlayoge mṛgāṅgaḥ kurukṣetraṃ puṇyadeśaṃ prasiddham
kiṃ vā devo 'smadvidhairbuddhihīnaiḥ śikṣāpanīyaḥ sādhu vāsādhu caiva / svayaṃ śrutīnāmapi cādikarttā vyāpya sthitaḥ sadasad yo jagad vai
kṛtvā pramāṇaṃ svayaseva hīnaṃ padatrayaṃ yācitavān bhuvaśca / kiṃ tvaṃ na gṛhṇāsi jagattrayaṃ bho rūpeṇa lokatrayavanditena
nātrāścaryaṃ yajjagad vai samagraṃ kramatrayaṃ naiva pūrṇaṃ tavādya / krameṇa tvaṃ laṅghayituṃ samartho līlāmetāṃ kṛtavān lokanātha
pramāṇahīnāṃ svayameva kṛtvā vasuṃdharāṃ mādhava padmanābha / viṣṇo na badhnāsi baliṃ na dūre prabhuryadevecchati tatkaroti
pulastya uvāca / ityevamukte vacane bāṇena balisūnunā / provāca bhagavān vākyamādikarttā janārdanaḥ
trivikrama uvāca / yānyuktāni vacāṃsītthaṃ tvayā bāleya sāmpratam / teṣāṃ vaica hetusaṃyuktaṃ śṛṇu pratyuttaraṃ mama
pūrvamuktastava pitā mayā rājan padatrayam / dehi mahyaṃ pramāṇena tadetat samanuṣṭhitam
kiṃ na vetti pramāṇaṃ me balistava pitāsura / prāyacchad yena niḥśaṅkaṃ mamānantaṃ kramatrayam
satyaṃ krameṇa caikena krameyaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam / balerapi hitārthāya kṛtametat kramatrayam
tasmād yanmama bāleya tvatpitrāmbu kare mahat / dattaṃ tenāyuretasya kalpaṃ yāvad bhaviṣyati
gate manvantare bāṇa śrāddhadevasya sāmpratam / sāvarṇike ca saṃprāpte balirindro bhaviṣyati
itthaṃ proktvā balisutaṃ bāṇaṃ devastrivikramaḥ / provāca balimabhyetya vacanaṃ madhurākṣaram
śrībhagavānuvāca / āpūraṇād dakṣiṇāyā gaccha rājan mahāphalam / sutalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ vasa tatra nirāmayaḥ
baliruvāca / sutale vasato nātha mama bhogāḥ kuto 'vyayāḥ / bhaviṣyanti tu yenāhaṃ nivatsyāmi nirāmayaḥ
trivikrama uvāca / sutalasthasya daityendra yāni bhogāni te 'dhunā / bhivaṣyanti mahārhāṇi tāni vakṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ
dānānyavidhittāni śrāddhānyaśrotriyāṇi ca / tathādhītānyavratibhirdāsyanti bhavataḥ phalam
tathānyamutsavaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛtte śakramahotsave / dvārapratipadā nāma tava bhāvī mahotsavaḥ
tatra tvāṃ naraśārdūlā hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ / puṣpadīpapradānena arjayiṣyanti yatnataḥ
tatrotsavo sukhyatamo bhaviṣyati divāniśaṃ hṛṣṭajanābhirāmam / yathaiva rājye bhavatastu sāmprataṃ tathaiva sā bhāvyatha kaumudī ca
ityevamuktvā madhuhā ditīśvaraṃ visarjayitvā sutalaṃ sabhāryam / yajñaṃ samādāya jagāma tūrṇaṃ sa śakrasadbhāmarasaṃghajuṣṭam
dattvā maghone ca vibhustriviṣṭapaṃ kṛtvā ca devān makhabhāgabhoktṝn / antardadhe viśvapatirmaharṣe saṃpaśyatāmeva murādhipānām
svargaṃ gate dhātari vāsudeve śālvo 'surāṇāṃ mahatā balena / kṛtvā puraṃ saubhamiti prasiddhaṃ tadāntarikṣe vicacāra kāmāt
mayastu kṛtvā tripuraṃ mahātmā suvarṇatāmrāyasamagryasaukhyam / satārakākṣaḥ saha vaidyutena saṃtiṣṭhate bhṛtyakalatravān saḥ
baṇo 'pi devena hṛte triviṣṭape baddhe balau cāpi rasātalasthe / kṛtvā suguptaṃ bhuvi śoṇitākhyaṃ puraṃ sa cāste saha dānavendraiḥ
evaṃ purā cakradhareṇa viṣṇunā baddho balirvāmanarūpadhāriṇā / śakrapriyārtha surakāryasiddhaye hitāya viprarṣabhagodvijānām
prādurbhavaste kathito maharṣe puṇyaḥ śucirvāmanasyāghahārī / śrute yasmin saṃsmṛte kīrtite ca pāpaṃ yāti prakṣayaṃ puṇyameti
etat proktaṃ bhavataḥ puṇyakīrtteḥ prādurbhāvo balibandho 'vyayasya / yaccāpyanyan śrotukāmo 'si vipra tatprocyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmyaśeṣam

iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyaḥ ________________________________________________________________________ nārada uvāca / śrutaṃ yathā bhagavatā balirbaddho mahātmanā / kiṃ tvastayanyattu praṣṭavyaṃ tacchrutvā kathayādya me
bhagavān devarājāya dattvā viṣṇustriviṣṭapam / antardhānaṃ gataḥ kvāsau sarvātmā tāta kathyatām
sutalasthaśca daityendraḥ kimakārṣīt tathā vada / kā ceṣṭā tasya viprarṣe tanme vyākhyātumarhasi
pulastya uvāca / antardhāya surāvāsaṃ vāmano 'bhūdavāmanaḥ / jagāma brahmasadanamadhiruhyoragāśanam
vāsudevaṃ samāyāntaṃ jñātvā brahmāvyayātmakaḥ / samutthāyāyatha sauhārdāt sasvaje kamalāsanaḥ
pariṣvajyārcya vidhinā vedhāḥ pūjādinā harim / papraccha kiṃ cireṇeha bhavatāgamanaṃ kṛtam / 66.6 athovāca jagatsvāmī mayā kāryaṃ mahatkṛtam / surāṇāṃ kratubhāgārthaṃ svayaṃbho balibandhanam
pitāmahastad vacanaṃ śrutvā muditamānasaḥ / kathaṃ kathamiti prāha tvaṃ māṃ darśitumarhasi
ityevamukte vacane bhagavān garuḍadhvajaḥ / darśayāmāsa tadrūpaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ laghu
taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ yojanāyutavistṛtam / tāvānevordhvāmānena tato 'jaḥ praṇato 'bhavat
tataḥ praṇamya suciraṃ sādhu sādhvityudīrya ca / bhaktitamro mahādevaṃ padmajaḥ stotramīrayat

nṛtyanti tatrāpsarasāṃ samūhya gāyanti gītāni surendragāyanāḥ / vidyādharāstūryarāṃśca vādayan stuvanti devāsurasiddhasaṅghāḥ
tataḥ samārādhya vibhuṃ surādhipaḥ pitāmaho dhautamalaḥ sa śuddhaḥ / svarge viriñciḥ sadanāt supuṣpāṇyānīya pūjāṃ pracakāra viṣṇoḥ
svarge sahasraṃ sa tu yojanānāṃ viṣṇoḥ pramāṇena hi vāmano 'bhūt tatrāsya śakraḥ pracakāra pūjāṃ svayaṃbhuvastulyaguṇāṃ maharṣe
etat tavoktaṃ bhagavāṃstrivikramaścakāra yad devahitaṃ mahātmā / rasātalastho ditijaścakāra yattacchṛṇuṣvādya vadāmi vipra

iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ________________________________________________________________________ pulastya uvāca / gatvā rasātalaṃ daityo mahārhamaṇicitritam / śuddhasphaṭisopānaṃ kārayāmāsa vai puram
tatra madhye suvistīrmaḥ prāsādo vajravedikaḥ / muktājālāntaradvāro nirmito viśvakarmaṇā
tatrāste vividhān bhogān bhuñjan divyān sa mānuṣān / nāmnā vindhyāvalītyevaṃ bhāryāsya dayitābhavat / 67.3 yuvatīnāṃ sahasrasya pradhānā śīlamaṇḍitā / tayā saha mahātejā reme vairocanirmune
bhogāsaktasya daityasya vasataḥ sutale tadā / daityatejoharaḥ prāptaḥ capātāle vai sudarśanaḥ
cakre praviṣṭe pātālaṃ dānavānāṃ pure mahān / babhai halahalāśabdaḥ kṣubhitārṇavasaṃnibhaḥ
taṃ ca śrutvā mahāśabdaṃ baliḥ khaṅgaṃ samādade / āḥ kimetaditītthañca papracchāsurapuṅgavaḥ
tato vindhyāvalī prāha sāntvayantī nijaṃ patim / kośe khaṅgaṃ samāveśya dharmapatnī śucivratā
etad bhagavataścakraṃ daityacakrakṣayaṅkaram / saṃpūjanīyaṃ daityendra vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ / ityevamuktvā cārvaṅgī sārghapātrā viniryayau
athābhyāgāt sahasrāraṃ viṣṇoścakraṃ sudarśanam / tato 'surapatiḥ prahvaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo mune / saṃpūjya vidhivaccakramidaṃ stotramudīrayat
baliruvāca / namasyāmi hareścakraṃ daityacakravidāraṇam / sahasrāṃśuṃ sahasrābhaṃ sahasrāraṃ sunirmalam
namasyāmi hareścakraṃ yasya nābhyāṃ pitāmahaḥ / tuṇḍe triśūladhṛk śarva ārāmūle mahādrayaḥ
areṣu saṃsthitā devāḥ sendrāḥ sārkāḥ sapāvakāḥ / jave yasya sthito vāyurāpogniḥ pṛthivī nabhaḥ
āraprānteṣu jīmūtāḥ saudāminyṛkṣatārakāḥ / bāhmato munayo yasya bālakhilyādayastathā
tamāyudhavaraṃ vande vāsudevasya bhaktitaḥ / yanme pāpaṃ śarīrotthaṃ vāgjaṃ mānasameva ca
tanme dahasva dīptāṃśo viṣṇoścakra sudarśana / yanme kulodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ paitṛkaṃ mātṛkaṃ tathā
tanme harasva tarasā namaste acyutāyudha / ādhayo mama naśyantu vyādhayo yāntu saṃkṣayam / tvannāmakīrtanāc cakra duritaṃ yātu saṃkṣayam
ityevamuktvā matimān samabhyarcyātha bhaktitaḥ // saṃsmaran puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāsanam
pūjitaṃ balinā cakraṃ kṛtvā nistejaso 'surān / niścakrāmātha pātālād viṣuve dakṣime mune
sudarśane nirgate tu balirviklavatāṃ gataḥ / paramāmāpadaṃ prāpya sasmāra svapitāmaham
sa cāpi saṃsmṛtaḥ prāptaḥ sutalaṃ dānaveśvaraḥ / dṛṣṭvā tasthau mahātejāḥ sārghapātro balistadā

tamarcya vidhinā brahman pituḥ pitaramīśvaram / kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt / 67.22 saṃsmṛto 'si mayā tāta suviṣaṇṇena cetasā tanme hitaṃ ca pathyaṃ ca śreyogryaṃ vada tāta me / 67.23 kiṃ kāryaṃ tāta saṃsāre vasatā puruṣoṇa hi / kṛtena yena vai nāsya bandhaḥ samupajāyate / 67.24 saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ narāṇāmalpacetasām / taraṇe yo bhavet potastanme vyākhyātumarhasi

pulastya uvāca / etadvacanamākarṇya tatpautrād dānaveśvaraḥ / vicintya prāha vacanaṃ saṃsāre yadvitaṃ param // 67.26 // prahlāda uvāca / sādhu dānavaśārdūla yatte jātā matistviyam / pravakṣyāmi hitaṃ te 'dya tathāneyeṣāṃ hitaṃ bale
bhavajaladhigatānāṃ dvāndvavātāhatānāṃ sutaduhitṛkalatratrāṇabhārārditānām / viṣamaviṣayatoye majjatāmaplāvānāṃ bhavati śaraṇameko viṣṇupoto narāṇām

ye saṃśritā harimanantamanādimadhyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ suraguruṃ śubhadaṃ vareṇyam / śuddhaṃ khagendragamanaṃ kamalālayeśaṃ te dharmarājakaraṇaṃ na viśanti dhīrāḥ / 67.29 svapuruṣamabhivīkṣya pāśahastaṃ vadati yamaḥ kila tasya karṇamūle / parihara madhusūdanaprannān prabhurahamanyanṛṇāṃ na vaiṣṇavānām
tathānyaduktaṃ narasattamena ikṣvākuṇā bhaktiyutena nūnam / ye viṣṇubhaktāḥ puruṣāḥ pṛthivyāṃ yamasya te nirviṣayā bhavanti
sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti taccittaṃ yattadarpitam / tāveva kevalaṃ śalāghyau yau tatpūjākarau karau
nūnaṃ na tau karau proktau vṛkṣaśākhāgrapallavau / na yau pūjituṃ śaktau haripādāmbujadvayam
nūnaṃ tatkaṇṭhaśālūkamathavā pratijihvakā / rogovānyo na sā jihvā yā na vakti harerguṇān
śocanīyaḥ sa bandhūnāṃ jīvannapi mṛto naraḥ / yaḥ pādapaṅkajaṃ viṣṇorna pūjayati bhaktitaḥ
ye narā vāsudevasya satataṃ pūjane ratāḥ / mṛtā api na śocyāste satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam
śārīraṃ mānasaṃ vāgjaṃ mūrtāmūrtaṃ carācaram / dṛśyaṃ spṛsyamadṛśyañca tatsarvaṃ keśavātmakam
yenārcito hi bhagavān caturdhā vai trivikramaḥ / tenārcitā na saṃdeho lokāḥ sāmaradānavāḥ
yatā ratnāni jaladherasaṃkhyeyāni putraka / tathā guṇā hi devasya tvasaṃkhyātāstu cakriṇaḥ
ye śaṅkhacakrābjakaraṃ saśārṅgiṇaṃ khagendraketuṃ varadaṃ śriyaḥ patim / samāśrayante bhavabhītināśanaṃ saṃsāragarte na patanti te punaḥ
yeṣāṃ manasi govindo nivāsī satataṃ bale / na te paribhavaṃ yānti na mṛtyorudvijanti ca
devaṃ sārṅgadharaṃ viṣṇuṃ ye prapannāḥ parāyaṇam / na teṣāṃ yamasālokyaṃ na ca te narakaukasaḥ
na tāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuvanti śrutiśāstraviśāradāḥ / viprā dānavaśārdūla viṣṇubhaktā vrajanti yām
yā gatirdaityaśārdūla hatānāṃ tu mahāhave / tato 'dikāṃ gatiṃ yānti viṣṇubhaktā narottamāḥ
yā gatirdharmaśīlānāṃ sāttvikānāṃ mahātmanām / sā gatirgaditā daitya bhagavatsevināmapi
sarvāvāsaṃ vāsudevaṃ sūkṣmamavyaktavigraham / praviśanti mahātmānaṃ tadbhaktā nānyacetasaḥ
ananyamanaso bhaktyā ye namasyanti keśavam / śucayaste mahātmānastīrthabhūtā bhavanti te
gacchan tiṣṭhan svapan jāgrat pibannaścannabhīkṣṇaśaḥ / dhyāyan nārāyaṇaṃ yastu na tato 'nyo 'sti puṇyabhāk / vaikuṇṭhaṃ khaḍgaparaśuṃ bhavabandhasamucchidam
praṇipatya yathānyāyaṃ saṃsāre na punarbhavet / kṣetreṣu vasate nityaṃ krīḍannāste 'mitadyutiḥ
āsīnaḥ sarvadeheṣu karmabhirna sa badhyate / yeṣāṃ viṣṇuḥ priyontyante viṣṇoḥ satataṃ priyāḥ
na te punaḥ sambhavanti tadbhaktāstatparāyaṇāḥ / dhyāyed dāmodaraṃ yastu bhaktinamror'cayeta vā
na sa saṃsārapaṅke 'smin majjate dānaveśvara / kalyamutthāya ye bhaktyā smaranti madhusūdanam / stuvantyapyabhiśṛṇvanti durgaṇyatitaranti te
harivākyāmṛtaṃ pītvā vimalaiḥ śrotrabhājanaiḥ / prahṛṣyati mano yeṣāṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te
yeṣāṃ cakragadāpāṇau bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī / te yānti niyataṃ sthānaṃ yatra yogeśvaro hariḥ
viṣṇukarmaprasaktānāṃ bhaktānāṃ yā parā gatiḥ / sā tu janmasahasreṇa na tapobhiravāpyate
kiṃ japyaistasya mantrairvā kiṃ tapobhiḥ kimāśramaiḥ / yasya nāsti parā bhaktiḥ satataṃ madhusūdane
vṛthā yajñā vṛtā vedā vṛthā dānaṃ vṛthā śrutam / vṛthā tapaśca kīrtiśca yo dveṣṭi madhusūdanam
kiṃ tasya bahurbharmantrairbhaktiryasya janārdane / namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ
viṣṇureva gatiryoṣāṃ kutasteṣāṃ parājayaḥ / yeṣāmindīvaraśyāmo hṛdayastho janārdanaḥ
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ prabhum / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya sarvakarmāṇi kārayet
viṣṭayo vyatipātāśca ye 'nye durnītisambhavāḥ / te nāma smaraṇādviṣṇornāsaṃ yānti mahāsura
tīrthakoṭisahasrāṇi tīrthakoṭiśatāni ca / nārāyaṇapraṇāmasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca / tāni sarvāṇyavāpnoti viṣṇornāmānukīrtanāt
prāpnuvanti na tāṃllokān vratino vā tapasvinaḥ / prāpyante ye tu kṛṣṇasya namaskāraparairna raiḥ
yo 'pyanyadevatābhakto mithyārcayati keśavam / so/'pi gacchati sādhūnāṃ sthānaṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ mahat
sātatyena hṛṣīkeśaṃ pūjayitvā tu yatphalam / sucīrṇatapasāṃ nṝṇāṃ tatā phalaṃ na kadācana
trisandhyaṃ padmānābhaṃ tu ye smaranti sumedhasaḥ / te labhantyupavāsasya phalaṃ nāsatyatra saṃśayaḥ
satataṃ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā harimarcaya / tatprasādāt parāṃ siddhiṃ bale prāpsyasi śāśvatīm
tanmanā bhava tadbhaktastadyājī taṃ namaskuru / tamevāśritya deveśaṃ sukhaṃ prāpyasi putraka
ādyaṃ hyanantamajaraṃ harimavyayaṃ ca ye vai smarantyaharaharnṛvarā bhuvisthāḥ / sarvatragaṃ śubhadaṃ brahmamayaṃ purāṇam te yānti vaiṣṇavapadaṃ dhruvamakṣayañca
ye mānavā vigatarāgaparāparajñā nārāyaṇaṃ suraguruṃ satataṃ smaranti / te dhautapāṇḍurapuṭā iva rājahaṃsāḥ saṃsārasāgarajalasya taranti pāram
dhyāyanti ye satatamacyutamīśitāraṃ niṣkalmaṣaṃ pravarapadmadalāyatākṣam / dhyānena tena hatakilbaṣavedanāste mātuḥ payodhararasaṃ na punaḥ pibanti
ye kīrtayanti varadaṃ varapadmanābhaṃ śaṅkhābjacakravaracāpagadāsihastam / padmālayāvadanapaṅkajaṣaṭpadākhyaṃ nūnaṃ prayānti sadanaṃ madhughātinaste
śṛṇvanti ye bhaktiparā manuṣyāḥ saṃkīrtyamānaṃ bhagavantamādyam / te muktapāpāḥ sukhino bhavanti yathāmṛtaprāśanatarpitāstu
tasmād dhyānaṃ smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ vā nāmnāṃ śravaṇaṃ paṭhatāṃ sajjanānām / kāryaṃ viṣṇoḥ śraddadhānairmanuṣyaiḥ pūjātulyaṃ tat praśaṃsanti devā
bāhyaistathāntaḥkaraṇairaviklavairyo nārcayet keśavamīśitaram / puṣpaiśca patrairjalapallavādibhirnūnaṃ sa muṣṭo vidhitaskareṇa

iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saptaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ________________________________________________________________________ baliruvāca / bhavatā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ samārādhya janārdanam / yā gatiḥ prāpyate loke tāṃ me vaktumihārhasi
kenārcanena devasya prītiḥ samupajāyate / kāni dānāni śastāni prīṇanāya jagadguroḥ
upavāsādikaṃ kāryaṃ kasyāṃ tithyāṃ mahodayam / kāni puṇyāni śastāni viṣṇostuṣṭipradāni vai
yaccānyadapi karttavyaṃ hṛṣṭarūpairanālasaiḥ / tadapyaśeṣaṃ daityendra mamākhyātumihārhasi
prahlāda uvāca / śraddadhānairbhaktiparairyānyuddiśya janārdanam / bale dānāni dīyante tānūcurmunayo 'kṣayān
tā eva tithayaḥ śastā yāsvabhyarcya jagatpatim / taccittastanmayo bhūtvā upavāsī naro bhavet
pūjiteṣu dvijendreṣu pūjitaḥ syājjanārdanaḥ / etān dviṣanti ye mūḍhāste yānti narakaṃ dhruvam
tānarcayennaro bhaktyā brāhmaṇān viṣṇutatparaḥ / evamāha hariḥ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇā māmakī tanuḥ
brāhmaṇo nāvamantavyo budho vāpyabudho 'pi vā / so 'pi divyā tanurviṣṇostasmāt tāmarcayennaraḥ
tānyeva ca praśastāni kusumāni mahāsura / yāni syurvarṇayuktāni rasagandhayutāni ca
viśeṣataḥ pravakṣyāmi puṣpāṇi tithayastathā / dānāni ca praśastāni mādhavaprīṇanāya tu / / 68.11 jātī śatāhvā sumanāḥ kundaṃ bahupuṭaṃ tathā / bāṇañca campakāśokaṃ karavīraṃ ca yūthikā
pāribhadraṃ pāṭalā ca bakulaṃ giriśālinī / tilakaṃ ca japākusumaṃ pītakaṃ nāgaraṃ tvapi
etāni hi praśastāni kusumānyacyutārcane / surabhīṇi tathānyāni varjayitvā tu ketakīm
bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ patraṃ bhṛṅgamṛgāṅkayoḥ / tamālāmalakīpatraṃ śastaṃ keśavapūjane
yeṣāmapi hica puṣpāṇi praśastānyacyutārcane / pallavānyapi teṣāṃ stuḥ patrāṇyarcāvidhau hareḥ / 68.16 vīrudhāṃ ca pravālena barhiṣā cārcayettathā / nānārūpaiścāmbubhavaiḥ kamalendīvarādibhiḥ
pravālaiḥ śucibhiḥ ślakṣṇairjalaprakṣālitairbale / vanaspatīnāmarcyeta tathā dūrvāgrapallavaiḥ
candanenānulimpeta kuṅkumena prayatnanataḥ / uśīrapadmakābhyāṃ ca tathā kālīyakādinā
mahiṣākhyaṃ kaṇaṃ dāru sihlakaṃ sāgaruṃ sitā / śaṅkhaṃ jātīphalaṃ śrīśe dhūpāni syuḥ priyāṇi vai
haviṣā saṃskṛtā ye tu yavagodhūmaśālayaḥ / tilamudgādayo māṣā vrīhayaśca priyā hareḥ
godānāni pavitrāṇi bhūmidānāni cānagha / vastrānnasvarṇadānāni prītaye madhughātinaḥ
māghamāse tilā deyāstiladhenuśca dānava / indhanādīni ca tathā mādhavaprīṇanāya tu
phālgune vrīhayo mudgā vastrakṛṣṇājinādikam / govindaprīṇanārthāya dātavyaṃ puruṣarṣabhaiḥ
caitre citrāṇi vastrāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca / viṣṇoḥ prītyarthametāni deyāni brāhmaṇeṣvatha
gandhamālyāni deyāni vaiśākhe surabhīṇi vai / deyāni dvijamukhyebhyo madhusūdanatuṣṭaye
udakumbhāmbudhenuṃ ca tālavṛntaṃ sucandanam / trivikramasya prītyarthaṃ dātavyaṃ sādhubhiḥ sadā
uvānadyugalaṃ chatraṃ lavaṇāmalakādikam / āṣāḍhe vāmanaprītyai dātavyāni tu bhaktitaḥ
ghṛtaṃ ca kṣīrakumbhāśca ghṛtadhenuphalāni ca / śrāvaṇe śrīdharaprītyai dātavyāni vipaścitā
māsi bhādrapade dadyāt pāyasaṃ madhusarpiṣī / hṛṣīkeśaprīṇanārthaṃ lavaṇaṃ saguḍodanam
tilāsturaṅgaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dadhi tāmrāyasādikam / prītyarthaṃ padmanābhasya deyamāśvayuje naraiḥ
rajataṃ kanakaṃ dīpān maṇimuktāphalādikam / dāmodarasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ pradadyāt kārtike naraḥ
kharoṣṭrāśvatarān nāgān yānayugyamajāvikam / dātvayaṃ keśavaprītyai māsi mārgaśire naraiḥ
prāsādanagarādīni gṛhaprāvaraṇādikam / nārāyaṇasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ pauṣe deyāni bhaktitaḥ
dāsīdāsamalaṅkāramannaṃ ṣaḍrasasaṃyutam / puruṣottamasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ pradeyaṃ sārvakālikam
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiñcidyadvāpyasti śuci gṛhe / tattadvi deyaṃ prītyarthaṃ devadevāya cakriṇe
yaḥ kārayenmandiraṃ keśavasya puṇyāṃllokān sa jayecchāśvatān vai / dattvārāmān puṣpaphalābhipannān bhogān bhuṅkte kāmātaḥ ślāghanīyān
pitāmahasya purataḥ kulānyaṣṭau tu yāni ca / tārayedātmanā sārdhaṃ viṣṇormandirakārakaḥ
imāś ca pitaro daitya gāthā gāyanti yoginaḥ / purato yadusiṃhasya jyāmaghasya tapasvinaḥ
api naḥ sa kule kaścid viṣṇubhakto bhaviṣyati / harimandirakartā yo bhaviṣyati śicivrataḥ
api naḥ santatau jāyed viṣṇvālayavilepanam / sammārjanaṃ ca dharmātmā kariṣyati ca bhaktitaḥ
api naḥ santatau jāto dhvajaṃ cakeśavamandire / dāsyate devadevāya dīpaṃ puṣpānulepanam
mahāpātakayukto vā pātakī copapātakī / vimuktapāpo bhavati viṣṇvāyatanacitrakṛt
itthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā nṛpatisattamaḥ / cakārāyatanaṃ bhūmyāṃ khyaṃ ca limpatāsura
vibhūtibhiḥ keśavasya keśavārādhane rataḥ / nānādhātuvikāraiśca pañcavarṇaiśca citrakaiḥ
dadau dīpāni vidhivad vāsudevālaye bale / sugandhitailapūrṇāni ghṛtapūrṇāni ca svayam
nānāvarṇā vaijayantyo mahārajanarañjitāḥ / mañjiṣṭhā navaraṅgīyāḥ śvetapāṭalikāśritāḥ
ārāmā vividhā hṛdyāḥ puṣpāḍhyāḥ phalaśālinaḥ / latāpallavasaṃchannā devadārubhirāvṛtāḥ
kāritāśca mahāmañcādhiṣṭhitāḥ kuśalairjanaiḥ / paurogavavidhānajñai ratnasaṃskāribhirddaḍhai
teṣu nityaṃ prapūjyante yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ / śrotriyā jñānasampannā dīnāndhavikalādayaḥ
itthaṃ sa nṛpatiḥ kṛtvā śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ / jyāmagho viṣṇunilayaṃ gata ityanuśuśrumaḥ
tameva cāgyāpi bale mārgaṃ jyāmaghakāritam / vrajanti naraśārdūla viṣṇulokajigīṣavaḥ
tasmāt tvamapi rājendra kārayasvālayaṃ hareḥ / tamarcayasva yatnena brāhmaṇāṃśca bahuśrutān / paurāṇikān viśeṣeṇa sadācāraratāñśucīn
vāsobhirbhūṣaṇai ratnairgaubhirbhūkanakādibhiḥ / vibhave sati devasya prīṇanaṃ kuru cakriṇaḥ
evaṃ kriyāyogaratasya te 'dya nūnaṃ murāriḥ śubhado bhaviṣyati / narā na sīdanti bale samāśritā vibhuṃ jagannāthamanantamacyutam
pulastya uvāca / ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ ditīśvaro vairocanaṃ satyamanuttamaṃ hi / saṃpūjitastena vimuktimāyayau saṃpūrṇakāmo haripādabhaktaḥ
gate hi tasmin mudite pitāmahe balerbabhau mandiraminduvarṇam / mahendraśilpipravaro 'tha keśavaṃ sa kārayāmāsa mahāmahīyān
svayaṃ svabhāryāsahitaścakāra devālaye mārjanalepanādikāḥ / kriyā mahātmā yavaśarkarādyāṃ baliṃ cakārāpratimāṃ madhudruhaḥ
dīpapradānaṃ svayamāyatākṣī vindhyāvalī viṣṇugṛhe cakāra / geyaṃ sa dharmyaśravaṇaṃ ca dhīmān paurāṇikairvipravarairakārayat
tathāvidhasyāsurapuṅgavasya dharmye sumārge pratisaṃsthitasya / jagatpatirdivyavapurjanārdanastasthau mahātmā balirakṣaṇāya
sūryāyutābhaṃ musalaṃ pragṛhya nighnan sa duṣṭāriyūthāpālān / dvāri sthito na pradadau praveśaṃ prākāragupte balino gṛhe tu
dvāri sthite dhātari rakṣapāle nārāyaṇe sarvaguṇābhirāme / prāsādamadhye harimīśitāramabhyarcayāmāsa surarṣimukhyam
sa evamāste 'surarāḍ balistu samarcayan vai haripādapaṅkajau / sasmāra nityaṃ haribhaṣitāni sa tasya jāto vinayāṅkuśastu
idaṃ ca vṛttaṃ sa papāṭha daityarāṭ smaran suvākyāni guroḥ śubhāni / tathyāni pathyāni paratra ceha pitāmahasyendrasamasya vīraḥ
ye vṛddhavākyāni samācaranti śrutvā duruktānyapi pūrvatastu / snigdhāni paścānnavanītaśuddhā modanti te nātra vicāramasti
āpadbhujaṅgadaṣṭasya mantrahīnasya sarvadā / vṛddhavākyaiṣadhā nūnaṃ kurvanti kila nirviṣam
vṛddhavākyāmṛtaṃ pītvā taduktamanumānya ca / yā tṛptirjāyate puṃsā somapāne kutastathā
āpattau patitānāṃ yeṣāṃ vṛddhā na santi śāstāraḥ / te śocyā banadhūnāṃ jīvanto 'pīha mṛtatulyāḥ
āpadgrāhagṛhītānāṃ vṛddhāḥ santi na paṇḍitāḥ / yeṣāṃ mokṣyitāre vai teṣāṃ sāntirna vidyate
āpajjalanimagnānāṃ hriyatāṃ vyasanormibhiḥ / vṛddhavākyairvinā nūnaṃ naivottāraṃ kathañcana
tasmād yo vṛddhavākyāni śṛṇuyād vidadhāti ca / sa sadyaḥ siddhimāpnoti yathā vairocano baliḥ

iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ________________________________________________________________________ pulastya uvāca / etanmayā puṇyatamaṃ purāṇaṃ tubhyaṃ tathā nārada kīrtitaṃ vai / śrutvā ca kīrtyā parayā sameto bhaktyā ca viṣṇoḥ padamabhyupaiti
yathā pāpāni pūyante gaṅgāvārivigāhanāt / tathā purāṇaśravaṇād duritānāṃ vināśanam
na tasya rogā jāyante na viṣaṃ cābhicārikam / śarīre ca kule brahman yaḥ śruṇoti ca vāmanam
śraṇoti nityaṃ vidhivacca bhaktyā saṃpūjayan yaḥ praṇataśca viṣṇum / sa cāśvamedhasya sadakṣiṇasya phalaṃ samagraṃ parihinapāpaḥ

prāpnoti dattasya suvarṇabhūmeraśvasya gonāgarathasya caiva nārī naraścāpi ca pādamekaṃ śṛṇvan śuciḥ puṇyatamaḥ pṛthivyām / 69.5 snāne kṛte tīrthavare supuṇye gaṅgājale naimiṣapuṣkare vā / kokāmukhe yat pravadanti viprāḥ prayāgamāsādya ca māghamāse
sa tatphalaṃ prāpya ca vāmanasya saṃkīrtayan nānyamanāḥ padaṃ hi / gacchenmayā nārada te 'dya coktaṃ yad rājasūyasya phalaṃ prayacchet
yad bhūmiloke suralokalabhye mahatsukhaṃ prāpya naraḥ samagram / prāpanoti cāsya śravaṇānmaharṣe sautrāmaṇernāsti ca saṃśayo me
ratnasya dānasya ca yatphalaṃ bhaved yatsūryasya cendorgrahaṇe ca rāhoḥ / annasya dānena phalaṃ yathoktaṃ bubhukṣite vipravare ca sāgnike
durbhikṣasaṃpīḍitaputrabhārye yāmī sadā poṣaṇatatpare ca / devāgniviprarṣirate ca pitroḥ śuśruṣake bhrātari jyeṣṭhasāmne / yattatphalaṃ saṃpravadanti devāḥ sa tat phalaṃ labhate cāsya pāṭhāt
caturdaśaṃ vāmanamāhuragryaṃ śrute ca yasyāghacayāśca nāśam / prayānti nāstyatra ca saṃśayo me mahānti pāpānyapi nāradāśu
pāṭhāt saṃśravaṇād vipra śrāvaṇādapi kasyacit / sarvapāpāni naśyanti vāmanasya sadā mude
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tavoktaṃ na vācyametaddharibhaktivarjite / dvijasya nindāratihinadakṣiṇe sahetuvākyāvṛtapāpasattve
namo namaḥ kāraṇa vāmanāya nityaṃ yo vadenniyataṃ dvijaḥ / tasya viṣṇuḥ padaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti surapūjitaḥ
vācakāya pradātavya gobhūsvarṇavibhūṣaṇam / vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ kurvan śravaṇanāśakam
trisaṃdhyaṃ ca paṭhan śṛṇvan sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / asūyārahitaṃ vipra sarvasampatpradāyakam
devadeva uvāca sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyorantare kurujāṅgale / sunipravaramāsīnaṃ purāṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam / aṣṭacchanta dvijavarāḥ prabhāvaṃ sarasastadā
pramāṇaṃ saraso brūhi tīrthānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / devatānāṃ ca māhātmyamutpattiṃ vāmanasya ca
etacchrutvā vacasteṣāṃ romaharṣasamanvitaḥ / praṇipatya purāṇarṣiridaṃ vacanamavravīt
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca brahmaṇamagryaṃ kamalāsanasthaṃ viṣṇuṃ tathā lakṣmisamanvitaṃ ca / rudraṃ ca devaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhnā tīrthaṃ mahad brahmasaraḥ pravakṣye
rantukādaujasaṃ yāvat pāvanācca caturmukham / saraḥ saṃnihitaṃ proktaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvameva tu
kalidvāparayormadhye vyāsena ca mahātmanā / saraḥpramāṇaṃ yatproktaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ
viśveśvarādasthipuraṃ rathā kanyā jaradgavī / yāvadoghavatī proktā tāvatsaṃnihitaṃ saraḥ
mayā śrutaṃ pramāṇaṃ yat paṭhyamānaṃ tu vāmane / tacchṛṇudhvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ puṇyaṃ vṛddhikaraṃ mahat
viśveśvarād devavarā nṛpāvanāt sarasvatī / saraḥ saṃnihitaṃ jñeyaṃ samantādarthayojanam
etadāśritya devāśca ṛṣayaśca samāgatāḥ / sevante muktikāmārthaṃ svargārthe cāpare sthitāḥ
brahmaṇā sevitamidaṃ sṛṣṭikāmena yoginā / viṣṇunā sthitikāmena harirūpeṇa sevitam
rudreṇa ca saromadhyaṃ praviṣṭena mahātmanā / sevya tīrthaṃ mahātejāḥ sthāṇutvaṃ prāptavān haraḥ
ādyaiṣā brahmaṇo vedistato rāmahṛdaḥ smṛtaḥ / karuṇā ca yataḥ kṛṣṭaṃ kurukṣetraṃ tataḥ smṛtam
tarantukārantukayoryadantaraṃ yadantaraṃ rāmahṛdāccaturmukham / etkurukṣetrasamantapañcakaṃ pitāmahasyottaravedirucyate
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ brūhi vāmanamāhātmyamutpattiṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / yathā balirniyamito dattaṃ rājyaṃ śatakratoḥ
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ prītā vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ / utpattiṃ ca prabhāvaṃ ca nivāsaṃ kurujāṅgale
tadeva vaṃśaṃ daityānāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ / yasya vaṃśe samabhavad balirvairocaniḥ purā
daityānāmādipuruṣo hiraṇyakaśipuḥ purā / tasya putro mahātejāḥ prahlādo nāma dānavaḥ
tasmād virocano jajñe balirjajñe virocanāt / hate hiraṇyakaśipau devānutsādya sarvataḥ
rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ ca teneṣṭaṃ trailokye sacarācare / kṛtayatneṣu deveṣu trailokye daityatāṃ gate
jaye tathā balavatormayaśambarayostathā / śuddhāsu dikṣu sarvāsu pravṛtte dharmakarmaṇi
saṃpravṛtte daityapathe ayanasthe divākare / prahlādaśambaramayairanuhvādena caiva hi
dikṣu sarvāsu suptāsu gagane daityapālite / deveṣu makhaśobhāṃ ca svargasthāṃ darśayatsu ca
prakṛtisthe tato loke vartamāne ca satpathe / abhāve sarvapāpānāṃ dharmabhāve sadotthite
catuṣpāde sthite dharme hyadharme pādavigrahe / prajāpālanayukteṣu bhrājamāneṣu rājasu / svadharmasaṃprayukteṣu tathāśramanivāsiṣu
abhiṣikto 'suraiḥ sarvairdaityarājye balistadā / hṛṣṭeṣvasurasaṃgheṣu nadatsu muditeṣu ca
athābhyupagatā lakṣmīr baliṃ padmāntaraprabhā / padmodyatakarā devī varadā supraveśinī
śrīruvāca bale balavatāṃ śreṣṭha daityarāja mahādyute / prītāsmi tava bhadraṃ te devarājaparājaye
yattvayā yudhi vikramya devarājyaṃ parājitam / dṛṣṭvā te paramaṃ sattvaṃ tato 'haṃ svayamāgatā
nāścaryaṃ dānavavyāghra hiraṇyakaśipoḥ kule / prasūtasyāsurendrasya tava karme damīdṛśam
viśeṣitastvayā rājan daityendraḥ prapitāmahaḥ / yena bhuktaṃ hi nikhilaṃ trailokyamidamavyayam
evamuktvā tu sā devī lakṣmīrdaityanṛpaṃ balim / praviṣṭā varadā sevyā sarvadevamanoramā
tuṣṭāśca devyaḥ pravarāḥ hrīḥ kīrtirdyutireva ca / prabhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā bhūtir ṛddhirdivyā mahāmatiḥ
śrutiḥsmṛtiriḍā kīrtiḥ śāntiḥ puṣṭistathā kriyā / sarvāścapsaraso divyā nṛttagītaviśāradāḥ
prapadyante sma daityendraṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / prāptamaiśvaryamatulaṃ balinā brahmavādinā
iti kṣīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ in ree nicht zulässige zeichen: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ devānāṃ brūhi naḥ karma yadvṛttāste parājitāḥ / kathaṃ devātidevo 'sau viṣṇurvāmanatāṃ gataḥ
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca// balisaṃsthaṃ ca trailokyaṃ dṛṣṭvā devaḥ purandaraḥ/ meruprasthaṃ yayau śakraḥ svamāturnilayaṃ śubham
samīpaṃ prāpya mātuśca kathayāmāsa tāṃ giram / ādityāśca yathā yuddhe dānavena parājitāḥ
aditiruvāca// yadyevaṃ putra yuṣmābhirna śakyo hantumāhave / balirvirocanasutaḥ sarvaiścaiva marudgaṇaiḥ
sahasraśirasā śakyaḥ kevalaṃ hantumāhave / tenaikena sahasrākṣa na sa hyanyena śakyate
tadvat pṛcchāmi pitaraṃ kaśyapaṃ brahmavādinam/ parājayārthaṃ daityasya balestasya mahātmanaḥ
tato 'dityā saha surāḥ paṃprāptāḥ kaśyapāntikam / tatrāpaśyanta mārīcaṃ muniṃ dīptataponidhim
ādyaṃ devaguruṃ divyaṃ pradīptaṃ brahmavarcasā / tejasā bhāskarākāraṃ sthitamagniśikhopamam
nyastadaṇḍaṃ tapoyuktaṃ baddhakṛṣṇājināmbaram / valkalājinasaṃvītaṃ pradīptamiva tejasā
hutāśamiva dīpyantamājyagandhapuraskṛtam / svādhyāyavantaṃ pitaraṃ vapuṣmantamivānalam
brahmavādisatyavādisurāsuraguruṃ prabhum / brāhmaṇyāpratimaṃ lakṣmyā kaśyapaṃ dīptatejasam
yaḥ sraṣṭā sarvalokānāṃ prajānāṃ patiruttamaḥ / ātmabhāvaviśeṣeṇa tṛtīyo yaḥ prajāpatiḥ
atha praṇamya te vīrāḥ sahādityā surarṣabhāḥ / ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve brahmāṇamiva mānasāḥ
ajeyo yudhi śakreṇa balirdaityo balādhikaḥ / tasmād vidhatta naḥ śreyo devānāṃ puṣṭivardhanam
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ putrāṇāṃ kaśyapaḥ prabhuḥ / akarod gamane buddhi brahmalokāya lokakṛt
kaśyapa uvāca śakra gacchāma sadanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramādbhutam / tathā parājayaṃ sarve brahmaṇaḥ khyātumudyatāḥ
sahādityā tato devāyātāḥ kāśyapamāśramam / prasthitā brahmasadanaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam
te muhūrtena saṃprāptā brahmalokaṃ suvarcasaḥ / divyaiḥ kāmagamairyānairyathārhaiste mahābalāḥ
brahmāṇaṃ draṣṭumicchantastaporāśinamavyāyam / adhyagacchanta vistīrṇā brahmaṇaḥ paramāṃ sabhām
ṣaṭpadodgītamadhurāṃ sāmagaiḥ samudīritām / śreyaskarīmamitraghnīṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃjahṛṣustadā
ṛco bahvacamukhyaiśca proktāḥ kramapadākṣarāḥ / śuśruvurvibudhavyāghrā vitateṣu ca karmasu
yajñavidyāvedavidaḥ padakramavidastathā / svareṇa paramarṣiṇāṃ sā babhūva praṇāditā
yajñasaṃstavavidbhiśca śikṣāvidbhistathā dvijaiḥ / chandasāṃ caiva cārthajñaiḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaiḥ
lokāyatikamukhyaiśca śuśruvuḥ svaramīritam / tatra tatra ca viprendrā niyatāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
japahomaparā mukhyā dadṛśuḥ kaśyapātmajāḥ / tasyāṃ sabhāyāmāste sa brahma lokapitāmahaḥ
surāsuraguruḥ śrīmān vidyayā vedamāyayā / upāsanta ca tatraiva prajānāṃ patayaḥ prabhum
dakṣaḥ pracetāḥ pulaho marīciśca dvijottamāḥ / bhṛguratrirvasiṣṭhaśca gautamo nāradastathā
vidyāstathāntarikṣaṃ ca vāyustejo jalaṃ maho / śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca
prakṛtiśca vikāraśca yaccānyat kāraṇaṃ mahat / sāṅgopāṅgāśca catvāro vedā lokapatistathā
nayāśca kratavaścaiva saṅkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca / ete cānye ca bahavaḥ svayaṃbhuvamupāsate
artho dharmaśya kāmaśca krodho harṣaśca nityaśaḥ / sakro bṛhaspatiścaiva saṃvarta'tha budhastathā
śanāścaraśca rāhuśca grahāḥ sarve vyavasthitāḥ / maruto viśvakarmā ca vasavaśca dvijottamāḥ
divākaraśca somaśca divā rātristathaiva ca / arddhamāsāśca māsāśca ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ ca saṃsthitāḥ
tāṃ praviśya sabhāṃ divyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ sarvakāmikām / kaśyapastridaśaiḥ sārddha putrairdharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
sarvatejomayīṃ divyāṃ brahmarṣigaṇasevitām / brāhmyā śriyā sevyamānām acintyāṃ vigataklamām
brahmaṇaṃ prakṣya te sarve paramāsanamāsthitam / śirobhiḥ praṇatā devaṃ devā brahmarṣibhiḥ saha
tataḥ praṇamya caraṇau niyatāḥ paramātmanaḥ / vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śāntā vigatakalmaṣāḥ
dṛṣṭvā tu tān surān sarvān kaśyapena sahāgatān / āha brahma mahātejā devānāṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ
brahmovāca yadarthamiha saṃprāpta bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi / cintayāmyahamapyagre tadarthaṃ ca mahābalā
bhaviṣyati ca vaḥ sarvaṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ yat surottamāḥ / balerdānavamukhyasya yo 'sya jetā bhaviṣyati
na kevalaṃ surādīnāṃ gatirmama sa viśvakṛt / trailokyasyāpi netā ca devānāmapi sa prabhuḥ
yaḥ prabhuḥ sarvalokānāṃ viśveśaśca sanātanaḥ / pūrvajo 'yaṃ sadāpyāhurādidevaṃ sanātanam
tandevāpi mahātmānaṃ na viduḥ ko 'pyasāviti / devānāsmān śrutiṃ viśvaṃ sa vetti puruṣottamaḥ
tasyaiva tu prasādena pravakṣye paramāṃ gatim / yatra yogaṃ samāsthāya tapaścarati duścaram
kṣīrodsayottare kūle udīcyāṃ diśi viśvakṛt / amṛtaṃ nāma paramaṃ sthānamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
bhavantastatra vai gatvā tapasā śaṃsitavratāḥ / amṛtaṃ sthānamāsādya tapaścarata duścaram
tataḥ śroṣyatha saṃghuṣṭāṃ snigdhagambhīraniḥ svanām / uṣṇānte toyadasyeva toyapūrṇasya niḥsvanam
raktāṃ puṣṭakṣarāṃ ramyamābhayāṃ sarvadā śivām / vāṇīṃ paramasaṃskāraṃ vadatāṃ brahmavādinām
divyāṃ satyakarīṃ satyāṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśinīm / sarvadevādhidevasya tato 'sau bhāvitātmanaḥ
tasya vratasamāptyāṃ tu yogavratavisarjane / amoghaṃ tasya devasya viśvatejo mahātmanaḥ
kasya kiṃ vo varaṃ devā dadāmi varadaḥ sthitaḥ / svāgataṃ vaḥ suraśreṣṭhā matsamīpamupāgatāḥ
tato 'ditiḥ kaśyapaśca gṛhṇīyātāṃ varaṃ tadā / praṇamya śirasā pādau tasmai devāya dhīmate
bhagavāneva naḥ putro bhavatviti prasīda naḥ / uktaśca parayā vācā tathāstvati sa vakṣyati
devā bruvanti te sarve kasyapo 'ditireva ca / tathāstviti surāḥ sarve praṇamya śirasā prabhum / śvetadvīpaṃ samuddiśya gatāḥ saumyadiśaṃ prati
te 'cireṇaiva saṃprāptāḥ kṣīrodaṃ saritāṃ patim / yathoddiṣṭaṃ bhagavatā brahmaṇā satyavādinā
te krāntāḥ sāgarān sarvān parvatāṃśca sakānanān / nadīśca vividhā divyāḥ pṛthivyāṃ te suroktamāḥ
apaśyanta tamo ghoraṃ sarvasattvavivarjitam / abhāskaramamaryādaṃ tamasā sarvato vṛtam
amṛtaṃ sthānamāsādyakaśyapena mahātmanā / dīkṣitāḥ kāmadaṃ divyaṃ vrataṃ varṣa sahasrakam
prasādārthaṃ sureśāya tasmai yogāya dhīmate / nārāyaṇāya devāya sahasrākṣāya bhūtaye
brahmacaryeṇa maunena sthānavīrāsanena ca / krameṇa ca surāḥ sarve tapa ugraṃ samāsthitāḥ
kaśyapastatra bhagavān prasādārthaṃ mahātmanaḥ / udīrayata vedoktaṃ yamāhuḥ paramaṃ stavam

iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye caturthe 'dhyāyaḥ kaśyapa uvāca namo 'stu te devadeva ekaśṛṅga vṛṣārcce sindhuvṛṣa vṛṣākape suravṛṣa anādisaṃbhava rudra kapila viṣvaksena sarvabhūtapate dhruva dharmadharma vaikuṇṭha vṛṣāvarta anādimadhyanidhana dhanañjaya śuciśravaḥ pṛśnitejaḥ nijaya (5) amṛteśaya sanātana tridhāma tuṣita mahātattva lokanātha padmanābha viriñce bahurūpa akṣaya akṣara havyabhuja khaṇḍaparaśo śatakra muñjakeśa haṃsa mahādakṣiṇa hṛṣīkeśa sūkṣma mahāniyamadhara viraja lokapratiṣṭha arūpa agraja dharmaja dharmanābha (10) gabhastinābha śatakratunābha candraratha sūryatejaḥ samudravāsaḥ ajaḥ sahasraśiraḥ sahasrapāda adomukha mahāpuruṣa puruṣottama sahasrabāho sahasramūrte sahasrāsya paruṣottama sahasrabāho sahasramūrte sahasrāsya sahasrasaṃbhava sahasrasattvaṃ tvamāhuḥ / puṣpahāsa carama tvameva vauṣaṭ (15) vaṣaṭkāraṃ tvāmāhuragrayaṃ makheṣu prāśitāraṃ sahasradhāraṃ ca bhuśca bhuvaśca svaśca tvameva vedavedya brahmaśaya brāhmaṇapriya tvameva dyaurasi mātariśvāsi dharmo 'si hotā potā mantā netā homahetus tvameva agraya viśvadhāmnā tvameva digbhiḥ subhāṇḍa (20) ijyo 'si sumedho 'si samidhastvameva matir gatir dātā tvamasi / mokṣo 'si yogo 'si / sṛjasi / dhātā paramayajño 'si somo 'si dīkṣito 'si dakṣiṇāsi viśvamasi / sthavira hiraṇyanāma nārāyaṇa trinayana ādityavarma ādityatejaḥ mahāpuruṣa (25) puruṣottama ādidedeva suvikrama prabhākara śaṃbho svayaṃbho bhūtādiḥ mahābhūto 'si viśvabhūta viśvaṃ tvameva viśvagoptāsi pavitramasi viśvabhava ūrdhvakarma amṛta divaspate vācaspate ghṛtārce anantakarma vaṃśa pragvaṃśa viśvapāstvameva varārthināṃ varado 'si tvam / (30) caturbhiśca caturbhiśca dvābhyāṃ pañjabhireva ca / hūyate ca punardvābhyāṃ tubhyaṃ hotrātmane namaḥ / iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / nārāyaṇastu bhagavāñchrutvaivaṃ paramaṃ stavam / brahmajñena dvijendreṇa kaśyapena samīritam
upāca vacanaṃ samyak tuṣṭaḥ puṣṭapadākṣaram / śrīmān prītamanā devo yadvadet prabhurīśvaraḥ
varaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ bhadraṃ vo varado 'smi surottamāḥ / kaśyapa uvāca prīto 'si naḥ suraśreṣṭha sarveṣāmeva niścayaḥ
vāsavasyānujo bhrātā jñātīnāṃ nandivardhanaḥ / adityā api ca śrīmān bhagavānasta vai sutaḥ
aditirdevamātā ca etamevārthamuttamam / putrārthaṃ varadaṃ prāha bhagavantaṃ varārthinī
devā ūcuḥ niḥśreyasārthaṃ sarveṣāṃ daivatānāṃ maheśvara / trātā bhartā ca dātā ca śaraṇaṃ bhava naḥ sadā
tatastānabravīdviṣṇurdevān kaśyapameva ca / sarveṣāmeva yuṣmākaṃ ye bhaviṣyanti śatravaḥ / muhūrtamapi te sarve na sthāsyanti mamāgrataḥ
hatvāsurāgaṇan sarvān yajñabhāgāgrabhejinaḥ / havyādāṃśca surān sarvān kavyādāṃśca pitṛnapi
kariṣye vibudhaśreṣṭhāḥ pārameṣṭhyena karmaṇā / yathāyātena sārgeṇa nivartadhvaṃ surottamāḥ
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca evamukte tu devena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā / tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ pūjayanti sma taṃ prabhum
viśvedevā mahātmānaḥ kaśyapo 'ditireva ca / namaskṛtya sureśāya tasmai devāya raṃhasā
prayātāḥ prāgdiśaṃ sarve vipulaṃ kaśyapāśramam / te kaśyapāśramaṃ gatvā kurukṣetravanaṃ mahāt
prasādya hyaditiṃ tatra tapase tāṃ nyayojayan/ tha sā cacāra tapo ghoraṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ tadā
tasyā nāmnā vanaṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham / ārādhanāya kṛṣṇasya vāgjitā vāyubhojanā
daityairnirākṛtān dṛṣṭvā tanayānṛṣisattamāḥ / vṛthāputrāhamiti sā nirvedāt praṇayāddharim / tuṣṭāva vāgbhiragryābhiḥ paramārthavabodhinī
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇatā bhaktavatsalam / devadaityamayaṃ cādimadhyamāntasvarūpiṇam
aditiruvāca namaḥ kṛtyārtināśāya namaḥ puṣkaramāline / namaḥ paramakalyāṇa kalyāṇāyādivedhase
namaḥ paṅkajanetrāya namaḥ paṅkajanābhaye / namaḥ paṅkajasaṃbhūtisaṃbhavāyātmayonaye
śriyaḥ kāntāya dāntāya dāntadṛśyāya cakriṇe / namaḥ padmāsihastāya namaḥ kanakaretase
tathātmajñānayajñāya yogicintyāya yogine / nirguṇāya viśeṣāya haraye brahmarūpiṇe
jagacca tiṣṭhate yatra jagato yo na dṛsyate / namaḥ sthūlātisūkṣmāya tasmai devāya śārṅiḍṇe
yaṃ na paśyanti paśyanto jagadapyakhilaṃ narāḥ / apaśyadbhirjagadyaśca dṛśyate hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ
bahirjyoti ralakṣyo yo lakṣyate jyotiṣaḥ paraḥ / yasminneva yataścaiva yasyaitadakhilaṃ jagat
tasmai samastajagatām amarāya namo namaḥ / ādyaḥ prajāpatiḥ so 'pi pitṝṇāṃ paramaḥ patiḥ / patiḥ surāṇāṃ yastasmai namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase
yaḥ pravṛttairnivṛttaiśca karmastasmai virajyate / svargāpavargaphalado namastasmai gadābhṛte
yastu saṃcityamāno 'pi sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati / namastasmai viśuddhāya parasmai harimedhase
ye paśyantyakhilādhāramīśānamajamavyayam / na punarjanmamaraṇaṃ prāpnuvanti namāmi tam
yo yajño yajñaparamairijyate yajñasaṃsthitaḥ / taṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ namāmi prabhumīśvaram
gīyate sarvavedeṣu vedavidbhirvidāṃ gatiḥ / yastasmai vedavedyāya nityāya viṣṇave namaḥ
yato viśvaṃ samudbhūtaṃ yasmin pralayameṣyati / viśvodbhavapratiṣṭhāya namastasmai mahātmane
ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram / māyājālasamunnaddhaṃ tamupendraṃ namāmyaham
yo 'tra toyasvarūpastho bibhartyakhilamīśvaraḥ / viśvaṃ viśvapatiṃ viṣṇuṃ taṃ namāmi prajāpatim
mūrta tamo 'suramayaṃ tadvidho vinihanti yaḥ / rātrijaṃ sūryarūpī ca tamupendraṃ namāmyaham
yasyākṣiṇi candrasūryau sarvalokaśubhāśubham / paśyataḥ karma satataṃ tamupendraṃ namāmyaham
yasmin sarveśvare sarvaṃ satyametanmayoditam / nānṛtaṃ tamajaṃ viṣṇuṃ namāmi prabhavāvyayam
yadyetatsatyamuktaṃ me bhūyaścāto janārdana / satyena tena sakalāḥ pūryantāṃ me manorathāḥ
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / evaṃ stuto 'tha bhagavān vāsudeva uvāca tām / adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāḥ saṃdarśane sthitaḥ
śrībhagavānuvāca manorathāṃstvamadite yānicchasyabhivāñchitān / tāṃstvaṃ prāpyasi dharmajñe matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ
śṛṇu tvaṃ ca mahābhāge varo yaste hṛti sthitaḥ / maddarśanaṃ hi viphalaṃ na kadācid bhaviṣyati
yaśceha tvadvane sthitvā trirātraṃ vai kariṣyati / sarve kāmāḥ samṛdhyante manasā yānihecchati
dūrastho 'pi vanaṃ yastu adityāḥ smarate naraḥ / so 'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ kiṃ punarnivasan naraḥ
yaśceha brāhmaṇān pañca trīn vā dvāvekameva vā / bhojayecchraddhayā yuktāḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
aditiruvāca yadi deva prasannastvaṃ bhaktyā me bhaktavatsala / trailokyādhipatiḥ putrastadastu mama vāsavaḥ
hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ hṛtaścāsya yajñabhāga ihāsuraiḥ / tvayi prasanne parada tat prāpnotu suto mama
hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ na duḥkhāya mama putrasya keśava / prapannadāyavibhraṃśo bādhāṃ me kurute hṛti
śrībhagavānuvāca kṛtaḥ prasādo hi mayā tava devi yathepsitam / svāṃśena caiva te garbhe saṃbhaviṣyāmi kaśyapāt
tava garbhe samudbhūtastataste ye tvarātayaḥ / tānahaṃ ca haniṣyāmi nivṛttā bhava nandini
aditiruvāca prasīda devadeveśa namaste viśvabhāvana / nāhaṃ tvāmudare voḍhumīśa śakṣyāmi keśava / yasmin pratiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ viśvayonistvamīśvaraḥ
ahaṃ tvāṃ ca vahiṣyāmi ātmānaṃ caiva nandini / na ca pīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi svasti te 'stu vrajāmyaham
ityuktvāntarhite deve 'ditirgarbhaṃ samādadhe / garbhasthite tataḥ khṛṣṇe cacāla saralā kṣitiḥ / cakampire mahāśailā jagmuḥ kṣobhaṃ mahābdhayaḥ
yato yato 'ditiryāti dadāti padamuttamam / tatastataḥ kṣitiḥ khedānnanāma dvijapuṅgavāḥ
daityānāmapi sarveṣāṃ garbhasthe madhusūdane / babhūva tejaso hāniryathoktaṃ parameṣṭhinā
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye sapmo 'dhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / nisteso 'surān dṛṣṭavā samastānasureśvaraḥ / prahlādamatha papraccha balirātmapitāmaham
baliruvāca tāta nistejaso daityā nirdagdhā iva vahninā / kimete sahasaivādya brahmadaṇḍahatā iva
duriṣṭaṃ kiṃ tu daityānāṃ ki kṛtyā vidhinirmitā / nāśāyaiṣāṃ samudbhutā yena nistejaso 'surāḥ
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca ityasuravarastena pṛṣṭaḥ pautreṇa brāhmaṇāḥ / ciraṃ dhyātvā jagādedamasuraṃ taṃ tadā balim
prahlāda uvāca calanti girayo bhīmirjahāti sahasā dhatim / sadyaḥ samudrāḥ kṣubhitā daityā nistejasaḥ kṛtāḥ
sūryodaye yathā pūrvaṃ tathā gacchanti na grahāḥ / devānāṃ ca parā lakṣmīḥ karaṇenānumīyate
mahadetanmahābāho kāraṇaṃ dānaveśvara / na hyalpamiti mantavyaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ kathañcana
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca ityuktvā dānavapatiṃ prahlādaḥ so 'surottamaḥ / atyarthabhakto deveśaṃ jagāma manasā harim
sa dhyānapathagaṃ kṛtvā prahlādaśca mano 'suraḥ / vicārayāmāsa tato yathā devo janārdanaḥ
sa dadarśodare 'dityāḥ prahlādo vāmanākṛtim / tadantaśca vasūn rudrānaśvinau sarutāstathā
sādhyān viśve tathādityān gandharvoragarākṣasān / virocanaṃ ca tanayaṃ baliṃ cāsuranāyakam
jambhaṃ kujambhaṃ narakaṃ bāṇamanyāṃstathāsurān / ātmānamurvīṃ gaganaṃ vāyuṃ vāri hutāśanam
samudrādrisariddvīpān sarāṃsi ca paśūn mahīm / vayomanuṣyānakhilāṃstathaiva ca sarīsṛpān
samastalokasraṣṭāraṃ brahmaṇaṃ bhavameva ca / grahanakṣatratārāśca dakṣādyāṃśca prajāpatīn
saṃpaśyan vismayāviṣṭaḥ prakṛtisthaḥ kṣaṇāt punaḥ / prahlādaḥ prāha daityendraṃ baliṃ vairociniṃ tataḥ
tatsaṃjñātaṃ mayā sarvaṃ yadarthaṃ bhavatāmiyam / tejaso hānirutpannā śṛṇvantu tadaśeṣataḥ
devadevo jagadyonirayonirjagadādijaḥ / anādirādirviśvasya vareṇyo varado hariḥ
parāvarāṇāṃ paramaḥ parāparasatāṃ gatiḥ / prabhuḥ pramāṇaṃ mānānāṃ saptalokagurorguruḥ / sthitiṃ kartu jagannāthaḥ so 'cintyo garbhatāṃ gataḥ
prabhuḥ prabhūṇāṃ paramaḥ parāṇāmanādimadhyo bhagavānanantaḥ / trailokyamaṃśena sanāthamekaḥ kartu mahātmāditijo 'vatīrmaḥ
na yasya rudro na ca padmayonirnendro na sūryendumarīcimiśrāḥ / jānanti daityādhipa yatsvarūpaṃ sa vāsudevaḥ kalayāvatīrṇaḥ
yamakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti viśanti yaṃ jñānavidhūtapāpāḥ / yasmin praviṣṭā na purarbhavanti taṃ vāsudevaṃ praṇamāmi devam
bhṛtānyaśeṣāṇi yato bhavanti yathormayastoyandherajasram / layaṃ ca yasmin pralaye prayānti taṃ vāsudevaṃ praṇato 'smyacintyam
na yasya rūpaṃ na balaṃ prabhāvo na ca pratāpaḥ paramasya puṃsaḥ / vijñāyate sarvapitāmahādyaistaṃ vāsudevaṃ praṇamāmi nityam
rūpasya cakṣurgrahaṇe tvageṣā sparśagrahitrī rasanā rasasya / ghrāṇaṃ ca gandhagrahaṇe niyuktaṃ na ghrāṇacakṣuḥ śravaṇādi tasya
svayaṃprakāśaḥ paramārthato yaḥ sarveśvaro veditavyaḥ sa yuktyā / śakyaṃ tamīḍyamanaghaṃ ca devaṃ grāhyaṃ nato 'haṃ harimīśitāram
yenaikadaṃṣṭreṇa samuddhṛteyaṃ dharācalā dhārayatīha sarvam / śete grasitvā sakalaṃ jagad yastamīḍyamīśaṃ praṇato 'smi viṣṇum
aṃśāvatīrṇena ca yena garbhe hṛtāni tejāṃsi mahāsurāṇām / namāmi taṃ devamanantamīśamaśeṣasaṃsārataroḥ kuṭhāram
devo jagadyonirayaṃ mahātmā sa ṣoḍśāṃśena mahāsurendrāḥ / surendramāturjaṭharaṃ praviṣṭo hṛtāni vastena balaṃ vapūṃṣi
baliruvāca tāta ko 'yaṃ harirnāma yato no bhayamāgatam / santi me śataśo daityā vāsudevabalādhikāḥ
vipracittiḥ śibiḥ śaṅkurayaḥ śaṅkustathaiva ca / hayaśirā aśvaśirā bhaṅgakāro mahāhanuḥ
pratāpī praghaśaḥ śaṃbhuḥ kukkurākṣaśca durjayaḥ / ete cānye ca me santi daiteyā dānavāstathā
mahābalā mahāvīryā bhūbhāradharaṇakṣamāḥ / eṣāmekaikaśaḥ kṛṣṇo na vīryārddhena saṃmitaḥ
lomaharṣama uvāca pautrasyaitad vacaḥ śrutvā prahlādo daityasattamaḥ / sakrodhaśca baliṃ prāha vaikuṇṭhākṣepavādinam
vināśamupayāsyanti daityā ye cāpi dānavāḥ / yeṣāṃ tvamīdṛśo rājā durbuddhiravivekavān
devadevaṃ mahābhāgaṃ vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum / tvāmṛte pāpasaṅkalpa ko 'nya evaṃ vadiṣyati
