ya ete bhavatā proktāḥ samastā daityadānavāḥ / sabrahmakāstathā devāḥ sthāvarāntā vibhūtayaḥ
tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca jagaccedaṃ sādridrumanadīvanam / sasamudradvīpaloko 'yaṃ yaścedaṃ sacarācaram
yasyābhivādyavandyasya vyāpinaḥ paramātmanaḥ / ekāṃśāṃśakalājanma kastamevaṃ pravakṣyati
ṛte vināśābimukhaṃ tvāmekamavivekinam / durbuddhimajitātmānaṃ vṛddhānaṃ śāsanātigam
śocyo 'haṃ yasya me gehe jātastava pitādhamaḥ / yasya tvamīdṛśaḥ putro devadevāvamānakaḥ
tiṣṭhatvanekasaṃsārasaṃghātaughavināśini / kṛṣṇe bhaktirahaṃ tāvadavekṣyo bhavatā na kim
na me priyataraḥ kṛṣṇādapi deho 'yamātmanaḥ / iti jānātyayaṃ loko bhavāṃśca ditinandana
jānannapi priyataraṃ prāṇebhyo 'pi hariṃ mama / nindāṃ karoṣi tasya tvamakurvan gauravaṃ mama
virocanastava gururgurustayāpyahaṃ bale / mamāpi sarvajagatāṃ gururnārāyaṇo hariḥ
nindāṃ karoṣi tasmistvaṃ kṛṣṇe gurugurorgurau / yasmāt tasmādihaiva tvam aiśvaryād bhrāṃśameṣyasi
sa devo jagatāṃ nātho bale prabhurjanārdanaḥ / nanvahaṃ pratyavekṣyaste bhaktimānatra me guruḥ
etāvanmātramapyatra nindatā jagato gurum / nāpekṣitastvayā yasmāt tasmācchāpaṃ dadāmi te
yathā me śirasaśchedādidaṃ gurutaraṃ bale / tvayoktamacyutākṣepaṃ rājyabhraṣṭastathā pata
yathā na kṛṣṇādaparaḥ paritrāṇaṃ bhavārṇave / tathācireṇa paśyeyaṃ bhavantaṃ rājyavicyutam
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / iti daityapatiḥ śrutvā vacanaṃ raudramapriyam / prasādayāmāsa guruṃ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ
baliruvāca prasīda tāta mā kopaṃ kuru mohahate mayi / balāvalepamūḍhena mayaitadvākyamīritam
mohāpahatavijñānaḥ papo 'haṃ ditijottama / yacchapto 'smi durācārastatsādhu bhavatā kṛtam
rājyabhraṃśaṃ yaśobhraṃśaṃ prapsyāmīti tatastvaham / viṣaṇṇo 'si yathā tāta tathaivāvinaye kṛte
trailokyarājyamaiśvaryamanyadvā nātidurlabham / sasāre durlabhāstāta guravo ye bhavadvidhāḥ
prasīda tāta mā kopaṃ kartumarhasi daityapa / tvatkopaparidagdho 'haṃ paritapye divāniśam
prahlāda uvāca vatsa kopena me moho janitastena te mayā / śāpo datto vivekaśca mohenāpahṛto mama
yadi mohena me jñānaṃ nākṣiptaṃ syānmahāsura / tatkathaṃ sarvagaṃ jānan hariṃ kaccicchapāmyaham
yo yaḥ śāpo mayā datto bhavato 'surapuṅgava / bhāvyametena nūnaṃ te tasmāttvaṃ mā viṣīda vai
adyaprabhṛti deveśe bhagavatyacyute harau / bhavethā bhaktimānīśe sa te trātā bhaviṣyati
śāpaṃ prāpya ca me vīra deveśaḥ saṃsmṛtastvayā / tathā tathā vadiṣyāmi śreyastvaṃ prāpsyase yathā
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca aditirvaramāsādya sarvakāmasamṛddhidam / krameṇa hyudare devo vṛddhiṃ prāpto mahāyaśāḥ
tato māse 'tha daśame kāle prasava āgate / ajāyata sa govindo bhagavān vāmanākṛtiḥ
avatīrṇe jagannāthe tasmin sarvāmareśvare / devāśca mumucurduḥkhaṃ devamātāditistathā
vavurvātāḥ sukhaspārśā nīrajaskamabhūnnabhaḥ / dharme ca sarvabhūtānāṃ tadā matirajāyata
nodvegaścāpyabhūd dehe manujānāṃ dvijottamāḥ / tadā hi sarvabhūtānāṃ dharme matirajāyata
taṃ jātamātraṃ bhagavān brahma lokapitāmahaḥ / jātakarmādikāṃ kṛtvā kriyāṃ tuṣṭāva ca prabhum
brahmovāca jayādhīśa jayājeya jaya viśvaguro hare / janmamṛtyujarātīta jayānanta jayācyuta
jayājita jayāśeṣa jayāvyaktasthite jaya / paramārthārtha sarvajña jñānajñeyārthaniḥsṛta
jayāśeṣa jagatsākṣiñjagatkartarjagadguro / jagato 'jagadanteśa sthitau pālayate jaya
jayākhila jayāśeṣa jaya sarvahṛdisthita / jayādimadhyāntamaya sarvajñānamayottama
mumukṣubhiranirdeśya nityahṛṣṭa jayeśvara / yogibhirmuktikāmaistu damādighuṇabhūṣaṇa
jayātisūkṣma durjñeya jaya sthūla jaganmaya / jaya sūkṣmātisūkṣma tvaṃ jayānindriya sendriya
jaya svamāyāyogastha śeṣabhoga jayākṣara / jayaikadaṃṣṭraprāntena samuddhṛtavasuṃdhara
nṛkesarin surārātivakṣasthalavidāraṇa / sāmprataṃ jaya viśvātman māyāvāmana keśava
nijamāyāparicchinna jagaddhātarjanārdana / jayācintya jayānekāsvarūpaikavidha prabho
varddhasva vardhitānekavikāraprakṛte hare / tvayyeṣā jagatāmīśe saṃsthitā dharmapaddhatiḥ
na tvāmahaṃ na ceśāno nendrādyāstridaśā hare / jñātumīśā na munayaḥ sanakādyā na yoginaḥ
tvaṃ māyāpaṭasaṃvīto jagatyatra jagatpate / kastvāṃ vetsyati sarveśa tvatprasādaṃ vinā naraḥ
tvamevārādhito yasya prasādasumukhaḥ prabho / sa eva kevalaṃ devaṃ vetti tvāṃ netaro naja
tadīśvareśvareśāna vibho varddhasva bhāvana / prabhavāyāsya viśvasya viśvātman pṛthulocana
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca elaṃ stuto hṛṣīkeśaḥ sa tadā vāmanākṛtiḥ / prahasya bhāvagambhīramuvācārūḍhasaṃpadam
stuto 'haṃ bhavatā pūrvamindrādyaiḥ kaśyapena ca / mayā ca vaḥ pratijñātamindrasya bhuvanatrayam
bhṛyaścahaṃ stuto 'dityā tasyāścāpi mayāśrutam / yathā śakrāya dāsyāmi trailokyaṃ hatakaṇṭakam
so 'haṃ tathā kariṣyāmi yathendro jagataḥ patiḥ / bhaviṣyati sahasrākṣaḥ satyametad bravīmi vaḥ
tataḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ brahma hṛṣīkeśāya dattavān / yajñopavītaṃ bhagavān dadau tasya bṛhaspatiḥ
āṣāḍhamadadād daṇḍaṃ marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ / kamaṇḍaluṃ vasiṣṭhaśca kauśaṃ cīramathāṅgirāḥ / āsanaṃ caiva pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ pītavāsasī
upatasthuśca taṃ vedāḥ praṇavasvarabhūṣaṇāḥ / śāstrāṇyaśeṣāṇi tathā sāṃkhyayogoktayaśca yāḥ
sa vāmano jaṭī daṇḍī chatrī dhṛtakamaṇḍaluḥ / sarvadevamayo devo baleradhvaramabhyagāt
yatra yatra padaṃ viprā bhūbhāge vāmano dadau / dadāti bhūmirvivaraṃ tatra tatrābhipīḍitā
sa vāmano jaḍagatirmṛdu gacchan saparvatām / sābdhidvīpavatīṃ sarvāṃ cālayāmāsa bhedinīm
bṛhaspatistu śanakairmārgaṃ darśayate śubham / tathā krīḍāvinodārthamatijāḍyagato 'bhavat
tataḥ śeṣo mahānāgo niḥsṛtyāsau rasātalāt / sāhāyyaṃ kalpayāmāsa devadevasya cakriṇaḥ
tadadyāpi ca vikhyātamahervilamanuttamam / tasya saṃdarśanādeva nāgebhyo na bhayaṃ bhavet
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye navamo 'dhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / saparvatavanāmurvīṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃkṣubhitāṃ baliḥ / papracchośanasaṃ śukraṃ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ
ācārya kṣobhamāyāti sābdhibhūmidharā mahī / kasmācca nāsurān bhāgān pratigṛhṇanti vahnayaḥ
iti pṛṣṭo 'tha balinā kāvyo vedavidāṃ varaḥ / uvāca daityādhipatiṃ ciraṃ dhyātvā mahāmatiḥ
avatīrṇo jagadyoniḥ kaśyapasya gṛhe hariḥ / vāmaneneha rūpeṇa paramātmā sanātanaḥ
sa nūnaṃ yajñamāyāti tava dānavapuṅgava / tatpādanyāsavikṣobhādiyaṃ pracalitā mahī
kampante girayaśceme kṣubhitā makarālayāḥ / neyaṃ bhūtapatiṃ bhūmiḥ samarthā voḍhumīśvaram
sadevāsuragandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagā / anenaiva dhṛtā bhūmirāpo 'gniḥ pavano nabhaḥ / dhārayatyakhilān devān manuṣyāṃśca mahāsurān
iyamasya jagaddhāturmāyā kṛṣṇasya gahvarī / dhāryadhārakabhāvena yayā saṃpīḍitaṃ jagat
tatsannidhānādasurā na bhāgārhāḥ suradviṣaḥ / bhuñjate nāsurān bhāgānapi tena trayo 'gnayaḥ
śukrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā hṛṣṭaromābravīd baliḥ / dhanyo 'haṃ kṛtapuṇyaśca yanme yajñapatiḥ svayam / yajñamabhyāgato brahman mattaḥ ko 'nyo 'dhikaḥ pumān
yaṃ yoginaḥ sadodyuktāḥ paramātmānamavyayam / draṣṭumicchanti devo 'sau mamādhvaramupeṣyati / yanmayācārya kartavyaṃ tanmamādeṣṭumarhasi
śukra uvāca yajñabhāgabhujo devā vedaprāmāṇyato 'sura / tvayā tu dānavā daitya yajñabhāgabhujaḥ kṛtāḥ
ayaṃ ca devaḥ sattvasthaḥ karoti sthitipālanam / visṛṣṭaṃ ca tathāyaṃ ca svayamatti prajāḥ prabhuḥ
bhavāṃstu vandī bhavitā nūnaṃ viṣṇuḥ sthitau sthitaḥ / viditvaivaṃ mahābhāgā kuru yat te manogatam
tvayāsya daityādhipate kvalpake 'pi hi vastuni / pratijñā naiva voḍhavyā vācyaṃ sāma tathāphalam
kṛtakṛtyasya devasya devārthaṃ caiva kurvataḥ / alaṃ dadyāṃ dhanaṃ deve tvetadvācyaṃ tu yācataḥ / kṛṣṇasya devabhūtyartha pravṛttasya mahāsura
baliruvāca brahman kathamahaṃ brūyāmanyenāpi hi yācitaḥ / nāstīti kimu devasya saṃsākasyāghahāriṇaḥ
vratopavāsairvividhair yaḥ prabhurgṛhyate hariḥ / sa me vakṣyati dehīti govindaḥkimato 'dhikam
yadarthaṃ sumahārambhā damaśaucaguṇānvitaiḥ / yajñā kriyante yajñeśaḥ sa me dehīti vakṣyati
tatsādhu sukṛtaṃ karma tapaḥ sucaritaṃ canaḥ / yanmā dehīti viśveśaḥ svayameva vadiṣyati
nāstītyahaṃ guro vakṣye tamabhyāgatamīśvaram / prāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣye 'haṃ na tu nāsti jane kvacit
nāstīti yanmayā noktamanyeṣāmapi yācatām / vakṣyāmi kathamāyāte tadadya cāmare 'cyute
ślāghya eva hi vīrāṇāṃ dānāccāpatsamāgamaḥ / na bādhākāri yaddānaṃ tadaṅgaṃ balavat smṛtam
madrājye nāsukhī kaścinna daridro na cāturaḥ / na duḥkhito na cobdigno na śamādivivarjitaḥ
hṛṣṭastuṣṭaḥ sugandhī ca tṛptaḥ sarvasukhānvitaḥ / janaḥ sarvo mahābhāga kimutāhaṃ sadā sukhī
etadviśiṣṭamatrāhaṃ dānabījaphalaṃ labhe / viditaṃ muniśārdula mayaitat tvanmukhācchrutam
matprasādaparo nūnaṃ yajñenārādhito hiraḥ / mama dānamavāpyāsau puṣṇāti yadi devatāḥ
etadbījavare dānabījaṃ patati ced gurau / janārdane mahāpātre kiṃ na prāptaṃ tato mayā
viśiṣṭaṃ mama taddānaṃ parituṣṭāśca devatāḥ / uvabhogācchataguṇaṃ dānaṃ sukhakaraṃ smṛtam
matprasādaparo nūnaṃ jajñenārādhito hariḥ / tenābhyeti na saṃdeho darśanādupakārakṛt
atha kopena cābhyeti devabhāgoparodhataḥ / māṃ nihantuṃ tato hi syād vadhaḥ ślāghyataro 'cyutāt
etajjñātvā muniśreṣṭha dānavighnākareṇa me / naiva bhāvyaṃ jagannāthe govinde samupasthite
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca ityevaṃ vadatastasya prāptastatra janārdanaḥ / sarvadevamayo 'tintyo māyāvāmanarūpadhṛk
taṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñavāṭaṃ tu praviṣṭamasurāḥ prabhum / jagmuḥ prabhāvataḥ kṣobhaṃ tejasā tasya niṣprabhāḥ
jeṣuśca munayastatra ye sametā mahādhvare / vasiṣṭho gādhijo gargo anye ca munisattamāḥ
baliścaivākhilaṃ janma mene śaphalamātmanaḥ / tataḥ saṃkṣobhamāpanno na kaścit kiñciduktavān
pratyekaṃ devadeveśaṃ pūjayāmāsa tejasā / athāsurapati prahvaṃ dṛṣṭvā munivarāśca tān
devadevapatiḥ sākṣād viṣṇurvāmanarūpadhṛk / tuṣṭāva yajñaṃ vahniṃ ca yajamānamathārcitaḥ / yajñakarmādhikārasthān sadasyān dravyasaṃpadam
sadasyāḥ pātramakhilaṃ vāmanaṃ prati tatkṣaṇāt / yajñavāṭasthitaṃ viprāḥ sādhu sādhvityudīrayan
sa cārghamādāya baliḥ prodbhūtapulakastadā / pūjayāmāsa govindaṃ prāha cedaṃ mahāsuraḥ
baliruvāca suvarṇaratnasaṃghāto gajāśvasamitistathā / striyo vastrāṇyalaṅkārān gāvo grāmāśca puṣkalāḥ
sarve ca saralā pṛthvī bhavato vā yadīpsitam / tad dadāsi vṛṇuṣveṣṭaṃ mamārthāḥ santi te priyāḥ
ityukto daityapatinā prītigarbhānvitaṃ vacaḥ / prāha sasmitagambhīraṃ bhagavān vāmanākṛtiḥ
mamāgniśaraṇārthāya dehi rājan padatrayam / suvarṇagrāmaratnādi tadarthibhyaḥ pradīyatām
baliruvāca tribhiḥ prayojanaṃ kiṃ te padaiḥ padavatāṃ vara / śataṃ śatasahasraṃ vā padānāṃ mārgatāṃ bhavān
śrīvāmana uvāca etāvatā daityapate kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mārgaṇe / anyeṣāmarthināṃ vittamicchayā dāsyate bhavān
etacchrutvā tu gaditaṃ vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ / vācayāmāsa vai tasmai vāmanāya mahātmane
pāṇau tu patite toye vāmano 'bhūdavāmanaḥ / sarvedevamayaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt
cantrasūryau tu nayane dyauḥ śiraścaraṇau kṣitiḥ / pādāṅgulyaḥ piśācāstu hastāṅgulyaśca guhyakāḥ
viśvedevāśca jānusthā jaṅghe sādhyāḥ surottamāḥ / yakṣā nakheṣu saṃbhūtā rekhāsvapsarasastathā
dṛṣṭirṛkṣāṇyaśeṣāṇi keśāḥ sūryāśavaḥ prabhoḥ / tārakā romakūpāṇi romeṣu ca maharṣayaḥ
bāhavo vidiśastasya diśaḥ śrotre mahātmanaḥ / aśvinau śravaṇe tasya nāsā vāyurmahātmanaḥ
prasāde candramā devo mano dharmaḥ samāśritaḥ / satyamasyābhavad vāṇī jihvā devī sarasvatī
grīvāditirdevamātā vidyāstadvalayastathā / svargadvāramabhūnmaitraṃ tvaṣṭā pūṣā ca vai bhruvau
mukhe vaiśvānaraścāsya vṛṣaṇau tu prajāpatiḥ / hṛdayaṃ ca paraṃ brahma puṃstvaṃ vai kaśyapo muniḥ
pṛṣṭhe 'sya vasavo devā marutaḥ sarvasaṃdhiṣu / vakṣasthale tathā rudro dhairye cāsya mahārṇavaḥ
udare cāsya gandharvā marutaśca mahābalāḥ / lakṣmīrmedhā dhṛtiḥ kāntiḥ sarvavidyāśca vai kaṭiḥ
sarvajyotīṃṣi yānīha tapaśca paramaṃ mahat / tasya devādhidevasya tejaḥ prodbhūtamuttamam
tanau kukṣiṣu vedāśca jānunī ca mahāmakhāḥ / iṣṭayaḥ paśavaścāsya dvijānāṃ ceṣṭitāni ca
tasya devamayaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇormahātmanaḥ / upasarpanti te daityāḥ pataṅgā iva pāvakam
cikṣurastu mahādaityaḥ pādāṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhītavān / dantābhyāṃ tasya vai grīvāmaṅguṣṭhenāhanaddhariḥ
pramathya sarvānasurān pādahastatalairvibhuḥ / kṛtvā rūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ saṃjahārāśu medinīm
tasya vikramato bhūmiṃ candrādityau stanāntare / nabho vikramamāṇasya sakthideśe sthitāvubhau
paraṃ vikramamāṇasya jānumūle prabhākarau / viṣṇorāstāṃ sthitasyaitau devapālanakarmaṇi
jitvā lokatrayaṃ tāṃśca hatvā cāsurapuṅgavān / purandarāya trailokyaṃ dadau viṣṇururukramaḥ
sutalaṃ nāma pātālamadhastādvasudhātalāt / balerdattaṃ bhagavatā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā
atha daityaiśvaraṃ prāha viṣṇuḥ sarveśvareśvaraḥ / yat tvayā salilaṃ dattaṃ gṛhītaṃ pāṇinā mayā
kalpapramāṇaṃ tasmāt te bhaviṣyatyāyuruttamam / vaivakhate tathātīte kāle manvantare tathā
sāvarṇike tu saṃprāpte bhavānindro bhaviṣyati / idānīṃ bhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ dattaṃ śakrāya vai purā
caturyugavyavasthā ca sādhikā hyekasaptatiḥ / niyantavyā mayā sarve ye tasya paripanthinaḥ
tenāhaṃ parayā bhaktyā pūrvamārādhito bale / sutalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ samāsādya vaco mama
vasāsura mamādeśaṃ yathāvatparipālayan / tatra devasukhopete prāsādaśatasaṃkule
protphullapadmasarasi hvadasuddhasaridvare / sugandhī pūpasaṃpanno varābharamabhūṣitaḥ
srakcandanādidigdhāṅgo nṛtyagītamanoharān / upabhuñjan mahābhogān vividhān dānaveśvara
mamājñayā kālamimaṃ tiṣṭha strīśatasaṃvṛtaḥ / yāvatsuraiśca vipraiśca na virodhaṃ gamiṣyasi
tāvat tvaṃ bhuṅkṣva saṃbhogān sarvakāmasamanvitān / yadā suraiśca vipraiśca virodhaṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi / bandhiṣyanti tadā pāsā vāruṇā ghoradarśanāḥ
baliruvāca tatrāsato me pātāle bhagavan bhavadājñayā / kiṃ bhaviṣyatyupādānamupabhogopapādakam / āpyāyito yena deva smareyaṃ tvāmahaṃ sadā
śrībhagavānuvāca dānānyavidhidattāni śrāddhānyaśrotriyāṇi ca / hutānyaśraddhayā yāni tāni dāsyanti te phalam
adakṣiṇāstathā yajñāḥ kriyāścāvidhinā kṛtāḥ / phalāni tava dāsyanti adhītānyavratāni ca
udakena vinā pūjā vinā darbeṇa yā kriyā / ājyena ca vinā homaṃ phalaṃ dāsyanti te bale
yaścedaṃ sthānamāśritya kriyāḥ kāścitkariṣyati / na tatra cāsuro bhāgo bhaviṣyati kadācana
jyeṣṭhāśrame mahāpuṇye tathā viṣṇupade hvade / ye ca śrāddhāni dāsyanti vrataṃ niyamameva ca
kriyā kṛtā ca yā kācid vidhināvidhināpi vā / sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe ekādasyāmupoṣitaḥ / dvādaśyāṃ vāmanaṃ dṛṣṭvā snātvā viṣṇupade hvade / dānaṃ dattvā yathāśaktyā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca balervaramimaṃ dattvā śakrāya ca triviṣṭapam / vyāpinā tena rūpeṇa jagāmādarśanaṃ hariḥ
śaśāsa ca yathāpūrvaṃmindrastrailokyamūrjitaḥ / niḥśeṣaṃ ca tadā kālaṃ baliḥ pātālamāsthitaḥ
ityetat kathitaṃ tasya viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam / vāmanasya śṛṇvan yastu sarvapāṣaiḥ pramucyate
baliprahlādasaṃvādaṃ mantritaṃ baliśukrayoḥ / balerviṣṇośca caritaṃ ye smariṣyanti mānavāḥ
nādhayo vyādhayasteṣāṃ na ca mohākulaṃ manaḥ / bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ puṃsastasya kadācana
cyutarājyo nijaṃ rājyamiṣṭaprāptiṃ viyogavān / samāpneti mahābhāgā naraḥ śrutvā kathāmimām
brāhmaṇo vedamāpnoti kṣatriyo jayate mahīm / vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhiṃ ca śūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt / vāmanasya ca māhatmyaṃ śṛṇvan pāpaiḥ pramucyate
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathameṣā samutpannā nadīnāmuttamā nadī / sakakhatī mahābhāgā kurukṣetrapravāhinā
kathaṃ saraḥ samāsādya kṛtvā tīrthāni pārśvataḥ / prayātā paścimāmāśāṃ dṛśyāhṛśyagatiḥ śubhā / etad vistarato brūhi tīrthaṃvaṃśaṃ sanātanam
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca plakṣavṛkṣāt samudbhūtā saricchreṣṭhā sanātanī / sarvapāpakṣayakarī smaraṇādeva nityaśaḥ
saiṣā śailasahasrāṇi vidārya ca mahānadī / praviṣṭā puṇyatoyaughā vanaṃ dvaitamiti smṛtam
tasmin palkṣe sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ / praṇipatya tadā mūrdhnā tuṣṭāvātha sarasvatīm
tvaṃ devi sarvalokānāṃ mātā devāraṇiḥ śubhā / sadasad devi yatkiñcinmokṣadāyyarthavat padam
tat sarvaṃ tvayi saṃyogi yogivad devi saṃsthitam / akṣaraṃ paramaṃ devī yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam / akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma viśvaṃ caitat kṣarātmakam
dāruṇyavasthito vahnirbhṛmau gandho yathā dhruvam / tathā tvayi sthitaṃ brahma jagaccedamaśeṣataḥ
oṅkārākṣarasaṃsthānaṃ yat tad devi sthirāsthiram / tatra mātrātrayaṃ sarvamasti yad devi nāsti ca
trayo lokāstrayo vedāstraividyaṃ pāvakatrayam / trīṇi jyotīṃṣi vargāśca trayo dharmādayastathā
trayo guṇāstrayo varṇāstrayo devāstathā kramāt / traidhātavastathāvasthāḥ pitaraścaivamādayaḥ
etanmātrātrayaṃ devi tava rūpaṃ sarasvati / vibhinnadarśanāmādyāṃ brahmaṇo hi sanātanīm
somasaṃsthā haviḥsaṃsthā pākasaṃsthā sanātanī / tāstvaduccāraṇād devi kriyante brahmavādibhiḥ
anirdeśyapadaṃ tvetadarddhamātrāśritaṃ param / avikāryakṣayaṃ divyaṃ pariṇāmavivarjitam
tavaitat paramaṃ rūpaṃ yanna śakyaṃ mayoditum / na cāsyena na vā jihvātālvoṣṭhādibhirucyate
sa viṣṇuḥ sa vṛṣo brahma candrākrajyotireva ca / viśvāvāsaṃ viśvarūpaṃ viśvātmānamanīśvaram
sāṅkhyasiddhāntavedoktaṃ bahuśākhāsthirīkṛtam / anādimadhyanidhanaṃ sadasacca sadeva tu
ekaṃ tvanekadhāpyekabhāvavedasamāśritam / anākhyaṃ ṣaḍguṇākhyaṃ ca bahvākhyaṃ triguṇāśrayam
nānāśaktivibhāvajñaṃ nānāśaktivibhāvakam / sukhāt sukhaṃ mahātsaukhyaṃ rūpaṃ tattvaguṇātmakam
evaṃ devi tvayā vyāptaṃ sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ ca yat / advaitāvasthitaṃ brahma yacca dvaite vyavasthitam
ye'rthā nityā ye vinaśyanti cānye ye'rthāḥ sthūlā ye tathā santi sūkṣmāḥ / ye vā bhūmau ye 'ntarikṣenyato vā teṣāṃ devi tvatta evopalabdhiḥ
yadvā mūrtaṃ yadamūrtaṃ samastaṃ yadvā bhūteṣvekamekaṃ ca kiñcit / yacca dvaite vyastabhūtaṃ ca lakṣyaṃ tatsaṃbaddhaṃ tvatsvarairvyañjanaiśca
evaṃ stutā tadā devī viṣṇorjihvā sarasvatī / pratyuvāca mahātmānaṃ mārkaṇḍeya mahāsunim / yatra tvaṃ neṣyase vipra tatra yāsyāmyatandritā
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ādyaṃ brahmasaraḥ puṇyaṃ tato rāmahvadaḥ smṛtaḥ / kuruṇā ṛṣiṇā puṣṭaṃ kurukṣetraṃ tataḥ smṛtam / tasya madhyena vai gāḍhaṃ puṇyā puṇyajalāvahā
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / ityuṣervacanaṃ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyasya dhīmataḥ / nadī pravāhasaṃyuktā kurukṣetraṃ viveśa ha
tatra sā rantukaṃ prāpya puṇyatoyā sarasvatī / kurakṣetraṃ samāplāvya prayātā paścimāṃ diśam
tatra tīrthasahasrāṇi ṛṣibhiḥ sevitāni ca/ tānyahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi prasādāt parameṣṭhinaḥ
tīrthānāṃ smaraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanaṃ pāpanāśanam / snānaṃ muktikaraṃ proktamapi duṣṭṛtakarmaṇaḥ
ye smaranti ca tīrthāni devatāḥ prīṇayanti ca / snānti ca śraddadhānāśca te yānti paramāṃ gatim
apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato 'pi vā / yaḥ smaret kurukṣetraṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ
kurukṣatraṃ gamiṣyāmi kurukṣetre vasāmyaham / ityevaṃ vācamutsṛjya sarvapāṣaiḥ pramucyate
brahmajñānaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ gograhe maraṇaṃ tathā / vāsaḥ puṃsāṃ kurukṣetre muktiruktā caturvidhā
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyordevanadyoryadantaram / taṃ devanirmitaṃ deśaṃ brahmavartaṃ pracakṣate
dūrastho 'pi kurukṣetre gacchāmi ca vasāmyaham / evaṃ yaḥ satataṃ brūyāt so 'pi pāṣaiḥ pramucyate
tatra caiva saraḥsnāyī sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitaḥ / tasya jñānaṃ brahmamayamutpatsyati na saṃśayaḥ
devatā ṛṣayaḥ siddhāḥ sevante kurujāṅgalam / tasya saṃsevanānnityaṃ brahma cātmani paśyati
cañcalaṃ hi manuṣyatvaṃ prāpya ye mokṣakāṅkiṇaḥ / sevanti niyatātmāno api duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ
te vimuktāśca kaluṣairanekajanmasaṃbhavaiḥ / paśyanti nirmalaṃ devaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ sanātanam
brahmavediḥ kurukṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ sānnihitaṃ saraḥ
grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ kālena patanād bhayam / kurukṣetre mṛtānāṃ ca patanaṃ naiva vidyate
yatra brahmādayo devā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ / gandharvāpsaraso yakṣāḥ sevanti sthānakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
gatvā tu śraddhāyā yuktaḥ snātvā sthāṇumahāhvade / manasā cintitaṃ kāmaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
niyamaṃ ta tataḥ kṛtvā gatvā saraḥ pradakṣiṇam / rantukaṃ ca samāsādya kṣamayitvā punaḥ punaḥ
sarasvatyāṃ naraḥ snātvā yakṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamya ca / puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca naivaidyaṃ datvā vācamudīrayet
tava prasādād yakṣendra vānāni saritaśca yāḥ / bhramiṣyāmi ca tīrthāni avighneṃ kuru me sadā
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛśaya ūcuḥ vanāni sapta no brūhi nava nadyaśca yāḥ smṛtāḥ / tīrthāni ca samagrāṇi tīrthasnānaphalaṃ tathā
yena yena vidhānena yasya tīrthasya yat phalam / tat sarvaṃ vistateṇeha brūhi paurāṇikottama
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca/ śṛṇu sapta vanānīha kuruthetrasya madhyataḥ / yeṣāṃ nāmāni puṇyāni sarvapāpaharāṇi ca
kāmyakaṃ ca vanaṃ puṇyaṃ tathāditivanaṃ mahat / vyāsasya ca vanaṃ puṇyaṃ phalakīvanameva ca
tatra sūryavanasthānaṃ tathā madhuvanaṃ mahat / puṇyaṃ śītavanaṃ nāma sarvakalmaṣanāśanam
vanānyetāni vai sapta nadīḥ śṛṇuta me dvijāḥ / sarasvatī nadī puṇyā tathā vaitaraṇī nadī
āpagā ca mahāpuṇyā gaṅgā mandākinī nadī / madhusrāvā vāsunadī kauśikī pāpanāśinī
dṛṣadvatī mahāpuṇyā tathā hiraṇvatī nadī / varṣākālavahāḥ sarvā varjayitvā sarasvatīm
etāsāmudakaṃ puṇyaṃ prāvṛṭkāle prakīrtitam / rajasvalatvametāsāṃ vidyate na kadācana / tīrthasya ca prabhāveṇa puṇyā hyetāḥ saridvarāḥ
śṛṇvantu munayaḥ prītāstīrthasnānaphalaṃ sahat / gamanaṃ smaraṇaṃ caiva sarvakalmaṣanāśanam
rantukaṃ ca naro dṛṣṭvā dvārapālaṃ mahābalam / yakṣaṃ samabhivādyaiva tīrtayātrāṃ samācaret
tato gaccheta viprāndrā nāmnāditivanaṃ mahat / adityā yatra gutrārthaṃ kṛtaṃ ghoraṃ mahattapaḥ
tatra snātvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca aditiṃ devamātaram / putraṃ janayate śūraṃ sarvadoṣivivarjitam / ādityaśatasaṃkāśaṃ vimānaṃ cādhirohati
tato gaccheta viprendrā viṣṇoḥ sthānamanuttamam / savanaṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ yatra saṃnihito hariḥ
vimale ca naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca vimaleśvaram / nirmalaṃ svargamāyāti rudralokaṃ ca gacchati
hariṃ ca baladevaṃ ca ekatrāsasamanvitau / dṛṣṭvā mokṣamavāpnoti kalikalmaṣasaṃbhavaiḥ
tataḥ pāriplavaṃ gacchet tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / tatra snātvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca brahmāṇaṃ vedasaṃyutam
brahmavedaphalaṃ prāpya nirmalaṃ svargamāpnuyāt / tatrāpi saṃgamaṃ prāpya kauśikyāṃ tīrthasaṃbhavam / saṃgame ca naraḥ snātvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam
dharaṇyāstīrthamāsādya sarvapāpavimocanam / kṣāntiyukto naraḥ snātvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam
dharaṇyāmaparādhāni kṛtāni puruṣeṇa vai / sarvāṇi kṣamate tasya snātamātrasya dehinaḥ
tato dakṣāśramaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā dekṣeśvaraṃ śivam / aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
tataḥ śālūkinīṃ gatvā snātvā tīrthe dvijottamāḥ / hariṃ hareṇa saṃyuktaṃ pūjya bhaktisamanvitaḥ / prapnotyakṣimatāṃllokān sarvapāpavivarjitān
sarpirdadhi samāsādya nāgānāṃ tīrthamuttamam / tatra snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā mukto nāgabhayād bhavet
tato gaccheta viprendrā dvārapālaṃ tu rantukam / tatroṣya rajanīmekāṃ snātvā tīrthavare śubhe
dvitīyaṃ pūjayed yatra dvārapālaṃ prayatnataḥ / brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca praṇipatya kṣamāpayet
tava prasādād yakṣendra mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ / siddhirmayābhilaṣitā tayā sārddhaṃ bhavāmyaham / evaṃ prasādya yakṣendraṃ tataḥ pañcanadaṃ vrajet
pañcanadāśca rudreṇa kṛtā dānavabhīṣaṇāḥ / tatra sarveṣu lokeṣu tīrthaṃ pañcanadaṃ smṛtam
koṭitīrthāni rudreṇa samāhṛtya yataḥ sthitam / tena trailokyavikhyātaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ pracakṣate
tasmin tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā koṭīśvaraṃ haram / pañcayajñānavāpnoti nityaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ
tatraiva vāmano devaḥ sarvadevaiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ / tatrāpi ca naraḥ snātvā hyagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet
aśvinostīrthamāsādya śraddhāvān yo jitendriyaḥ / rūpasya bhāgī bhavati yaśasvī ca bhavennaraḥ
vārāhaṃ tīrthamākhyātaṃ viṣṇunā parikīrtitam / tasmin snātvā śraddadhānaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam
tato gaccheta viprendrāḥ somatīrthamanuttamam / yatra somastapastaptvā vyādhimukto 'bhavat purā
tatra someśvare dṛṣṭvā snātvā tīrthavare śubhe / rājasūyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
vyādhibhiśca vinirmuktaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ / somalokamapāpnoti tatraiva ramate ciram
bhūteśvaraṃ ca tatraiva jvālāmāleśvaraṃ tathā / tāvubhau liṅgāvabhyarcya na bhūyo janma cāpnuyāt
ekahaṃse naraḥ snātvā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet / kṛtaśocaṃ samāsādya tīrthasevī dvijottamaḥ
puṇḍarīkamavāpnoti kṛkaśauco bhavennaraḥ / tato muñjavaṭaṃ nāma mahādevasya dhīmataḥ
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnayāt / tatraiva ca mahāgrāhī yakṣiṇī lokaviśrutā
snātvābigatvā tatraiva prasādya yakṣiṇīṃ tataḥ / upavāsaṃ ca tatraiva mahāpātakanāśanam
kurukṣetrasya tad dvāraṃ viśrutaṃ puṇyavarddhūnam / pradakṣiṇamupāvartya brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ / puṣkaraṃ ca tato gatvā abhyarcya pitṛdevatāḥ
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa āhṛtaṃ tanmahātmanā / kṛtakṛtyo bhaved rājā aśvamedhaṃ ca vindati
kanyādānaṃ ca yastatra kārtikyāṃ vai kariṣyati / prasannā devatāstasya dāsyantyabhimataṃ pharam
kapalaśca mahāyakṣo dvārapālaḥ khayaṃ sthitaḥ / vighnaṃ karoti pāpānāṃ durgati ca prayacchati
patnī tasya mahāyakṣī nāmnodūkhalamekhalā / āhatya dundubhiṃ tatra bhramate nityameva hi
sā dadarśa striyaṃ caikāṃ saputrāṃ pāpadeśajām / tāmuvāca tadā yakṣī āhatya niśi dundubhim
yugandhare dadhi prāśya uṣitvā cācyutasthale / tadvad bhūtālaye snātvā saputrā vastumicchasi
divā mayā te kathitaṃ rātrau bhakṣyāmi niścitam / etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ praṇipatya ca yakṣiṇīm
uvāca dīnayā vācā prasādaṃ kuru bhāmini / tataḥ sā yakṣiṇī tāṃ tu provāca kṛpayānvitā
yadā sūryasya grahaṇaṃ kālena bhavitā kvacit / saṃnihatyāṃ tadā snātvā pūtā svargaṃ kamiṣyasi
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye trayodaso 'dhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / tato rāmahṛdaṃ gacchet tīrthasevī dvijottamaḥ / yatra rāmeṇa vipreṇa tarasā dīptatejasā
kṣatramutsādya vīreṇa hradāḥ pañca niveśitāḥ / pūrayitvā naravyāghra rudhireṇeti naḥ śrutam
pitarastarpitāstena tathaiva ca pitāmahāḥ / tataste pitaraḥ prītā rāmamūcurdvijottamāḥ
rāma rāma mahābāho prītāḥ smastava bhārgava / anayā pitṛbhaktyā ca vikrameṇa ca te vibho
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te kimicchasi mahāyaśaḥ / evamuktastu pitṛbhī rāmaḥ prabhavatāḥ paraḥ
abravīt prāñjalirvākyaṃ sa pitṛn gagane sthitān / bhavanto yadi me prītā yadya nugrāhyatā mayi
pitṛprasādādiccheyaṃ tapasāpyāyanaṃ punaḥ / yacca poṣābhibhūtena kṣatramutsāditaṃ mayā
tataśca pāpānmucyeyaṃ yuṣmākaṃ tejasā hyaham / hradāścaite tīrthabhūtā bhaveyurbhuvi viśrutāḥ
evamuktāḥ śubhaṃ vākyaṃ rāmasya pitarastadā / pratyūcuḥ paramaprītā rāmaṃ harṣapuraskṛtāḥ
tapaste varddhūtāṃ putra pitṛbhaktyā viśeṣataḥ / yacca roṣābhibhūtena kṣatramutsāditaṃ tvayā
tataśca pāpānmuktastvaṃ pātitāste kvakarmabhiḥ / hradāśca tava tīrthatvaṃ gamīṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ
hradeṣveteṣu ye snātvā svān pitṝṃstarpayanti ca / tebhyo dāsyanti pitaro yathābhilaṣitaṃ varam
īpsitān mānasān kāmān svargavāsaṃ ca śāśvatam / evaṃ dattvā varān viprā rāmasya pitarastadā
āmantrya bhārgavaṃ prītāstatraivāntarhitāstadā / evaṃ rāmahradāḥ puṇyā bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ
snātvā hradeṣu rāmasya brahmacārī śucivrataḥ / rāmamabhyarcya śraddhāvān vinded bahu suvarṇakam
vaṃśamūlaṃ samāsādya tīrthasevī susaṃyataḥ / svavaṃśasiddhaye viprāḥ snātvā vai vaṃśamūlake
kāyaśodhanamāsādya tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / śarīrasuddhimāpnoti snātastasmin na saṃśayaḥ
suddhadehaśca taṃ yāti yasmānnāvartate punaḥ / tāvad bhramanti tīrtheṣu siddhāstīrthaparāyaṇāḥ / yāvanna prāpnuvantīha tīrthaṃ tatkāyaśodhanam
tasmistīrthe ca saṃplāvya kāyaṃ saṃyatamānasaḥ / paraṃ padamavāpnoti yasmānnāvartate punaḥ / 14.19 tato gaccheta viprendrāstīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / lokā yatroddhatāḥ sarve viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā
lokoddhāraṃ sāmāsādya tīrthasmaraṇatatparaḥ / snātvātīrthavare tasmin lokān paśyati śāśvatān
yatra viṣṇuḥ sthito nityaṃ śivo devaḥ sanātanaḥ / tau devau praṇipātena prasādya muktimāpnuyāt
śrītīrthaṃ tu tato gacchet śālagrāmamanuttamam / tatra snātasya sānnidhyaṃ sadā devī prayacchati
kapilāhradamāsādya tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / tatra snātvār'cayitvā ca daivatāni pitṛstathā
kapilānāṃ sahasrasya phalaṃ vindati mānavaḥ / tatra sthitaṃ mahādevaṃ kāpilaṃ vapurāsthitam
dṛṣṭvā muktimavāpnoti ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaṃ śivam / sūryatīrthaṃ samāsādya snātvā niyatamānasaḥ
arcayitvā pitṛn devānupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / agniṣṭomamavāpnoti sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati
sahasrakiraṇaṃ devaṃ bhānuṃ trailokyaviśrutam / dṛṣṭvā muktimavāpnoti naro jñānasamanvitaḥ
bhavānīvanāmāsādya tīrthasevī yathākramam / tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvāṇo gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
pitāmahasya pibato hyamṛtaṃ pūrvameva hi / udgārāt surabhirjātā sā ca pātālamāśritā
tasyāḥ surabhayo jātāḥ tanayā lokamātaraḥ / tābhistatsakalaṃ vyāptaṃ pātālaṃ sunirantaram
pitāmahasya yajato dakṣiṇārthamupāhṛtāḥ / āhutā brahmaṇā tāśca vibhrāntā vivareṇa hi
tasmin vivaradvāre tu sthito gaṇapatiḥ svayam / yaṃ dṛṣṭvā sakalān kāmān prāpnotisaṃyatendriyaḥ
saṃginīṃ tu samāsādya tīrthaṃ muktisamāśrayam / devyāstīrthe naraḥ snātvā labhate rūpamuttamam
anantāṃ śriyamāpnoti putrapautrasamanvitaḥ / bhogāṃśca vipulān bhuktvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam
brahmāvarte naraḥ snātvā brahmajñānasamanvitaḥ / bhavate nātra sandehaḥ prāṇān muñcati svecchayā
tato gaccheta viprendrā dvārapālaṃ tu rantukam / tasya tīrthaṃ sarasvatyāṃ yakṣendrasya mahātmanaḥ
tatra snātvā mahāprājña upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / yakṣasya ca prasādena labhate kāmikaṃ phalam
tato gaccheta viprendrā brahmavartaṃ munistutam / brahmāvarte naraḥ snātvā brahma cāpnoti niścitam
tato gaccheta viprendrāḥ sutīrthakamanuttamam / tatra saṃnihitā nityaṃ pitaro daivataiḥ saha
tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta pitṛdevārcane rataḥ / aśvamedhamavāpnoti pitṛn prīṇāti śāśvatān
tato 'mbuvanaṃ dharmajña samāsādya yathākramam / kāmeśvarasya tīrthaṃ tu snātvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ
sarvavyādhivinirmukto brahmavāptirbhaved dhruvam / mātṛtīrthaṃ ca tatraiva yatra snātasya bhaktitaḥ
prajā vivarddhate nityamanantāṃ cāpnubhācchriyam / tataḥ śītavanaṃ gacchenniyato niyatāśanaḥ
tīrthaṃ tatra mahāviprā mahadanyatra durlabham / punāti darśanādeva daṇḍakaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ
keśānabhyukṣya vai tasmin pūto bhavati pāpataḥ / tatra tīrthavaraṃ cānyat svānulomāyanaṃ mahat
tatra viprā mahāprājñā vidvāṃsastīrthatatparāḥ / svanulomāyane tīrthe viprāstrailokyaviśrute
prāṇāyāmairniharanti svalomāni dvijottamāḥ / pūtātmānaśca te viprāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim
daśāśvamedhikaṃ caiva tatra tīrthaṃ suviśrutam / tatra snātvā bhaktiyuktastadeva labhate phalam
tato gaccheta śraddhāvān mānuṣaṃ lokaviśrutam / darśanāt tasya tīrthasya mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ
purā kṛṣṇamṛgāstatra vyādhena śarapīḍitāḥ / vigāhya tasmin sarasi mānuṣatvamupāgatāḥ
tato vyādhāśca te sarve tānapṛcchan dvijottamān / mṛgā anena vai yātā asmābhiḥ śarapīḍitāḥ
nimagnāste saraḥ prāpya kva te yātā dvijottamāḥ / te 'bruvaṃstatra vai pṛṣṭā vayaṃ te ca dvijottamāḥ
asya tīrthasya māhātmyān mānuṣatvamupāgatāḥ / tasmād yūyaṃ śraddadhānāḥ snātvā tīrthe vimatsarāḥ
sarvapāpavinirmuktā bhaviṣyatha na saṃśayaḥ / tataḥ snātāśca te sarve śuddhadehā divaṃ gatāḥ
etat tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ mānuṣasya dvijottamāḥ / ye śṛṇvanti śraddadhānāste 'pi yānti parāṃ gatim
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / mānuṣasya tu pūrveṇa krośamātre dvijottamāḥ / āpagā nāma vikhyātā nadī dvijaniṣevitā
śyāmākaṃ payasā siddhamājyena ca pariplutam / ye prayacchanti viprebhyasteṣāṃ pāpaṃ na vidyate
ye tu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyanti prāpya tāmāpagāṃ nadīm / te sarvakāmasaṃyuktā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ
śaṃsanti sarve pitaraḥ smaranti ca pitāmahāḥ / asmākaṃ ca kule putraḥ pautro vāpi bhaviṣyati
ya āpagāṃ nadīṃ gatvā tilaiḥ saṃtarpayiṣyati / tena tṛptā bhaviṣyāmo yāvatkalpaśataṃ gatam
nabhasye māsi samprāpte kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ / caturdaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne piṇḍado muktimāpnuyāt
tato gaccheta viprendrā brahmaṇaḥ sthanamuttamam / brahmodumbaramityevaṃ sarvalokeṣu piśrutam
tatra brahmarṣikuṇḍeṣu snātasya dvijasattamāḥ / saptarṣiṇāṃ prasādena saptasomaphalaṃ bhavet
bharadvājo gautamaśca jamadagniśca kaśyapaḥ / viśvāmitro vasiṣṭhaśca atriśca bhagavānṛpiḥ
etaiḥ sametya tatkuṇḍaṃ kalpitaṃ bhuvi durlabham / brahmaṇā sevitaṃ yasmād brahmodumbaramucyate
tasmiṃstīrthavare snāto brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ / brahmalokamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
devān pitṝn samuddiśya yo vipraṃ bhojayiṣyati / pitarastasya sukhitā dāsyanti bhuvi durlabham
saptarṣīśca samuddaśya pṛtham snānaṃ samācaret / ṛṣīṇāṃ ca prasādena saptalokādhipo bhavet
kapisthaleti vikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam / yasmin sthitaḥ khayaṃ devo vṛddhakedārasaṃjñitaḥ
tatra snātvār'cayitvā ca rudraṃ diṇḍisamanvitam / antardhānamavāpnoti śivaloke sa modate
yastatra tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā pibate culakatrayam / diṇḍidevaṃ namaskṛtya kedārasya phalaṃ labhet
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ śivamuddiśya mānavaḥ / caitrasuklacaturdaśyāṃ prāpnoti paramaṃpadam
kalasyāṃ tu tato gacched yatra devī svayaṃ sthitā / durgā kātyāyanī bhadrā nidrā māyā sanātanī
kalasyāṃ ca naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā durgā taṭe sthitām / saṃsāragahanaṃ durgaṃnistarennātra saṃśayaḥ
tato gaccheta sarakaṃ trailokyasyāpi durlabham / kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram
labhate sarvakāmāṃśca śivalokaṃ sa gacchati / tisrāḥ koṭyastu tīrthānāṃ sarake dvijasattamāḥ
rudrakoṭistathā kūpe saromadhye vyavasthitā / tasmin sare ca yaḥ snātvā rudrakoṭiṃ smarennaraḥ
pūjitā rudrakoṭiśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ / rudrāṇāṃ ca prasādena sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ
aindrajñānena saṃyuktaḥ paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt / iḍāspadaṃ ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ pāpabhayāpaham
asmin muktimavāpnoti darśanādeva mānavaḥ / tatra snātvār'thayitvā ca pitṛdevagaṇānapi
na durgatimavāpnoti manasā cintitaṃ labhet / kedāraṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam
tatra snātvā tu puruṣaḥ sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet / kiṃrūpaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ tatraiva bhuvi durlabham
sarakasya tu pūrveṇa tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / anyajanma suvikhyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
nārasiṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā hatvā dānavamūrjitam / tiryagyonau sthito viṣṇuḥ siṃheṣu ratimāpnuvan
tato devāḥ sagandharvā ārāghya varadaṃ śivam / ūcuḥ praṇatasarvāṅgā viṣṇudehasya lambhane
tato devo mahātmāsau śārabhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ / yuddhaṃ ca kārayāmāsa divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam / yudhyamānau tu tau devau patitau saramadhyataḥ
tasmin sarastaṭe vipro devarṣirnāradaḥ sthitaḥ / aśvatthavṛkṣamāśritya dhyānasthastau dadarśa ha
viṣṇuścaturbhujo jajñe liṅgākāraḥ śivaḥ sthitaḥ / tau dṛṣṭvā tatra puruṣau tuṣṭāva bhaktibhāvitaḥ
namaḥ śivāya devāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave / haraye ca umābhartre sthitikālabhṛte namaḥ
harāya vahurūpāya viśvarūpāya viṣṇave / tryambakāya susuddhāya kuṣṇāya jñānahetave
dhanyo 'haṃ sukṛtī nityaṃ yad dṛṣṭo puruṣottamau / mamāśramamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yuvābhyāṃ vimalīkṛtam / adyaprabhṛti trailokye anyajanmeti viśrutam
ya ihāgatya snātvā ca pitṝn saṃtarpayiṣyati / tasya śraddhānvitasyeha jñānamaindraṃ bhaviṣyati
aśvatthasya tu yanmūlaṃ sadā tatra vasāmyaham / aśvatthavandanaṃ kṛtvā yamaṃ raudraṃ na paśyati
tato gaccheta viprendrā nāgasya hradamuttamam / pauṇḍarīke naraḥ snātvā puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet
daśamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya caitrasya tu viśeṣataḥ / snānaṃ japaṃ tathā śrāddhaṃ muktimārgapradāyakam
tatastriviṣṭavaṃ gacchet tīrthaṃ devanaṣevitam / tatra vaitaraṇī puṇyā nadī pāpapramocanī
tatra snātvār'cayitvā ca śūlapāṇiṃ vṛṣadhvajam / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā gacchatyeva parāṃ gatim
tato gaccheta viprendrā rasāvartamanuttamam / tatra snātvā bhaktiyuktaḥ siddhimāpnotyanuttamām
caitra śuklacaturdaśyāṃ tīrthe snātvā hyalepake / pūjayitvā śivaṃ tatra pāpalepo na vidyate
tato gacchena viprandrāḥ phalakīvanamuttamam / yatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sādhyāśca ṛṣayaḥ sthitāḥ / tapaścaranti vipulaṃ divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam
dṛṣadvatyāṃ naraḥ snātvā tarpayitvā ca devatāḥ / agniṣṭomātirātrābhyāṃ phalaṃ vindati māvanaḥ
somakṣaye ca saṃprāpte somasya ca dine tathā / yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute martyastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
gayāyāṃ ca yatā śrāddha pitṛn prīṇāti nityaśaḥ / tathā śrāddhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ phalakīvanamāśritaiḥ
manasā smarate yastu phalakīvanamuttamam / tasyāpi pitarastṛptiṃ prayāsyanti na saṃśayaḥ
tatrāpi tīrthaṃ sumahat sarvadevairalaṅkṛtam / tasmin snātastu puruṣo gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
pāṇikhāte naraḥ snātvā pitṛn saṃtarpya mānavaḥ / avāpnuyād rājasūyaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃ ca vindati
tato gaccheta sumahat tīrthaṃ miśrakamuttamam / tatra tīrthāni muninā miśritāni mahātmanā
vyāsena muniśārdulā dadhīcyarthaṃ mahātmanā / sarvatīrtheṣu sa snāti miśrake snāti yo naraḥ
tato vyāsavanaṃ gacchenniyato niyatāśanaḥ / manojave naraḥ snātvā miśrake snāti yo naraḥ
manasā cintitaṃ sarvaṃ sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / gatvā madhuvaṭīṃ caiva devyāstīrthaṃ naraḥ śuciḥ
tatra snātvār'cayed devān pitṝṃśca prayato naraḥ / sa devyā samanujñāto yathā siddhiṃ labhennaraḥ
kauśikyāḥ saṃgame yastu dṛṣadvatyāṃ narottamaḥ / snāyīta nayatāhāraḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
tato vyāsasthalī nāma yatra vyāsena dhīmatā / putraśokābhibhūtena dehatyāgāya niścayaḥ
kṛto devaiśca viprendrāḥ punarutthāpitastadā / abhigamya sthalīṃ tasya putraśokaṃ na vindati
gindattaṃ kūpamāsādya tilaprasthaṃ pradāya ca / gaccheta paramāṃ siddhiṃ ṛṇairmuktimavāpnuyāt
yahnaṃ ca sudinaṃ caiva dve tīrthe bhuvi durlabhe / tayoḥ snātvā viśuddhātmā sūryalokamapāpnuyāt
kṛtajapyaṃ tato gacchet triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / tatrābhiṣekaṃ kuvīnta gaṅgāyāṃ prayataḥ sthitaḥ
arcayitvā mahādevamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / koṭitīrthaṃ ca tatraiva dṛṣṭvā koṭīśvaraṃ prabhum
tatra svnātvā śraddadhānaḥ koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet / tato vāmanakaṃ gacchet triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
yatra vāmanarūpeṇa viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā / balerapahṛtaṃ rājyamindrāya pratipāditam
tatra viṣṇupadesnātvā arcayitvā ca vāmanam / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt
jyeṣṭhāśramaṃ ca tatraiva sarvapātakanāśanam / taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā naro muktiṃ saṃprayāti na saṃśayaḥ
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ / dvādaśyāṃ ca naraḥ snātvā jyeṣṭhatvaṃ labhate nṛpu
tatra pratiṣṭhitā viprā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā / dīkṣāpratiṣṭhāsaṃyuktā viṣṇuprīṇanatatparāḥ
tebhyo dattāni śrāddhāni dānāni vividhāni ca / akṣayāṇi bhaviṣyanti yāvanmanvantarasthitiḥ
tatraiva koṭitīrthaṃ ca triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / tasmistīrthe naraḥ snātvā koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet
koṭīśvaraṃ naro dṛṣṭvā tasmitīrthe maheśvaram / mahādevaprasādena gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt
tatraiva sumahat tīrthaṃ sūryasya ca mahātmanaḥ / tasmin snātvā bhaktibhuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate
tato gaccheta vipraindrāstīrthaṃ kalmaṣanāśanam / kulottāraṇanāmānaṃ viṣṇunā kalpitaṃ purā
varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca tāraṇāya sunirmalam / brahmacaryātparaṃ mokṣaṃ ya icchinti sunirmalam / te 'pi tattīrthamāsādya paśyanti paramaṃ padam
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathā / kulāni tārayet snātaḥ sapta sapta ca sapta ca
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ sūdrā ye tatparāyaṇāḥ / snātā bhaktiyutāḥ sarve paśyanti paramaṃ padam
dūrastho 'pi smared yastu kurukṣetraṃ savāmanam / so 'pi muktimavāpnoti kiṃ punarnnivasannaraḥ
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmne pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / pavanasya hrade snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram / vimuktaḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ śaivaṃ padamavāpnuyāt
putraśokena pavano yasmillīno babhūva ha / tataḥ sabrahmakairdevaiḥ prasādya prakaṭīkṛtaḥ
ato gaccheta amṛtaṃ sthānaṃ tacchūlapāṇinaḥ / yatra devaiḥ sagandharvaiḥ hanumān prakaṭīkṛtaḥ
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā amṛtatvamavāpnuyāt / kulottāraṇamāsādya tīrthasevī dvijottamaḥ
kulāni tārayet sarvān mātāmahapitāmahān / śālihotrasya rājarṣestīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam
tatra snātvā vimuktastu kaluṣairdaihasaṃbhavaiḥ / śrīkuñjaṃ tu sarasvatyāṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam
tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet / tato naimiṣakuñjaṃ tu samāsādya naraḥ śuciḥ
naimiṣasya ca snānena yat puṇyaṃ tat samāpnuyāt / tatra tīrthaṃ mahākhyātaṃ vedavatyā niṣevitam
rāvaṇena gṛhītāyāḥ keśeṣu dvijasattamāḥ / tadvadhāya ca sā prāṇān mumuce śokakarśitā
tato jātā gṛhe rājño najakasya mahātmanaḥ / sītā nāmeti vikhyātā rāmapatnī pativratā
sā hṛtā rāvaṇeneha vināśāyātmanaḥ svayam / rāmeṇa rāvaṇaṃ hatvā abhiṣicya vibhiṣaṇam
samānītā gṛhaṃ sītā kīrtirātmavatā yathā / tasyāstīrthe naraḥ snātvā kanyāyajñaphalaṃ labhet
vimuktaḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam / tato gaccheta sumahad brahmaṇaḥ sthānamuttamama
yatra varṇāvaraḥ snātvā brāhmaṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ / brāhmaṇaśca viśuddhatmā paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt
tato gaccheta somasya tīrthaṃ trailokyadurlabham / yatra somastapastaptvā dvijarājyamavāpnuyāt
tatra snātvār'cayitvā ca svapitṝn daivatāni ca / nirmalaḥ svargamāyāti kārtikyāṃ candramā yathā / / 16.16 saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyasyāpi durlabham / yatra sapta sarasvatya ekībhūtā vahanti ca
suprabhā kāñcanākṣī ca viśālā mānasahradā / sarasvatyoghanāmā ca suveṇurvimalodakā
pitāmahasya yajataḥ puṣkareṣu sthitasya ha / abruvan ṛṣayaḥ sarve nāyaṃ yajño mahāphalaḥ
na dṛśyate saricchreṣṭhā yasmādiha sarasvatī / tachrutvā bhagavān prītaḥ sasmārātha sarasvatīm
pitāmahena yajatā āhūtā puṣkareṣu vai / suprabhā nāma sā devī tatra khyātā sarasvatī
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ prītā vegayuktāṃ sarasvatīm / pitāmahaṃ mānayantīṃ te tu tāṃ bahu menire
evameṣā saricchreṣṭhā puṣkarasthā sarasvatī / samānītā surukṣetre maṅkaṇena mahātmanā
naimiṣe munayaḥ sthitvā śaunakādyāstapodhanāḥ / te pṛcchanti mahātmānaṃ paurāṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
kathaṃ yajñaphalo 'smākaṃ vartatāṃ satpathe bhavet / tato 'brevīnmahābhāgāḥ praṇamya śirasā ṛtīn
sarasvatī sthitā yatra tatra yajñaphalaṃ mahat / etacchrutvā tu manuyo nānāsvādhyāyavedinaḥ
samāgamya tataḥ sarve sasmaruste sarasvatīm / sā tu dhyātā tatastatra ṛṣibhiḥ satrayājibhiḥ
samāgatā plāvanārthaṃ yajñe teṣāṃ mahātmanām / naimiṣe kāñcanākṣī tu smṛtā maṅkaṇakena sā
samāgatā kurukṣetraṃ puṇyatoya sarasvatī / gayasya yajamānasya gayeṣveva mahākratum
āhūtā ca saricchreṣṭhā gayayajñe sarasvatī / viśālāṃ nāma tāṃ prāhurṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ
sarit sā hi samāhūtā maṅkaṇena mahātmanā / kurukṣetraṃ samāyātā praviṣṭā ca mahānadī
uttare kośalābhāge puṇye devarṣisevite / uddālakena muninā tatra dhyātā sarasvatī
ājagāma saricchreṣṭhā taṃ deśaṃ munikāraṇāt / pūjyamānā munigaṇairvalkalājinasaṃvṛtaiḥ
manohareti vikhyātā sarvapāpakṣayāvahā / āhūtā sā kurukṣetre maṅkaṇena mahātmanā / ṛṣeḥ saṃmānanārthāya praviṣṭā tīrthamuttamam
suveṇuriti vikhyātā kedāre yā sarasvatī / sarvapāpākṣayā jñeyā ṛṣisiddhiniṣevitā
sāpi teneha muninā ārādhya parameśvaram / ṛṣīṇāmupakārārthaṃ kurukṣetraṃ praveśitā
dakṣeṇa yajatā sāpi gaṅgādvāre sarasvatī / vimalodā bhagavatī dakṣeṇa prakaṭīkṛtā
samāhūtā yayau tatra maṅkaṇena mahātmanā / kurukṣetre tu kuruṇā yajitā ca sarasvatī
saromadhye samānītā mārkaṇḍeyena dhīmatā / abhiṣṭūya mahābhāgāṃ puṇyatoyāṃ sarasvatīm
yatra maṅkaṇakaḥ siddhaḥ saptasārasvate sthitaḥ / nṛtyamānaśca devena śaṅkareṇa nivāritaḥ
iti kṣīvāmanurāṇe saromāhātmye ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ / kathaṃ maṅkaṇakaḥ siddhaḥ kasmājjāto mahānṛṣiḥ / nṛtyamānastu devena kimarthaṃ sa nivāritaḥ
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca kaśyapasya suto jajñe mānaso maṅkaṇomuniḥ / snānaṃ kartuṃ vyavasito gṛhītvā valkalaṃ dvijaḥ
tatra gatā hyapsaraso rambhādyāḥ priyadarśanāḥ / snāyanti rucirāḥ snigdhāstena sārdhamaninditāḥ
tato munestadā kṣobhādretaḥ skannaṃ yadambhasi / tadretaḥ sa tu jagrāha kalaśe vai mahātapāḥ
saptadhā pravibhāgaṃ tu kalaśasthaṃ jagāma ha / tatrarṣayaḥ spata jātā viduryān marutāṃ gaṇān / 17.5 vāyuvego vāyubalo vāyuhā vāyumaṇḍalaḥ / vāyujvalo vāyureto vāyucakraśca vīryavān
ete hyapatyāstasyarṣerdhārayanti carācaram / purā maṅkaṇakaḥ siddhaḥ kuśāgreṇeti me śrutam
kṣataḥ kila kare viprāstasya śākaraso 'sravat / sa vai śākarasaṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣāviṣṭaḥ pranuttavān
tataḥ sarvaṃ pranṛttaṃ ca sathāvaraṃ jaṅmaṃ ca yat / pranuttaṃ ca jagad dṛṣṭvā tejasā tasya mohitam
brahmādibhiḥ suraistatra ṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ / vijñapto vai mahādevo munerarthe dvijottamāḥ
nāya nṛtyed yathā deva tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi / tato devo muniṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣāviṣṭamatīva hi
suraṇāṃ hitakāmārthaṃ mahādevo 'bhyabhāṣata / harṣasthānaṃ kimarthaṃ ca tavedaṃ munisattama / tapasvino dharmapathe sthitasya dvijasattama
kiṃ na paśyasi me brahman karācchākarasaṃ srutam / yaṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ pranutto vai harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ
taṃ prahasyābravīd devo muniṃ rāgema mohitam / ahaṃ na vismayaṃ vipra gacchāmīha prapaśyatām
evamuktvā muniśreṣṭhaṃ devadevo mahādyutiḥ / aṅgulyagreṇa viprendrāḥ svāṅguṣṭhaṃ tāḍayad bhavaḥ
tato bhasma kṣatāt tasmānnirgataṃ himasannibham / tad dṛṣṭvā vrīḍitovipraḥ pādayoḥ patito 'bravīt
nānyaṃ devādahaṃ manye śūlapāṇermahātmanaḥ / carācarasya jagato varastvamasi śūladhṛk
tvadāśrayāśca dṛśyante surā brahmādayo 'nagha / pūrvastvamasi devānāṃ kartā kārayitā mahat
tvatprasādāt surāḥ sarve modante hyakulobhayāḥ / evaṃ stutvā mahādevamṛṣiḥ sa praṇato 'bravīt
bhagavaṃstvaprasādāddhi tapo me na kṣayaṃ vrajet / tato devaḥ prasānnātmā tamṛṣiṃ vākyamabravīt
īśvara uvāca tapaste varddhatāṃ vipra matprasādāt sahasradhā / āśrame ceha vatsyāmi tvayā sārddhamahaṃ sadā
saptasārasvate snātvā yo mamarciṣyate naraḥ / na tasya durlabhaṃ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca
sārasvataṃ ca taṃ lokaṃ gamiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ / śivasya ca prasādena pāpnoti paramaṃ padam
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye saptadaśodhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / tatastvauśanasaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchettu śraddhāyānvitāḥ / uśanā yatra saṃsiddho grahatvaṃ ca samāptavān
tasmin snātvā vimuktastu pātakairjanmasaṃbhavaiḥ / tato yāti paraṃ brahma yasmānnāvartate punaḥ
rahodaro nāma muniryatra mukto babhūva ha / mahatā śirasā grastastīrthamāhātmyadarśanāt
kathaṃ rahodaro grastaḥ kathaṃ mokṣamavāptavān / tīrthasya tasya māhātmyamicchāmaḥ śrotumādarāt
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca purā vai daṇḍakāraṇye rāghaveṇa mahātmanā / vasatā dvijaśārdūlā rākṣasāstatra hiṃsitāḥ
tatraikasya śiraśchinnaṃ rākṣasasya durātmanaḥ / kṣureṇa śitadhāreṇa tat papāta mahāvane
rahodarasya tallagnaṃ jaṅghāyāṃ vai yadṛcchayā / vane vicāratastatra asthi bhittvā viveśa ha
sa tena lagnena tadā dvijātirna śaśāka ha / abhigantuṃ mahāprājñastīrthānyāyatanāni ca
sa pūtinā visravatā vedanārte mahāmuniḥ / jagāma sarvatīrthāni pṛthivyāṃ yāni kāni ca
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām / te 'bruvan ṛṣayo vipraṃ prayāhyaiśanasaṃ pratiḥ
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jagāma sa rahodaraḥ / tatastvaiśanase tīrthe tasyopaspṛśatastadā
tacchiraścaraṇaṃ muktvā papātāntarjale dvijāḥ / tataḥ sa virajo bhūtvā pūtātmā vītakalmaṣaḥ
ājagāmāśramaṃ prītaḥ kathayāmāsa cākhilam / te śrutvā ṛṣayaḥ sarve tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam / kapālamocanamiti nāma cakruḥ samāgatāḥ
tatrāpi sumahattīrtha viśvāmitrasya viśrutam / brāhmaṇyaṃ labdhavān yatra viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
tasmistīrthavare snātvā brāhmaṇyaṃ labhate dhruvam / brāhmaṇastu viśuddhātmā paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt
tataḥ pūthūdakaṃ gacchenniyato niyatāśanaḥ / tatra siddhastu brahmarṣi ruṣaṅgurnāma nāmataḥ
jātismaro ruṣaṅgustu gaṅgādvāre sadā sthitaḥ / antakālaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā putrān vacanamabravīt / iha śreyo na pasyāmi nayadhvaṃ māṃ pṛthūdakam
vijñāya tasya tadbhāvaṃ ruṣaṅgoste tapodhanāḥ / taṃ vai tīrthe upāninyuḥ sarasvatyāstapodhanam
sa taiḥ putraiḥ samānītaḥ sarasvatyāṃ samāplutaḥ / smṛtvā tīrthaguṇān sarvān prāhedamṛṣisattamaḥ
sarasvatyuttare tīrthe yastyajedātmanastanum / pṛthūdake japyaparo nūnaṃ cāmaratāṃ vrajet
tatraiva brahmayonyasti brahmaṇā yatra nirmitā / pṛthūdakaṃ samāśritya sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitaḥ
cāturvarṇyasya sṛṣṭyarthamātmajñānaparo 'bhavat / tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
mukhato brāhmaṇā jātā bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyāstathā / ūrubhyāṃ vaiśyajātīyāḥ padbhyāṃ śūdrāstato 'bhavan
cāturvarṇyaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā āśramasthaṃ tatastataḥ / evaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmayonīti saṃjñitam
tatra snātvā muktikāmaḥ punaryoniṃ na paśyati / tatraiva tīrthaṃ vikhyātamavakīrṇeti nāmataḥ
yasmin tīrthe bako dālbhyo dhṛtarāṣṭramamarṣaṇam / juhāva vāhanaiḥ sārdhaṃ tatrābudhyat tato nṛpaḥ
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ tīrthamavakīrṇena nāmataḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa rājñā ca sa kimarthaṃ prasāditaḥ
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca ṛṣayo naimiṣeyā ye dakṣiṇārthaṃ yayuḥ purā / tatraiva ca bako dālbhyo dṛtarāṣṭrā mayācata
tenāpi tatra nindārthamuktaṃ paśvanṛtaṃ tu yat / tataḥ krodhena mahatā māṃsamutkṛtya tatra ha / / 18.29 pṛthūdake mahātīrthe avakīrṇeti nāmataḥ / juhāva dhṛtarāṣṭrasya rāṣṭraṃ narapatestataḥ
hūyamāne tadā rāṣṭre pravṛtte yajñakarmaṇi / akṣiyata tato rāṣṭraṃ nṛpaterduṣkṛtena vai
tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa brāhmaṇasya viceṣṭitam / purohitena saṃyukte ratnānyādāya sarvaśaḥ
prasādanārthaṃ viprasya hyavakīrṇaṃ yayau tadā / prasāditaḥ sa rājñā ca tuṣṭaḥ provāca taṃ nṛpam
brāhmaṇā nāvamantavyāḥ puruṣeṇa vijānatā / avajñāto brāhmaṇastu hanyāt tripuruṣaṃ kulam
evamuktvā sa nṛpatiṃ rājyena yaśasā punaḥ / utthāpayāmāsa tatastasya rājño hite sthitaḥ
tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ snāti śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ / sa prāpnoti naro nityaṃ manasā cintitaṃ phalam
tatra tīrthaṃ suvikhyātaṃ yāyātaṃ nāma nāmataḥ / yasyeha yajamānasya madhu susrāva vai nadī
tasmin snāto naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ / phalaṃ prāpnoti yajñasya aśvamedhasya mānavaḥ madhusravaṃ ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ dvijāḥ / tasmin snātvā naro bhaktyā madhunātarpayet pitṝn
tatrāpi sumahattīrthaṃ vasiṣṭhodvāhasaṃjñitam / tatra snāto bhaktiyukto vāsiṣṭhaṃ lokamāpnuyāt
tatrāpi sumahattīrthaṃ vasiṣṭhodvāhasaṃjñitam / tatra snāto bhaktiyukto vāsiṣṭhaṃ lokamāpnuyāt
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ / vasiṣṭhasyāpavāho 'sau kathaṃ vai saṃbabhūva ha / kimarthaṃ sā saricchreṣṭhā tamṛṣiṃ pratyavāhayat
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca viśvāmitrasya rājarṣervasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ / bhṛśaṃ vairaṃ babhūveha tapaḥsparddhākṛte mahat
āśramo vai vasiṣṭhasya sthāṇutīrthe babhūva ha / tasya paścimadigbhāge viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ
yatreṣṭvā bhagavān sthāṇuḥ pūjayitvā sarasvatīm / sthāpayāmāsa deveśo liṅgākārāṃ sarasvatīm
vasiṣṭhastatra tapasā ghorarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ / tasyeha tapasā hīno viśvāmitro babhūva ha
sarasvatīṃ samāhūya idaṃ vacanamabravīt / vasiṣṭhaṃ munisārdūlaṃ svena vegena ānaya
ihāhaṃ taṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ haniṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ / etacchratvā tu vacanaṃ vyathitā sā mahānadī
tathā tāṃ vyathitāṃ dṛṣṭvā vepamānaṃ mahānadīm / viśvāmitro 'bravīt kruddho vasiṣṭhaṃ śīghramānaya
tato gatvā saricchreṣṭhā vasiṣṭhaṃ munisattamam / kathayāmāsa rudatī viśvāmitrasya tad vacaḥ
tapaḥkriyāviśīrṇāṃ ca bhṛśaṃ śokasamanvitām / uvāca sa saricchreṣṭhāṃ viśvāmitrāya māṃ vacaḥ
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛpāśīlasya sā satit / cālayāmāsa taṃ stānāt pravāheṇāmbhasastadā
sa ca kūlāpahārema mitrāvaruṇayoḥ sutaḥ / uhyamānaśca tuṣṭāva tadā devīṃ sarasvatīm
pitāmahasya sarasaḥ pravṛttāsi sarasvati / vyāptaṃ tvayā jagat sarvaṃ tavaivāmbhobhiruttamaiḥ
tvamevākāśagā devī megheṣu sṛjase payaḥ / sarvāstvāpastvameveti tvatto vayamadhīmahe
puṣṭirdhṛtistathā kīrtiḥ siddhiḥ kāntiḥ kṣamā tathā / svadhā svāhā tathā vāṇī tavāyattamidaṃ jagat
tvameva sarvabhūteṣu vāṇīrūpeṇa saṃsthitā / evaṃ sarasvatī tena stutā bhagavatī tadā
sukhenovāha taṃ vipraṃ viśvāmitraśramaṃ prati / nyavedayattadā khinnā viśvāmitrāya taṃ munim
tamānītaṃ sarasvatyā dṛṣṭvā kopasamanvitaḥ / athānviṣat praharaṇaṃ vasiṣṭhāntakaraṃ tadā
taṃ tu kruddhamabhiprekṣya brahmahatyābhayānnadī / apovāha vasiṣṭhaṃ taṃ madhye caivāmbhasastadā / ubhayoḥ kurvatī vākyaṃ vañcayitvā ca gādhijam
tato 'pavāhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam / abravīt krodharaktākṣo viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ
yasmānmāṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭhe vañcayitvā vinirgatā / śoṇitaṃ vaha kalyāṇi rakṣogrāmaṇisaṃyutā
tataḥ sarasvatī śaptā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā / avahacchoṇitonmiśraṃ toyaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tadā
atharṣayaśca devāśca gandharvāpsarasastadā / sarasvatīṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā bhabhūvurbhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ
tasmintīrthavare puṇye śoṇitaṃ samupāvahat / tato bhūtapiśācāśca rākṣasāśca samāgatāḥ
tatasto śoṇitaṃ sarve pibantaḥ sukhamāsate / tṛptāśca subhṛśaṃ tena sukhitā vigatajvarāḥ / nṛtyantaśca hasantaśca yathā svargajitastathā
kasyacittvatha kālasya ṛṣayaḥ satapodhanāḥ / tīrthayātrāṃ samājagmuḥ sarasvatyāṃ tapodhanāḥ
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaighoraiḥ pīyamānāṃ mahānadīm / paritrāṇe sarasvatyāḥ paraṃ yatnaṃ pracakrire
te tu sarve mahābhāgāḥ samāgamya mahāvratāḥ / āhūya saritāṃ śreṣṭhāmidaṃ vacanamabravan
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ saricchreṣṭhe śoṇitena hlado hyayam / evamākulatāṃ yātaḥ śrutvā vetsyāmahe vayam
tataḥ sā sarvamācaṣṭa viśvāmitraviceṣṭitam / tataste munayaḥ prītāḥ sarasvatyāṃ samānayan / aruṇāṃ puṇyatoyaughāṃ sarvaduṣkṛtanāśanīm
dṛṣṭvā toyaṃ sarasvatyā rākṣasā duḥkhitā bhṛśam / ūcustān vai munīn sarvān dainyayuktāḥ punaḥ punaḥ
vayaṃ hi kṣudhitāḥ sarve dharmahīnāśca śāśvatāḥ / na ca naḥ kāmakāroyaṃ yad vayaṃ pāpakāriṇaḥ
yuṣmākaṃ cāprasādena duṣkṛtena ca karmaṇā / pakṣo 'yaṃ vardhate 'smākaṃ yataḥ smo brahmarākṣasāḥ
evaṃ vaiśyāśca śūdrāśca kṣatriyāśca vikarmabhiḥ / ye brāhmaṇān pedviṣanti te bhavantīha rākṣasāḥ
yoṣitāṃ caiva pāpānāṃ yonidoṣeṇa varddhate / iyaṃ saṃtatirasmākaṃ gatireṣā sanātanī
śaktā bhavantaḥ sarveṣāṃ lokānāmapi tāraṇe / teṣāṃ te munayaḥ śrutvā kṛpāśīlāḥ punaśca te
ūcuḥ parasparaṃ sarve tapyamānāśca te dvijāḥ / kṣutakīṭāvapannaṃ ca yaccocchiṣṭāśitaṃ bhavet
keśāvapannamādhūtaṃ mārutaśvāsadvaṣitam / ebhiḥ saṃsṛṣṭamannaṃ ca bhāgaṃ vai rakṣasāṃ bhavet
tasmājjñātvā sadā vidvān annānyetāni jarjayet / rākṣasānāmasau bhuṅkte yo bhuṅkte annamīdṛśam
śodhayitvā tu tattīrthamṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ / mokṣārthaṃ rakṣasāṃ teṣāṃ saṃgamaṃ tatra kalpayan
aruṇāyāḥ sarasvatyāḥ saṃgame lokaviśrute / trirātropoṣitaḥ snāto mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
prāpte kaliyuge ghore adharme pratyupasthite / aruṇāsaṃgame snātvā muktimāpnoti mānavaḥ
tataste rākṣasāḥ sarve snātāḥ pāpavivarjitāḥ / dviyāmālyambaradharāḥ svargasthitisamanvitāḥ
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ lomaharṣaṇa uvāca / samudrāstatra catvāro darviṇā āha-tāḥ purā / pratyekaṃ tu naraḥ snāto gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
yatkiñcit kriyate tasmiṃstapastīrthe dvijottamāḥ / paripūrṇaṃ hi tatsarvamapi duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ
śatasāhasrikaṃ tīrthaṃ tathaiva śatikaṃ dvijāḥ / ubhayorhi naraḥ snāto gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
somatīrthaṃ ca tatrāpi sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitam / yasmin snātastu puruṣo rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet
reṇukāśramamāsādya śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ / mātṛbhaktyā ca yatpuṇyaṃ tatphalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ
ṛṇairmukto bhavennityaṃ devarṣipitṛsaṃbhavaiḥ / kumārasyābhiṣekaṃ ca ojasaṃ nāma viśrutam
tasmin snātastu puruṣo yaśasā ca samanvitaḥ / kumārapuramāpnoti kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ tu mānavaḥ
caitraṣaṣṭhyāṃ site pakṣe yastu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati / gayāśrāddhe ca yatpuṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ
saṃnihityāṃ yathā śrāddhaṃ rāhugraste divākare / tathā śrāddhaṃ tatra kṛtaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
ojase hyakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ vāyunā kathitaṃ purā / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ tatra samācaret
yastu snānaṃ śraddadhānaścaitraṣaṣṭhyāṃ kariṣyati / akṣayyamudakaṃ tasya pitṝṇāmupajāyate
tatra pañcavaṭaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / mahādevaḥ sthito yatra yogamūrtidharaḥ svayam
tatra snātvār'cayitvā va devadevaṃ maheśvaram / gāṇapatyamavāpnoti daivataiḥ saha modate
kurutīrthaṃ ca vikhyātaṃ kuruṇā yatra vai tapaḥ / taptaṃ sughoraṃ kṣetrasya karṣaṇārthaṃ dvijottamāḥ
tasya ghoreṇa tapasā tuṣṭa indrobravīd vacaḥ / rājarṣe parituṣṭo 'smi tapasānena suvrataḥ
yajñaṃ ye ca kurukṣetre kariṣyanti śatakratoḥ / te gamiṣyanti sukṛtāṃllokān pāpavivarjitān
avahasya tataḥ śakro jagāma tridivaṃ prabhuḥ / āgamyāgamya caivainaṃ bhūyo bhūyo 'vahasya ca
śatakraturanirviṇṇaḥ pṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭvā jagāma ha / yadā tu tapasogreṇa cakarṣa dehamātmanaḥ / tataḥ śakro 'bravīt prītya brūhi yatte cikīrṣitam
kururuvāca ye śraddadhānāstīrthe 'smin mānavā nivasanti ha / te prāpnuvantu sadanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ
anyatra kṛtapāpā ye pañcapātakadūṣitāḥ / asmistīrthe narāḥ snātvā muktā yāntu parāṃ gatim
kurukṣetre puṇyatamaṃ kurutīrthaṃ dvijottamāḥ / te dṛṣṭvā pāpamuktastu paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt
kurutīrthe naraḥ snāto mukto bhavati kilviṣaiḥ / kuruṇā samanujñātaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam
svargadvāraṃ tato gacchet śivadvāre vyavasthitam / tatra snātvā śivadvāre prāpnoti paramaṃ padam
tato gacchedanarakaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / yatra pūrve sthito brahma dakṣiṇe tu maheśvaraḥ
rudrapatnī paścimataḥ padmanābhottare sthitaḥ / madhye anarakaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyasyāpi durlabham
yasmin snātastu mucyeta pātakairupapātakaiḥ / vaiśākhe ca yadā ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalasya dinaṃ bhavet
tadā snānaṃ tatra kṛtvā mukto bhavati pātakaiḥ / yaḥ prayaccheta karakāṃścaturo bhakṣyasaṃyutān
kalaśaṃ ca tathā dadyādapūpaiḥ pariśobhitam / devatāḥ prīmayet pūrvaṃ karakairannasaṃyutaiḥ
tatastu kalaśaṃ dadyāt sarvapātakanāśanam / anenaiva vidhānena yastu snānaṃ samācaret
sa muktāḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ prayāti paramaṃ padam / anyatrāpi yadā ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalena bhaviṣyati
tatrāpi muktiphaladā kriyā tasmin bhaviṣyati / tīrthe ca sarvatīrthānāṃ yasmin snāto dvijottamāḥ
sarvadevairanujñātaḥ paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt / kāmyakaṃ ca vanaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam
yasmin praviṣṭamātrastu mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ / yamāśritya vanaṃ puṇyaṃ savitā prakaṭaḥ sthitaḥ
pūṣā nāma dvijaśreṣṭha darśanānmuktimāpnuyāt / ādityasya dine prāpte tasmin snātastu mānavaḥ / viśuddhadeho bhavati manasā cintitaṃ labhet
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye viśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kāmyakasya tu pūrveṇa kuñjaṃ devairniṣevitam / tasya tīrthasya saṃbhūtiṃ vistareṇa bravīhi naḥ
lohamarṣaṇa uvāca śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam / ṛṣīṇāṃ caritaṃ śrutvā mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ
naimiṣeyāśca ṛṣayaḥ kurukṣetre samāgatāḥ / sarasvatyāstu snānārthaṃ praveśaṃ te na lebhire
tataste kalpayāmāsustīrthaṃ yajñopavītikam / śeṣāstu munayastatra na praveśaṃ hi lebhire
rantukasyāśramāttāvad yāvattīrthaṃ sacakrakam / brāhmaṇaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā devī sarasvatī
hitārthaṃ sarvaviprāṇāṃ kutvā kuñjāni sā nadī / prayātā paścimaṃ mārgaṃ sarvabhūtahite sthitā
pūrvapravāhe yaḥ snāti gaṅgasnānaphalaṃ labhet / pravāhe dakṣiṇe tasyā narmadā saritāṃ varā
paścime tu diśābhāge yamunā saṃśritā nadī / yadā uttarato yāti sindhurbhavati sā nadī
evaṃ diśāpravāheṇa yāti puṇyā sarasvatī / tasyāṃ snātaḥ sarvatīrthe snāto bhavati mānavaḥ
tato gacched dvijaśreṣṭhā madanasya mahātmanaḥ / tīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ vihāraṃ nāma nāmataḥ
yatra devāḥ samāgamya śivadarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ / samāgatā na cāpaśyan devaṃ devyā samanvitam
te stuvanto mahādevaṃ nandinaṃ gaṇanāyakam / tataḥ prasanno nandīśaḥ kathayāmāsa ceṣṭitam
bhavasya umayā sārdhaṃ vihāre krīḍitaṃ mahat / tacchratvā devatāstatra patnīrāhūya krīḍitāḥ
teṣāṃ krīḍāvinodena tuṣṭaḥ provaca śaṅkaraḥ / yo 'smiṃstīrthenaraḥ snātivihāre śraddhayānvitaḥ
dhanadhānyapriyairyukto bhavate nātra saṃsayaḥ / durgātīrthaṃ tato gacched durgayā sevitaṃ mahat
yatra snātvā pitṛn pūjya na durgatimavāpḥṛyāt / tatrāpi ca sarasvatyāḥ kūpaṃ trailokyaviśrutam
darśanānmuktimāpnoti sarvapātakavarjitaḥ / yastatra tarpayet devān pitṝṃś ca śraddhayāntavitaḥ
akṣayyaṃ labhate sarvaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ viśiṣyate / mātṛhā pitṛhā yaśca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ
snātvā śuddhimavāpnoti yatra prācī sarasvatī / devamārgapraviṣṭā ca devamārgeṇa niḥsṛta
pracī sarasvatī puṇyā api duṣkṛtakarmaṇām / trirātraṃ ye kariṣyanti prācīṃ prāpya sarasvatīm
na teṣāṃ duṣkutaṃ kiñcid dehamāśritya tiṣṭhati / naranārāyaṇau devau brahmā sthāṇustathā raviḥ
pracīṃ diśaṃ niṣevante sadā devāḥ savāsavāḥ / ye tu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyanti prācīmāśritya mānavāḥ
teṣāṃ na durlabhaṃ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca / tasmāt prācī sadā sevyā pañcamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
pañcamyāṃ sevamānastu lakṣmīvān jāyate naraḥ / tatra tīrthamauśanaṃ trailokyasyāpi durlabham
uśanā yatra saṃsiddha ārādhya parameśvaram / grahamadhyeṣu pūjyate tasya tīrthasya sevanāt
evaṃ śukreṇa muninā sevitaṃ tīrthamuttamam / ye sevante śraddadhānāste yānti paramāṃ gatim
yastu śrāddhaṃ naro bhaktyā tasmiṃstīrthe kariṣyati / pitarastāritāstena bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ
caturmukhaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ saro maryādayā sthitam / ye sevante caturdaśyāṃ sopavāsā vasanti ca
aṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya caitre māsi dvijottamāḥ / te paśyanti paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ yasmānnāvartate punaḥ
sthāṇutīrthaṃ tato gacchet sahasraliṅgaśobhitam / tatra sthāṇuvaṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye ekaviśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ sthāṇutīrthasya māhātmyaṃ vaṭasya ca mahāmune / sānnihatyasarotpattiṃ pūraṇaṃ pāṃśunā tataḥ
liṅgānāṃ darśanāt puṇyaṃ sparśanena ca kiṃ phalam / tathaiva saramāhātmyaṃ brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve purāṇaṃ vāmanaṃ mahat / yacchrutvā muktimāpnoti prasādād vāmanasya tu
sanatkumāramāsīnaṃ sthāṇorvaṭasamīpataḥ / ṛṣibhirbālakhilyādyairbrahmaputrairmahātmabhiḥ
mārkaṇḍeyo munistatra vinayenābhigamya ca / papraccha saramāhātmyaṃ pramāṇāṃ ca sthitiṃ tathā
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca brahmaputra mahābhāga sarveśāstraviśārada / brūhi me saramāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayāvaham
kāni tīrthāni dṛśyāni guhyāni dvijasattama / liṅgāni hyatipuṇyāni sthāṇoryāni samīpataḥ
yeṣāṃ darśanāmātreṇa muktiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ / vaṭasya darśanaṃ puṇyamutpatti kathayasva me
pradakṣiṇāyāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ tīrthasnānena yatphalam / guhyeṣu caiva dṛṣṭeṣu yatpuṇyamabhijāyate
devadevo yatā sthāṇuḥ saromadhye vyavasthitaḥ / kimarthaṃ pāṃśunā śakrastīrthaṃ pūritavān punaḥ
sthāṇutīrthasya māhātmyaṃ cakratīrthasya yatphalam / sūryatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ somatīrthasya brūhi me
saṃkarasya ca kuhyāni viṣṇoḥ stānāni yāni ca / kathayasya mahābhāga sarasvatyāḥ savistaram
brūhi devādhidevasya māhātmyaṃ deva tattvataḥ / viriñjasya prasādena viditaṃ sarvameva ca
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca/ mārkaṇḍeyavacaḥ śrutvā brahmatmā sa mahāmuniḥ / atibhaktyā tu tīrthasya pravaṇīkṛtamānasaḥ
paryaṅkaṃ śithilīkṛtvā namaskṛtvā maheśvaram / kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ yacchrutaṃ brahmaṇaḥ purā
sanatkumāra uvāca namaskṛtya mahādevamīśānaṃ varadaṃ śivam / utpatti ca pravakṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ brahmabhāṣitām
pūrvamekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / bṛhadaṇḍamabhūdekaṃ prajānāṃ bījasaṃbhavam
tasminnaṇḍe sthito brahmā śayanāyopacakrame / sahasrayugaparyantaṃ suptvā sa pratyabudhyata
suptotthitastadā brahmā śūnyaṃ lokamapaśyata / sṛṣṭiṃ cintayatastasya rajasā mohitasya ca
rajaḥ sṛṣṭiguṇaṃ proktaṃ sattvaṃ sthitiguṇaṃ viduḥ / upasaṃhārakāle ca tamogumaḥ pravartate
guṇātītaḥ sa bhagavān vyāpakaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ / tenadaṃ sakalaṃ vyāptaṃ yatkiñciñjīvasaṃjñitam
sa brahma sa ca govinda īśvaraḥ sa sanātanaḥ / yastaṃ veda mahātmānaṃ sa sarvaṃ veda mokṣavit
kiṃ teṣāṃ sakalaistīrthairāśramairvā prayojanam / yeṣāmanantakaṃ cittamātmanyeva vyavasthitam
ātmā nadī saṃyamapuṇyatīrthā satyodakā śīlamādhiyuktā / tasyāṃ snātaḥ puṇyakarmā punāti na viriṇā suddhyati cāntarātmā
etatpradhānaṃ puruṣasya karma yadātmasaṃbodhasukhe praviṣṭam / jñeyaṃ tadeva pravadanti santastatprāpya dehī vijahāti kāmān
naitādṛsaṃ brāhmaṇasyāsti vittaṃ yathaikatā samatā satyatā ca / śīle sthitirdaṇḍavidhānavarjanamakrodhanaścoparamaḥ kriyābhyaḥ
etad brahma samāsena mayoktaṃ te dvijottama / yajjñātvā brahma paramaṃ prāpsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
idānīṃ śṛṇu cotpattiṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ / imaṃ codāharantyeva ślokaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati
āpo nārā vai tanava ityevaṃ nāma śuśrumaḥ / tāsu śete sa yasmācca tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
vibuddhaḥ salile tasmin vijñāyāntargataṃ jagat / aṇḍaṃ bibheda bhagavāṃstasmādomityajāyata
tato bhūrabhavat tasmād bhuva ityaparaḥ smṛtaḥ / svaḥ śabdaśca tṛtīyo 'bhad bhūrbhuvaḥ sveti saṃjñitaḥ
tasmāttejaḥ samabhavat tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ yat / udakaṃ śoṣayāmāsa yattejo 'ṇḍaviniḥsṛtam
tejasā śoṣitaṃ śeṣaṃ kalalatvamupāgatam / kalalād budbudaṃ jñeyaṃ tataḥ kāṭhinyatāṃ gatam
kāṭhinyād dharaṇī jñeya bhūtānāṃ dhāriṇī iha sā / yasmin stānesthitaṃ hyaṇḍaṃ tasmin saṃnihitaṃsaraḥ
yadādyaṃ niḥsṛtaṃ tejastasmādāditya ucyate / aṇḍamadhye samutpanno hrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
ulbaṃ tasyābhavanmerurjarāyuḥ parvatāḥ smṛtāḥ / garbhodakaṃ samudrāśca tathā nadyaḥ sahasraśaḥ
nābhisthāne yadudakaṃ brahmaṇo nirmalaṃ mahat / mahatsarastena pūrṇaṃ vimalena varāmbhasā
tasmin madhye sthāṇurūpī vṛṭavṛkṣo mahāmanaḥ / tasmād vinirgatā varṇā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ
śūdrāśca tasmādutpannāḥ śuśrūṣārthaṃ dvijanmanām / tataścintayataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ / manasā mānasā jātāḥ sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ
punaścintayatastasya prajākāmasya dhīmataḥ / utpannā ṛṣayaḥ sapta te prajāpatayo 'bhavan
punaścintayatastasya rajasā mohitasya ca / bālakhilyāḥ samutpannāstapaḥsvādhyāyatatparāḥ
te sadā snānaniratā devārcanaparāyaṇāḥ / upavāsairvrataistīvraiḥ śoṣayanti kalevaram
vānaprasthena vidhinā agnihotrasamanvitāḥ / tapasā parameṇeha śoṣayanti kalevaram
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ te kṛśā dhamanisaṃtatāḥ / ārādhayanti deveśaṃ na ca tuṣyati śaṅkaraḥ
tataḥ kālena mahatā umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ / ākāśamārgeṇa tadā dṛṣṭvā devī suduḥkhitāḥ
prasādya devadeveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ prāha suvratā / kliśyante te munigaṇā devadāruvanāśrayāḥ
teṣāṃ kleśakṣayaṃ deva vidhehi kuru me dayām / kiṃ vedadharmaniṣṭhanāmanantaṃ deva dṛṣkṛtam
nādyāpi yena śuddhyanti śuṣkasnāyvasthisoṣitāḥ / tacchrutvā vacanaṃ devyāḥ pinākī pātitāndhakaḥ / provāca prahasan mūrdhni cārucandrāṃśuśobhitaḥ
śrīmahādeva uvāca na vetsi devi tattvena dharmasya gahanā gatiḥ / naite dharmaṃ vijānanti na ca kāmavivarjitāḥ
na ca krodhena nirmuktāḥ kevalaṃ mūḍhabuddhayaḥ / etacchrutvābravīd devī mā maivaṃ śaṃsitavratān
deva pradarśayātmānaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me / sa ityukta uvācedaṃ devīṃ devaḥ smitānanāḥ
tiṣṭha tvamatra yāsyāmi yatraite munipuṅgavāḥ / sādhayanti tapo ghoraṃ darśayiṣyāmi ceṣṭitam
ityuktā tu tato devī śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā / gacchasvetyāha muditā bhartaraṃ bhuvaneśvaram
yatra te munayaḥ sarve kāṣṭhaleṣṭasamāḥ sthitāḥ / adhīyānā mahābhāgāḥ kṛtāgnisadanakriyāḥ
tān vilokya tato devo nagnaḥ sarvāṅgasundaraḥ / vanamālākṛtāpīḍo yuvā bhikṣākapālabhṛt
āśrame paryaṭan bhikṣāṃ munīnāṃ darśanaṃ prati / dehi bhikṣāṃ tataścoktvā hyāśramādāśramaṃ yayau
taṃ vilokyāśramagataṃ yoṣito brahmavādinām / sakautukasvabhāvena tasya rūpema mohitāḥ
procuḥ parasparaṃ nārya ehi paśyāma bhiśrukam / parasparamiti coktvā gṛhya mūlaphalaṃ bahu
gṛhāṇa bhikṣāmūcustāstaṃ devaṃ muniyoṣitaḥ / sa tu bhikṣākapālaṃ taṃ prasārya bahu sādaram
dehi dehi śivaṃ vo 'stu bhavatībhyastapovane / hasamānastu devosastatra devyā nirīkṣitaḥ / tasmai dattvaiva tāṃ bhikṣāṃ papracchustaṃ smarāturāḥ
nārya ūcuḥ ko 'sau nāma vratavidhistvayā tāpasa sevyate / yatra nagnena liṅgena vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ / bhavān vai tāpaso hṛdyo hṛdyāḥ smo yadi manyase
ityuktastāpasībhistu provāca hasitānanaḥ / idamīdṛg vrataṃ kiñcinna rahasyaṃ prakāśyate
śṛṇvanti bahavo yatra tatra vyākhyā na vidyate / asya vratasya subhagā iti matvā gamiṣyatha
evamuktāstadā tena tāḥ pratyūcustadā munim / rahasye hi gamiṣyāmo mune naḥ kaitukaṃ mahat
ityuktvā tāstadā taṃ vai jagṛhuḥ pāṇipallavaiḥ / kācit kaṇṭhe sakandarpā bāhubhyāmaparāstathā
jānubhyāmaparā nāryaḥ keśeṣu lalitāparāḥ / aparāstu kaṭīrandhre aparāḥ pādayorapi
kṣobhaṃ vilokya munaya āśrameṣu svayoṣitām / hanyatāmiti saṃbhāṣya kāṣṭhapāṣāṇapāṇayaḥ
pātayanti sma devasya liṅgamuddhṛtya bhīṣaṇam / pātite tu tato liṅge gato 'ntardhānamīśvaraḥ / 22.68 devyā sa bhagavān rudraḥ kailāsaṃ nagamāśritaḥ / patite devadevasya liṅge naṣṭe carācare
kṣobho babhūva sumahānṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām / evaṃ deve tadā tatra vartati vyākulīkṛte
uvācaiko munivarastatra buddhimatāṃ varaḥ / na vayaṃ vidmaḥ sadbhāvaṃ tāpasasya mahātmanaḥ
viriñciṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmaḥ sa hi jñāsyati ceṣṭitam / evamuktāḥ sarva eva ṛṣayo lañjitā bhṛśam
brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ jagmur devaiḥ saha niṣevitam / praṇipatyātha deveśaṃ lañjayādhomukhāḥ sthitāḥ
atha tān duḥkhitān dṛṣṭvā brahma vacanamabravīt / aho mugdhā yadā yūyaṃ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtāḥ
na dharmasya kriyā kācijjñāyate mūḍhabuddhayaḥ / śruyatāṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ tāpasāḥ krūraceṣṭitaḥ
viditvā yad budhaḥ kṣipraṃ dharmasya phalamāpnuyāt / yo 'sāvātmani dehe 'smin vibhurnityovyavasthitaḥ
so 'nādiḥ sa mahāsthāṇuḥ pṛthaktve parisūcitaḥ / maṇiryathopadhānena dhatte varṇojjvalo 'pi vai
tanmayo bhavate tadvadātmāpi manasā kṛtaḥ / manaso bhedamāśritya karmabhiścopacīyate
tataḥ karmavaśād bhuṅkte saṃbhogān svarganārakān / tanmanaḥ śodhayed dhīmān jñānayogādyupakramaiḥ
tasmin śuddhe hyantarātmā svayameva nirākulaḥ / na śarīrasya saṃkleśairapi nirdahanātmakaiḥ
śuddhimāpnoti puruṣaḥ saṃśuddhaṃ yasya no manaḥ / kriyā hi niyamārthāya pātakebhyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ
yasmādatyāvilaṃ dehaṃ na śīghraṃ śuddhyate kila / tena lokeṣu mārgo 'yaṃ satpathasya pravartitaḥ
varṇāśramavibhāgo 'yaṃ lokādhyakṣeṇa kenacit / nirmito mohamāhātmyaṃ cihnaṃ cottamabhāginām
bhavantaḥ krodhakāmābhyāmabhibhūtāśrame sthitāḥ / jñānināmāśramo veśma anāśramamayoginām
kva ca nyastasamastecchā kva ca nārīmayo bhramaḥ / kva krodhamīdṛśaṃ ghoraṃ yenātmānaṃ na jāyatha
yatkrodhano yajati yad dadāti yad vā tapastapatila yajjuhoti / na tasya prāpnoti phalaṃ hi loke moghaṃ phalaṃ tasya hi krodhanasya
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye dvāviśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanatkumāra uvāca / brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te / punareva ca papracchurjagataḥ śreyakāraṇam
brahmovāca/ gacchāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ trilocanam / prasādād devadevasya bhaviṣyatha yathā purā
ityuktā brahmaṇā sārddha kailāsaṃ girimuttamam / dadṛśuste samāsīnamumayā sahitaṃ haram
tataḥ stotuṃ samārabdho brahma lokapitāmahaḥ / devādhidevaṃ varadaṃ trailokyasya prabhuṃ śivam
brahmovāca/ anantāya namastubhyaṃ varadāya pinākine / mahādevāya devāya sthaṇave paramātmane
namo 'stu bhuvaneśāya tubhyaṃ tāraka sarvadā / jñānānaṃ dāyako devastvamekaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
namaste padmagarbhāya padmeśāya namo namaḥ / ghoraśāntisvarūpāya caṇḍakrodha namo 'stu te
namaste deva viśveśa namaste suranāyaka / śūlapāṇe namaste 'stu namaste viśvabhāvana
evaṃ stuto mahādevo brahmaṇā ṛṣibhistadā / uvāca mā bhairvrajata liṅgaṃ vo bhavitā punaḥ
kriyatāṃ madvayaḥ śīghraṃ yena me prītiruttamā / bhaviṣyati pratiṣṭhāyāṃ liṅgasyātra na saṃśayaḥ
ye liṅgaṃ pūjayiṣyanti māmakaṃ bhaktimāśritāḥ / na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kicid bhaviṣyati kadācana
sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ kṛtānāmapi jānatā / śuddhyate liṅgapūjāyāṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
yuṣmābhiḥ pātitaṃ liṅgaṃ sārayitvā mahātsaraḥ / sāṃnihatyaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ tasmiñśīghraṃ pratiṣṭhitam
yathābhilaṣitaṃ kāmaṃ tataḥ prapsyatha brāhmaṇāḥ / sthāṇurnāmnā hi lokeṣu pūjanīyo divaukasām
sthāṇvīsvare sthito yasmātstāṇvīśvarastataḥ smṛtaḥ / ye smaranti sadā sthāṇuṃ te muktāḥ sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
bhaviṣyanti śuddhadehā darśanānmokṣagāminaḥ / ityevamuktā devena ṛṣayo brahmaṇā saha
tasmād dāruvanālliṅgaṃ netuṃ samupacakramuḥ / na taṃ cālayituṃ śaktāste devā ṛṣibhiḥ saha
śrameṇa mahatā yuktā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ / teṣāṃ śramābhitaptānāmidaṃ brahmābravīd vacaḥ
kiṃ vā śrameṇa mahatā na yūyaṃ vahanakṣamāḥ / svecchayā pātitaṃ liṅgaṃ devadevena śūlinā
tasmāt tameva śaraṇaṃ yāsyāmaḥ sahitāḥ surāḥ / prasannaśca mahādevaḥ svayameva nayiṣyati
ityevamuktā ṛṣayo devāśca brahmaṇā saha / kailāsaṃ girimāsedū rudradarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
na ca paśyanti taṃ devaṃ tataścintāsamanvitāḥ / brahmāṇamūcurmunayaḥ kva sa devo maheśvaraḥ
tato brahma ciraṃ dhyātvā jñātvā devaṃ maheśvaram / hastirupeṇa tiṣṭhantaṃ munibhirmānasaiḥ stutam
atha te ṛṣayaḥ sarve devāśca brahmaṇā saha / gatā mahatsaraḥ puṇyaṃ yatra devaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ
na ca paśyanti taṃ devamanviṣyantastatastataḥ / tataścintānvitā devā brahmaṇā sahitā sthitāḥ
pasyanti devīṃ suprītāṃ kamaṇḍaluvibhūṣitām / prīyamāṇā tadā devī idaṃ vacanamabravīt
śrameṇa mahatā yuktā anviṣyanto maheśvaram / pīyatāmamṛtaṃ devāstato jñāsyatha śaṅkaram / etacchratvā tu vacanaṃ bhavānyā samudāhṛtam
sukhopaviṣṭāste devāḥ papustadamṛtaṃ śuci / anantaraṃ sukhāsīnāḥ papracchuḥ parameśvarīm
kva sa deva ihāyāto hastirūpadharaḥ sthitaḥ / darśitaśca tadā devyā saromadhye vyavasthitaḥ
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ harṣayuktāḥ sarve devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ / brahmaṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā idaṃ vacanamabruvan
tvayā tyaktaṃ mahādeva liṅgaṃ trailokyavanditam / tasya cānayane nānyaḥ samarthaḥ syānmaheśvara
ityevamukto bhagavān devo brahmādibhirharaḥ / jagāma ṛṣibhiḥ sārddha devadāruvanāśramam
tatra gatvā mahādevo hastirūpadharo haraḥ / kareṇa jagrāha tato līlayā parameśvaraḥ
tamādāya mahādevaḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ / niveśayāmāsa tadā saraḥpārśve tu paścime
tato devāḥ sarva eva ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ / ātmānaṃ saphalaṃ daṣṭvā stavaṃ cakrurmaheśvare
