iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanatkumāra uvāca athovāca mahādevo devān brahmapurogamān / ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva praityakṣaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam
etat sāṃnihitaṃ proktaṃ saraḥ puṇyatamaṃ mahat / mayopasevitaṃ yasmāt tasmānmuktipradāyakam
iha ye puruṣāḥ kecid brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ / liṅgasya darśanādeva paśyanti paramaṃ padam
ahanyahani tīrthāni āsamudrasarāṃsi ca / sthāṇutīrthaṃ sameṣyanti madhyaṃ prāpte divākare
stotreṇānena ca naro yo māṃ stoṣyati bhaktitaḥ / tasyāhaṃ sulabho nityaṃ bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
ityuktvā bhagavān rudro hyantardhānaṃ gataḥ prabhuḥ / devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sarve svāni sthānāni bhehire
tato nirantaraṃ svargaṃ mānuṣairmiśritaṃ kṛtam / sthāṇuliṅgasya māhātmya darśanātsvargamāpnuyāt
tato devāḥ sarva eva brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ / tānuvāca tadā brahmā kimarthamiha cāgatāḥ
tato devāḥ sarva eva idaṃ vacanamabruvan / mānuṣebhyo bhayaṃ tīvraṃ rakṣāsmākaṃ pitāmaha
tānuvāca tadā brahmā surāṃstridaśanāyakaḥ / pāṃśunā pūryatāṃ śīghraṃ saraḥ śakre hitaṃ kuru
tato vavarṣa bhagavān pāṃśunā pākaśāsanaḥ / saptāhaṃ pūrayāmāsa saro devaistadā vṛtaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṃśuvarṣaṃ ca devadevo maheśvaraḥ / kareṇa dhārayāmāsa liṅgaṃ tīrthavaṭaṃ tadā
tasmāt puṇyatamaṃ tīrthamādyaṃ yatrodakaṃ sthitam / tasmin snātaḥ sarvatīrthaiḥ snāto bhavati mānavaḥ
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ vaṭaliṅgasya cāntare / tasya prītāśca pitaro dāsyanti bhuvi durlabham
pūritaṃ ta caco dṛṣṭvā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te / pāṃśunā sarvagātrāṇi spṛśanti śraddhayā yutāḥ
te 'pi nirdhūtapāpāste pāṃśunā munayo gatāḥ / pūjyamānāḥ suragaṇaiḥ prayātā brahmaṇaḥ padam
ye tu siddhā mahātmānaste liṅgaṃ pūjayanti ca / vrajanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ punarāvṛttidurlabhām
evaṃ jñātvā tadā brahmā liṅgaṃ śailamayaṃ tadā / ādyaliṅgaṃ tadā sthāpya tasyopari dadhāra tat
tataḥ kālena mahatā tejasā tasya rañjitam / tasyāpi sparśanāt siddhaḥ paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt
tato devaiḥ punarbrahmā vijñapto dvijasattama / ete yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ liṅgasya darśanānnarāḥ
tacchrutvā bhagavān brahmā devānāṃ hitakāmyayā / uparyupari liṅgāni sapta tatra cakāra ha
tato ye miktikāmāśca siddhāḥ śamaparāyaṇāḥ / sevya pāṃśuṃ prayatnena prayātāḥ paramaṃ padam
pāṃśavo 'pi kurukṣetre vāyunā samudīritāḥ / mahāduṣkṛtakarmāṇaṃ prayānti paramaṃ padam
ajñānājjñānato vāpi striyo vā puruṣasya vā / naśyate duṣkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sthāṇutīrthaprabhāvataḥ
liṅgasya darśanānmuktiḥ sparśanācca vaṭasya ca / tatsaṃnidhau jale snātvā prāpnotyabhimataṃ phalam
pitṛṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ yastu jale tasmin kariṣyati / bindo bindau tu toyasya anantaphalabhāgbhavet
yastu kṛṣṇatilaiḥ sārddha liṅgasya paścime sthitaḥ / tarpayecchraddhayā yuktaḥ sa prīṇāti yugatrayam
yāvanmanvantaraṃ proktaṃ yāvalliṅgasya saṃsthitiḥ / tāpatprītāśca pitaraḥ pibanti jalamuttamam
kṛte yuge sānnihatyaṃ tretāyāṃ vāyusaṃjñitam / kalidvāparayormadhye kūpaṃ rudrahradaṃ smṛtam
caitrasya kṛṣṇapakṣe ca caturdaśyāṃ narottamaḥ / snātvā rudrahrade tīrthe paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt
yastu vaṭe sthito rātriṃ dhyāyate parameśvaram / sthāṇorvaṭaprasādena manasā cintitaṃ phalam
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanatkumāra uvāca sthāṇorvaṭasyottarataḥ sukratīrthaṃ prakīrtitam / sthāṇorvaṭasya pūrveṇa somatīrthaṃ dvijottama
sthāṇorvaṭaṃ dakṣiṇato dakṣatīrthamudāhṛtam / sthāṇorvaṭāt paścimataḥ skandatīrthaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
etāni puṇyatīrtāni madhye sthāṇuriti smṛtaḥ / tasya darśanamātreṇa prāpnoti paramaṃ padam
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ yastvetāni parikramet / pade pade yajñaphalaṃ sa prāpnoti na śaṃśayaḥ
etāni munibhiḥ sādhyairādityairvasubhistadā / marudbhirvahnibhiścaiva sevitāni prayatnataḥ
anye ye prāṇinaḥ kecit praviṣṭāḥ sthāṇumuttamam / sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim
asti tatsaṃnidhau liṅgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ / umā ca liṅgarūpeṇa harapārśvaṃ na muñcati
tasya darśanamātreṇa siddhiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ / vaṭasya uttare pārśve takṣakeṇa mahātmanā
pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam / vaṭasya pūrvadigbhāge viśvakarmakṛtaṃ mahat
liṅgaṃ pratyaṅmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā siddhimāpnoti mānavaḥ / tatraiva liṅgarūpeṇa sthitā devī sarasvatī
praṇamya tāṃ prayatnena buddhiṃ medhāṃ ca vindati / vaṭapārśve sthitaṃ liṅgaṃ brahmaṇā tat pratiṣṭhitam
dṛṣṭvā vaṭeśvaraṃ devaṃ prayāti paramaṃ padam / tataḥ sthāṇuvaṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam
pradikṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā / sthāṇoḥ paścimadigbāge nakulīśo gaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
tamabhyarcya prayatnena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge tīrthaṃ rudrakaraṃ smṛtam
tasmin snātaḥ sarvatīrthe snāto bhavati mānavaḥ / tasya cottaradigbhāge rāvaṇena mahātmanā
pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ gokarṇaṃ nāma nāmataḥ / āṣāḍhamāse yā kṛṣṇā bhaviṣyati caturdaśī / tasyāṃ yor'cati gokarṇaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
kāmato 'kāmato vāpi yat pāpaṃ tena saṃcitam / tasmād vimucyate pāpāt pūjayitvā haraṃ śuciḥ
kaumārabrahmacaryeṇa yatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ / tatpuṇyaṃ sakalaṃ tasya aṣṭamyāṃ yor'cayecchivam
yadīcchet paramaṃ rūpaṃ saubhāgyaṃ dhanasaṃpadaḥ / kumāreśvaramāhātmyāt siddhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / / 25.19 tasya cottaradigbāge liṅgaṃ pūjya vibhīṣaṇaḥ / ajaraścāmaraścaiva kalpayitvā babhūva ha
āṣāḍhasya tu māsasya śuklā yā cāṣṭamī bhavet / tasyāṃ pūjya sopavāso hyamṛtatvamavāpnuyāt
khareṇa pūjitaṃ liṅgaṃ tasmin sthāne dvijottama / taṃ pūjayitvā yatnena sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt
dūṣaṇastriśirāścaiva tatra pūjya maheśvaram / yathābhilaṣitān kāmānāpatustau mudānvitau
caitramāse site pakṣe yo narastatra pūjayet / tasya tau varadau devau prayacchete 'bhivāñchitam
sthāṇorvaṭasya pūrvoṇa hastipādeśvaraḥ śivaḥ / taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpairanyajanmani saṃbhavaiḥ
tasya dakṣiṇato liṅgaṃ hārītasya ṛṣeḥ sthitam / yat praṇaṇya prayatnena siddhiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu vāpītasya mahātmanaḥ / lihgaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam
kaṅgālarūpiṇā cāpi rudreṇa sumahātmanā / pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ sarvapāpapraṇaśanam
bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ proktaṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśanam / liṅgasya darśanāccaiva agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet
tasya paścimadigbhāge liṅgaṃ siddhapratiṣṭhitam / siddheśvaraṃ tu vikhyātaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam
tasya dakṣiṇadigbāge mṛkaṇḍena mahātmanā / tatra pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃ darśanāt siddhidāyakam
tasya pūrve ca digbhāge ādityena mahātmanā / pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgavaraṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśanam
citrāṅgadastu gandharvo rambhā cāpsarasāṃ varā / parasparaṃ sānurāgau sthāṇudarśanakāṅkṣiṇau
dṛṣṭvā sthāṇuṃ pūjayitvā sānurāgau parasparam / ārādhya varadaṃ devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram
citrāṅgadeśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā rambheśvaraṃ dvija / subhago darśanīyaśca kule janma samāpnuyāt
tasya dabhiṇato liṅgaṃ vajriṇā sthāpitaṃ purā / tasya prasādāt prāpnoti manasā cintitaṃ phalam
parāśareṇa muninā tataivārādhya śaṅkaram / prāptaṃ kavitvaṃ paramaṃ darśanācchaṅkarasya ca
vedavyāsena muninā ārādhya parameśvaram / sarvajñatvaṃ brahmajñānaṃ prāptaṃ devaprasādataḥ
sthāṇoḥ paścimadigbhāge vāyunā jagadāyunā / pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ darśanāt pāpanāśanam
tasyāpi dakṣiṇe bhāge liṅgaṃ himavateśvaram / pratiṣṭhitaṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ darśanāt siddhikārakam
tasyāpi paścime bhāge kārtavīryeṇa sthāpitam / liṅgaṃ pāpaharaṃ sadyo kārtanāt puṇyamāpnuyāt
tasyāpyuttaradigbhāgo supārśve sthāpitaṃ punaḥ / ārādhya hanumāṃścāpa siddhiṃ devaprasādataḥ
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā / ārādhya varadaṃ devaṃ cakraṃ labdhaṃ sudarśanam
tasyāpi pūrvādighbhāge mitreṇa varuṇena ca / pratiṣṭhitau liṅgavarau sarvakāmapradāyakau
etāni munibhiḥ sādhyairādityairvasubhistathā / sevitāni prayatnena sarvapāpaharāṇi vai
kharṇaliṅgasya paścāttu ṛṣibhistattvadarśibhiḥ / pratiṣṭhitāni liṅgāni yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate
tathā hyuttaratastasya yāvadoghavatī nadī / sahasramekaṃ liṅgānāṃ devapaścimataḥ sthitam
tasyāpi pūrvadigbhāge bālakhilyairmahātmabhiḥ / pratiṣṭhitā rudrakoṭiryāvatsaṃnihitaṃ saraḥ
dakṣiṇena tu devasya gandharvairyakṣakinnaraiḥ / pratiṣṭhitāni liṅgāni yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate
tisraḥ koṭyor'dhakoṭī ca liṅgānāṃ vāyurabravīt / asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi ye rudrāḥ sthāṇumāśritāḥ
etajjñātvā śraddadhānaḥ sthāṇuliṅgaṃ samāśrayet / yasya prasādāt prāpnoti manasā cintitaṃ phalam
akāmo vā sakāmo vā praviṣṭaḥ sthāṇumandiram / vimuktaḥ pātakairghoraiḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam
caitre māse trayodaśyāṃ divyanakṣatrayogataḥ / śukrārkacandrasaṃyoge dine puṇyatame śubhe
pratiṣṭhitaṃ sthāṇuliṅgaṃ brahmaṇā lokadhāriṇā / ṛṣibhirdevasaṃghaiśca pūjitaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
tasmin kāle nirāhārā mānavāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ / pūjayanti śivaṃ ye vai te yānti paramaṃ padam
tadārūḍhamidaṃ jñātvā ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇam / pradakṣiṇīkṛtā taistu saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye pañcaviśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca sthāṇutīrthaprabhāvaṃ tu śrotumicchāmyahaṃ mune / kena siddhiratha prāptā sarvapāpabhayāpahā
sanatkumāra uvāca/ śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣeṇa sthāṇumāhātmyamuttamam / yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mukto bhavati mānavaḥ
ekārṇave jagatyasmin naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / viṣṇornābhisamudbhūtaṃ padmamavyaktajanmanaḥ / tasmin brahma samudbhūtaṃ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ
tasmānmarīcirabhavanmarīceḥ kaśyapaḥ sutaḥ / kaśyapādabhavad bhāsvāṃstamānmanurajāyata
manostu kṣuvataḥ putra utpanno mukhasaṃbhavaḥ / pṛthivyāṃ caturantāyāṃ rājāsīd dharmarakṣitā
tasya patnī babhūvātha bhayā nāma bhayāvahā / mṛtyoḥ sakāśādutpannā kālasya duhitā tadā
tasyāṃ samabhavad veno durātmā vedanindakaḥ / sa dṛṣṭvā putravadanaṃ kruddho rājā vanaṃ yayau
tatra kṛtvā tapo ghoraṃ dharmeṇāvṛtya rodasī / prāptavān brahmasadanaṃ puranāvṛttidurvabham
veno rājā samabhavat samaste kṣitimaṇḍale / sa mātāmahadoṣeṇa tena kālātmajātmajaḥ
ghoṣayāmasa nagare durātmā vedanindakaḥ / na dātavyaṃ na yaṣṭavyaṃ na hotavyaṃ kadācana
ahameko 'tra vai vandyaḥ pūjyo 'haṃ bhavatāṃ sadā / mayā hi pālitā yūyaṃ nivasadhvaṃ yathāsukham
tanmatto 'nyo na devo 'sti yuṣmākaṃ yaḥ parāyaṇam / etacchratvā tu vacanamṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te
parasparaṃ samāgamya rājānaṃ vākyamabravan / śrutiḥ pramāṇaṃ dharmasya tato yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
yajñairvinā no prīyante devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ / aprītā na prayacchanti vṛṣṭiṃ sasyasya vṛddhaye
tasmād yajñaiśca devaiśca dhāryate sacarācaram / etacchrutvā krodhadṛṣṭirvenaḥ prāha punaḥ punaḥ
na yaṣṭavyaṃ na dātavyamityāha krodhamūrcchitaḥ / tataḥ krodhasamāviṣṭā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te
nijaghnurmantrapūtaiste kuśairvajrasamanvitaiḥ / tatastvarājake loke tamasā saṃvṛte tadā
dasyubhiḥ pīḍyamānāstān ṛṣīṃste śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ / tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve mamanthustasya vai karam
savyaṃ tasmāt samuttasthau puruṣo hrasvadarśanaḥ / tamūcurṛṣayaḥ sarve niṣīdatu bhavāniti
tasmānniṣādā utpannā venakalmaṣasaṃbhavāḥ / tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve manmathurdakṣiṇaṃ karam
mathyamāne kare tasmin utpannaḥ puruṣo 'paraḥ / bṛhatsālapratīkāśo divyalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ
dhanurbāṇāṅkitakaraścaścakradhvasamanvitaḥ / tamutpannaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ
abhyaṣiñcan pṛthivyāṃ taṃ rājānaṃ bhūmipālakam / tataḥ sa rañjayāmāsa dharmeṇa pṛthivīṃ tadā
pitrāḥ'parañjitā tasya tena sā paripālitā / tatra rājetiśabdo 'sya pṛthivyā rañjanādabhūt
sa rājyaṃ pāpya tebhyastu cintayāmāsa pārthivaḥ / pitā mama adharmiṣṭho yajñavyucchittikārakaḥ
kathaṃ tasya kriyā kāryā paralokasukhāvahā / ityevaṃ cintayānasya nārado 'bhyājagāma ha
tasmai sa cāsanaṃ dattvā praṇipatya ca pṛṣṭavān / bhagavan sarvalokasya jānāsi tvaṃ śubhāśubham
pitā mama durācāro devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ / svakarmarahito vipra paralokamavāptavān
tato 'bravīnnāradastaṃ jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā / mlecchamaghye samutpannaṃ kṣayakuṣṭhasamanvitam
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ / cintayāmāsa dukhārtaḥ kathaṃ kāryaṃ mayā bhavet
ityevaṃ cintayānasya matirjātā mahātmanaḥ / putraḥ sa kathyate loke yaḥ pitṝṃstrāyate bhayāt
evaṃ saṃcintya sa tadā nāradaṃ pṛṣṭavān munim / tāraṇaṃ matpitustasya mayā kāryaṃ kathaṃ mune
nārada uvāca gaccha tvaṃ tasya taṃ dehaṃ tīrtheṣu kuru nirmalam / yatra sthāṇormahattīrthaṃ saraḥ saṃnihitaṃ prati
etacchratvā tu vacanaṃ nāradasya mahātmanaḥ / sacive rājyamādhāya rājā sa tu jagāma ha
sa gatvā cottarāṃ bhūmiṃ mlecchamadhye dadarśa ha / kuṣṭharogeṇa mahātā kṣayeṇa ca samanvitam
tataḥ śokena mahatā saṃtapto vākyamabravīt / ha mlecchā naumi puruṣaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca nayāmyaham
tatrāhamenaṃ nirujaṃ kariṣye yadi manyatha / tatheti sarve te mlecchāḥ puruṣaṃ taṃ dayāparam
ūcuḥ praṇatasarvāṅgā yathā jānāsi tatkuru / tata ānīya puruṣān śivikāvāhanocitān
dattvā śulkaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ sukhena nayata dvijam / tataḥ śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya rājño dayāvataḥ / 26.39 gṛhītvā śivikāṃ kṣipraṃ kurukṣetreṇa yānti te / tatra nītvā sthāṇutīrthe avatārya ca te gatāḥ
tataḥ sa rājā madhyāhne taṃ snāpayati vai tadā / tato vāyurantarikṣe idaṃ vacanamabravīt
mā tāta sāhasaṃ kārṣistīrtha rakṣa prayatnataḥ / ayaṃ pāpena ghorema atīva pariveṣṭitaḥ
vedanindā mahatpāpaṃ yasyānto naiva labhyate / so 'yaṃ snānānmahattīrthaṃ nāśayiṣyati tatkṣaṇāt
etad voyarbacaḥ śrutvāduḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ / uvāca śokasaṃtaptastasya duḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ / eṣa ghoreṇa pāpena atīva pariveṣṭitaḥ
prāyaścittaṃ kariṣye 'haṃ yadvadiṣyanti devatāḥ / tatastā devatāḥ sarvā idaṃ vacanamabruvan
snātvā snātvā ca tīrtheṣu abhiṣiñcasva vāriṇā / ojasā culukaṃ yāvat pratikūle sarasvatīm
snātvā muktimavāpnoti puruṣaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ / eṣa svapoṣaṇaparo devadūṣaṇatatparaḥ
brāhmaṇaiśca parityakto naiṣa śuddhyati karhicit / tasmādenaṃ samuddiśya snātvā tīrtheṣu bhaktitaḥ
abhiṣiñcasva toyena tataḥ pūto bhaviṣyati / ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā kṛtvā tasyāśramaṃ tataḥ
tīrthayātrāṃ yayau rājā uddiśya janakaṃ svakam / sa teṣu plāvanaṃ kurvastīrtheṣu ca dine dine
abhyaṣiḍhcat svapitaraṃ tīrthatoyena nityaśaḥ / etasminneva kāle tu sārameyo jagāma ha
sthāṇormaṭhe kaulapatirdevadravyasya rakṣitā / parigrahasya dravyasya paripālayitā sadā
priyaśca sarvasokeṣu devakāryaparāyaṇaḥ / tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya dharmamārge sthitasya ca
kālena calitā buddhirdevadravyasya nāśene / tenādharmeṇa yuktasya paralokagatasya ca / / 26.54 dṛṣṭvā yamo 'bravīd vākyaṃ śvayoniṃ va3ja mā ciram / tadvākyānantaraṃ jātaḥ śva vai saugandhike vane
tataḥ kālena mahatā śvayūthaparivāritaḥ / paribhūtaḥ saramayā duḥkhena mahatā vṛtaḥ
tyaktvā dvaitavanaṃ puṇyaṃ sānnihatyaṃ yayau saraḥ / tasmin praviṣṭamātrastu sthāṇoreva prasādataḥ
atīva tṛṣayā yuktaḥ sarasvatyāṃ mamañja ha / tatra saṃplutadehastu vimuktaḥ sarvākilbiṣaiḥ
āhāralobhena tadā praviveśa kuṭīrakam / praviśantaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā śvānaṃ bhayasamanvitaḥ
sa taṃ pasparśa śanakaiḥ sthāṇutīrthe mamañja ha / patataḥ pūrvatīrtheṣu vipruṣaiḥ pariṣiñcataḥ
śuno 'sya gātrasaṃbhūtairabbindubhiḥ sa siñcitaḥ / viraktadṛṣṭiśca śunaḥ kṣepeṇa ca tataḥ param
sthāṇutīrthasya māhātmyāt sa putreṇa ca tāritaḥ / niyatastatkṣaṇāñjāto stutiṃ kartuṃ pracakrame
vena uvāca prapadye devamīśānaṃ tvāmajaṃ candrabhūṣaṇam / mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ viśvasya jagataḥ patim
namaste devadeveśa sarvaśatruniṣūdana / deveśa baliviṣṭambhadevadaityaiśca pūjita
virūpākṣa sahasrākṣa tryakṣa yakṣeśvarapriya / sarvataḥ pāṇipādānta sarvato 'kṣiśiromukha
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhasi / śaṅkukarṇa mahākarma kumbhakarṇārṇavālaya
gajendrakarṇa gokarṇa pāṇikarṇa namo 'stu te / śatajihva śatāvarta śatodara śatānana
gāyanti tvāṃ gāyatriṇo hyarcayantyarkkamarciṇaḥ / brahmāṇaṃ tvā śatakrato udvaṃśamiva menire
mūrtau hi te mahāmūrte samudrāmbudharāstathā / devatāḥ sarva evātra goṣṭhe gāva ivāsate
śarīre tava paśyāmi somamagniṃ jaleśvaram / nārāyaṇaṃ tathā sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatim
bhagavān kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ kriyākāraṇameva tat / prabhavaḥ pralayaścaiva sadasaccāpi daivatam
namo bhavāya śarvāya varadāyograrūpiṇe / andhakāsurahantre ca paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ
trijaṭāya triśīrṣāya triśulāsakkapāṇaye / tryambakāya trinetrāya tripuraghra namo 'stu te
namo muṇḍāya caṇḍāya aṇḍāyotpattihetave / ḍiṇḍimāsaktahastāya ḍiṇḍimuṇḍāya te namaḥ
namordhvakeśadaṃṣṭrāya śuṣkāya vikṛtāya ca / dhūmralohitakṛṣṇāya nīlagrīvāya te namaḥ
namo 'stvapratirūpāya virupāya śivāya ca / sūryamālāya sūryāya svarūpadhvajamāline
namo mānātimānāya namaḥ paṭutarāya te / namo gaṇendranāthāya vṛṣaskandhāya dhanvine
saṃkrandanāya caṇḍāya parṇadhārapuṭāya ca / namo hiraṇyavarṇāya namaḥ kanakavarcase
namaḥ stutāya stutyāya stutisthāya namo 'stu te / sarvāya sarvabhakṣāya sarvabhūtaśarīriṇe
namo hotre ca hantre ca sitodagrapatākine / namo namyāya namrāya namaḥ kaṭakaṭāya ca
namo 'stu kṛśanāśāya śayitāyotthitāya ca / sthitāya dhāvamānāya muṇḍāya kuṭilāya ca
namo nartanaśīlāya layavāditraśāline / nāṭyopahāralubdhāya mukhavāditraśāline
namo jyoṣṭhāya śreṣṭhāya balatibalaghātine / kālanāśāya kālāya saṃsārakṣayarūpiṇe
himavadduhituḥ kānta bhairavāya namo 'stu te / ugrāya ca namo nityaṃ namo 'stu daśabāhave
citibhasmapriyāyaiva kapālāsaktapāṇaye / vibhīṣaṇāya bhīṣmāya bhīmavratadharāya ca
namo vikṛtavaktrāya namaḥ pūtogradṛṣṭaye / pakvāmamāṃsalubdhāya tambivīṇāpriyāya ca
namo vṛṣāṅkavṛkṣāya govṛṣābhirute namaḥ / kaṭaṅkaṭāya bhīmāya namaḥ paraparāya ca
namaḥ sarvavariṣṭhāya varāya varadāyine / namo viraktaraktāya bhāvanāyākṣamāline
vibhedabhedabhinnāya chāyāyai tapanāya ca / aghoraghorarūpāya ghoraghoratarāya ca
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya namaḥ śāntatamāya ca / bahunetrakapālāya ekamūrte namo 'stu te
namaḥ kṣudrāya lubdhāya yajñabhāgapriyāya ca / pañcālāya sitāṅgāya namo yamaniyāmine
namaścitrorughaṇṭāya ghaṇṭāghaṇṭanighaṇṭine / sahasraśataghaṇṭāya ghaṇṭāmālavibhūṣiṇe
praṇasaṃghaṭṭagarvāya namaḥ kilikilipriye / huṃhuṅkārāya pārāya huṃhuṅkārapriyāya ca
namaḥ samasame nityaṃ gṛhavṛkṣaniketine / garbhamāṃsaśṛgālāya tārakāya tarāya ca
namo yajñāya yajine hutāya prahutāya ca / yajñavāhāya havyāya tapyāya tapanāya ca
namastu payase tubhyaṃ tuṇḍānāṃ pataye namaḥ / annadāyānnapataye namo nānānnabhojine
namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāya sahasracaraṇāya ca / sahasrodyataśūlāya sahasrābharaṇāya ca
bālanucaragoptre ca bālalīlāvilāsine / namo bālāya vṛddhāya kṣubdhāya kṣobhaṇāya ca
gaṅgālulitakeśāya muñjakeśāya vai namaḥ / namaḥ ṣaṭkarmatuṣṭāya trikarmaniratāya ca
nagnaprāṇāya caṇḍāya kṛśāya sphoṭanāya ca / dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ kathyāya kathanāya ca
sāṅkhyāya sāṅkhyamukhyāya sāṅkhyayogamukhāya ca / namo viratharathyāya catuṣpatharathāya ca
kuṣṇājinottarīyāya vyālayajñopavītine / vaktrasaṃdhānakeśāya harikeśa namo 'stu te / tryambikāmbikanāthāyavyaktavyaktāya vedhase
kāmakāmadakāmaghna tṛptātṛptavicāriṇe / namaḥ sarvada pāpaghna kalpasaṃkhyāvicāriṇe
mahāsattva mahābāho mahābala namo 'stu te / mahāmegha mahāprakhya mahākāla mahādhyute
meghāvarta yugāvarta candrārkapataye namaḥ / tvamannamannabhoktā ca pakvabhuk pāvanottama
jarāyujāṇḍajāścaiva svedajodbhidajāśca ye / tvameva devadeveśa bhūtagrāmaścaturvidhaḥ
sraṣṭā carācarasyāsya pātā hantā tathaiva ca / tvāmāhurbrahya vidvāṃso brahma brahmavidāṃ gatim
manasaḥ paramajyotistvaṃ vāyurjyotiṣāmapi / haṃhavṛkṣe madhukaramāhustvaṃ brahmavādinaḥ
yajurmayo ṛṅmayastvāmāhuḥ sāmamayastathā / paṭhyase stutibhirnityaṃ vedopaniṣadāṃ gaṇaiḥ
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā varṇāvarāśca ye / tvameva meghasaṃghāśca vidyuto 'sanigarjitam
saṃvatsarastvamṛtavo māso māsārdhameva ca / yugā nimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhāśca nakṣatrāṇi grahāḥ kalāḥ
vṛkṣāṇāṃ kakubho 'si tvaṃ girīṇāṃ himavān giriḥ / vyāghro mṛgāṇāṃ patatāṃ tārkṣyo 'nantaśca bhoginām
kṣirodo 'syudadhīnāṃ ca yantrāṇāṃ dhanureva ca / vajraṃ praharaṇānāṃ ca vratānāṃ satyameva ca
tvameva dveṣa icchā ca rāgo mohaḥ kṣamākṣame / vyavasāyo dhṛtirlobhaḥ kāmakrodhau jayājayau
tvaṃ śarī tvaṃ gadī cāpi khaṭvāṅgī ca śarāsanī / chettā mettā prahartāsi mantā netā sanātanaḥ
daśalakṣaṇasaṃyukto dharmor'thaḥ kāma eva ca / samudrāḥ sarito gaṅgā parvatāśca sarāṃsi ca
latāvallyastṛṇauṣadhyaḥ paśavo mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / dravyakarmaguṇārambhaḥ kālapuṣpaphalapradaḥ
ādiścantaśca vedānāṃ gāyatrī praṇavastathā / lohito harito nīlaḥ kuṣṇaḥ pītaḥ sitastathā
kadruśca kapilaścaiva kapoto mecakastathā / savarṇaścāpyavarṇāśca kartā hartā tvameva hi
tvamindraśca yamaścaiva varuṇo dhanado 'nilaḥ / upaplavaścitrabhānuḥ svarbhānureva ca
śikṣāhaitraṃ trisauparṇaṃ yajuṣāṃ śatarudriyam / pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam
tinduko girijo vṛkṣe mudgaṃ cākhilajīvanam / prāṇāḥ sattvaṃ rajaścaiva tamaśca pratipatpitiḥ
prāṇo 'pānaḥ masānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca / unmeṣaśca nimeṣaśca kṣutaṃ jṛmbhitameva ca
lohitāntargato dṛṣṭirmahāvaktro mahodaraḥ / śuciromā hariśmaśrurūrdhvakeśaścalācalaḥ
gītavāditranṛtyajño gītavāditrakapriyaḥ / matsyo jālo jalaukāśca kālaḥ kelikalā kaliḥ

saṃvartako 'ntakaścaiva saṃvartakabalāhakaḥ / ghaṇṭo ghaṇṭī māhaghaṇṭī cirī mālī ca mātaliḥ
brahmakālayamāgnīnāṃ daṇḍī muṇḍī trimuṇḍadhṛk / caturyugaścaturvedaścāturhetrapravartakaḥ
cāturāśramyanetā ca cāturvarṇyakarastathā / nityamakṣapriyo dhūrto gaṇādhyakṣo gaṇādhipaḥ

bhaganetrāṅkuśaścaṇḍaḥ pūṣṇo dantavināśanaḥ / svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭkāro namaskāro namo namaḥ
gūḍhavrato guhyatapāstārakāstārakāmayaḥ / dhātā vidhātā saṃdhātā pṛthivyā dharaṇo 'paraḥ
brahma tapaśca satyaṃ ca vratacarya mathārjavam / bhūtātmā bhūtakṛd bhūtirbhūtabhavyabhavodbhavaḥ
bhūrbhuvaḥ svarṛtaṃ caiva dhruvo dānto maheśvaraḥ / dīkṣito 'dīkṣitaḥ kānto durdānto dāntasaṃbhavaḥ
candrāvarto yugāvartaḥ saṃvartakapravartakaḥ / binduḥ kāmo hyaṇuḥ sthūlaḥ karṇikārasrajapriyaḥ

trailokyagoptā govindo gomārgo mārga eva ca / sthiraḥ śreṣṭhaśca sthāṇuśca vikrośaḥ krośa eva ca
durvāraṇo durviṣaho duḥsaho duratikramaḥ / durddharṣo duṣprakāśaśca durdurśo durjayo jayaḥ
śaśāṅkānalaśītoṣṇaḥ kṣuttṛṣṇā ca nirāmayaḥ / ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva vyādhihā vyādhināśanaḥ
samūhaśca samūhasya hantā devaḥ sanātanaḥ / śikhaṇḍī puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ puṇḍarīkavanālayaḥ

na brahmā na ca govindaḥ paurāṇā ṛṣayo na te / māhātmyaṃ vedituṃ śaktā yātātathyena śaṅkara
puṃsāṃ śatasahasrāṇi yatsamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati / mahatastamasaḥ pāre goptā mantā bhavān sadā
yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsāḥ sattvasthāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ / jyotiḥ paśyanti yuñjānāstasmai yogātmane namaḥ
yā mūrtayaśca sūkṣmāste na śakyā yā nidarśitum / tābhirmāṃ satataṃ rakṣa pitā putramivaurasam
rakṣa māṃ rakṣaṇīyo 'haṃ tavānagha namo 'stu te / bhaktānukampī bhagavān bhaktaścāhaṃ sadā tvayi
jaṭine daṇḍine nityaṃ lambodaraśārīriṇe / kamaṇḍaluniṣaṅgāya tasmai rudrātmane namaḥ
yasya keśeṣu jīmūtā nadyāḥ sarvāṅgasandhiṣu / kukṣau samudraścatvārastasmai toyātmane namaḥ
saṃbhakṣya sarvabhūtāni yugānte paryupasthite / yaḥ śete jalamadhyasthastaṃ prapadye 'mbuśāyinam
praviśya vadanaṃ rāhoryaḥ somaṃ pibate niśi / grasatyarkaṃ ca kharbhānū rakṣitastava tejasā
ye cātra patitā garbhā rudragandhasya rakṣeṇa / namaste 'stu khadhā khāhā prāpnuvanti tadadbhute
ye 'ṅguṣṭhamātrāḥ puruṣā dehasthāḥ sarvadehinām / rakṣantu te hi māṃ nityaṃ te māmāpyāyayantu vai
ye nadīṣu samudreṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca / vṛbhamūleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāragahaneṣu ca
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu catvareṣu sabhāsu ca / hastyaśvarathaśālāsu jīrṇodyānālayeṣu ca
ye ca pañcasu bhūteṣu diśāsu vidiśāsu ca / candrārkayormadhyāgatā ye ca candrārkaraśmiṣu
rasātalagatā ye ca ye ca tasmāt paraṃ gatāḥ / namastebhyo namastebhyo namastebhyaśca nityaśaḥ
yeṣāṃ na vidyate saṃkhyā pramāṇaṃ rūpameva ca / asaṃkhyeyagaṇā rudrā namastebhyo 'stu nityaśaḥ
prasīda mama bhadraṃ te tava bhāvagatasya ca / tvayi me hṛdayaṃ deva tvayi buddhirmatistvayi
stutvaivaṃ sa mahādevaṃ virarāma dvijottmaḥ
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe saromāhātmye ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanatkumāra uvacā / athainamabravīd devastrailokyādhipatirbhavaḥ / āśvāsanakaraṃ cāsya vākyavid vākyamuttamam
aho tuṣṭo 'smi te rājan stavenānena suvrata / bahunātra kimuktena matsamīpe vasiṣyasi
uṣitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ mama gātrodbhavaḥ punaḥ / asuro hyandhako nāma bhaviṣyasi surāntakṛt
hiraṇyākṣagṛhe janma prāpya vṛddhiṃ gamiṣyasi / pūrvādharmeṇa ghoreṇa vedanindākṛtena ca
sābhilāṣo jaganmāturbhaviṣyasi yadā tadā / dehaṃ śulena hatvāhaṃ pāvayiṣyāmi samārbudam
tatrāpyakalmaṣo bhūtvā stutvā māṃ bhaktitaḥ punaḥ / khyātogaṇādhipo bhūtvā nāmnā bhṛṅgiriṭiḥ smṛtaḥ
matsannidhāne sthitvā tvaṃ tataḥ siddhiṃ gamiṣyasi / venaproktaṃ stavamimaṃ kīrtayed yaḥ śṛṇoti ca
nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyāt kiñcid dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt / yathā sarveṣu deveṣu viśiṣṭo bhagavāñśivaḥ
tathā stavo variṣṭho 'yaṃ stavānāṃ venanirmitaḥ / yaśorājyasukhaiśvaryadhanamānāya kīrtitaḥ
śrotavyo bhaktimāsthāya vidyākāmaiśca yatnataḥ / vyādhito duḥkhito dīnaścaurarājabhayānvitaḥ
rājakāryavimukto vā mucyate mahato bhayāt / anenaiva tu dehena gaṇānāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ vrajet
tejasā yaśasā caiva yukto bhavati nirmalaḥ / na rākṣasāḥ piśācā vā na bhūtā na vināyakāḥ
vighnaṃ kuryurgṛhe tatra yatrāyaṃ paṭhyate stavaḥ / śruṇuyād yā stavaṃ nārī anujñāṃ prāpya bhartṛtaḥ
mātṛpakṣe pituḥ pakṣe pūjyā bhavati devavat / śruṇuyād yaḥ stavaṃ divyaṃ kīrtayed vā samāhitaḥ
tasya sarvāṇi kāryāṇa siddhiṃ gacchanti nityaśaḥ / manasā cintitaṃ yacca yacca vācānukīrtitam
sarvaṃ saṃpadyate tasya stavanasyānukīrtanāt / manasā karmaṇā vācā kṛtameno vinaśyati / varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yattvayā manasepsitam
vena uvāca asya liṅgasya māhātmyāt tathā liṅgasya darśanāt / mukto 'haṃ pātakaiḥ sarvaistava darśanataḥ kila
yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama / devasvabhakṣaṇāñjātaṃ śvayonau tava sevakam
etasyāpi prasādaṃ tvaṃ kartumarhasi śaṅkara / etasyāpi bhayānmadhye saraso 'haṃ nimañjitaḥ
devairnivāritaḥ pūrvaṃ tīrthe 'smin snānakāraṇāt / ayaṃ kṛtopakāraśca etadarthe vṛṇomyaham
tasyaitad vacanaṃ śrutvā tuṣṭaḥ provāca śaṅkaraḥ / eṣo 'pi pāpinirmukto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
prasādānme mahābāho śivalokaṃ gamiṣyati / tathā stavamimaṃ śrutvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
kurukṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ saraso 'sya mahīpate / mama liṅgasya cotpattiṃ śrutvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate
sanatkumāra uvāca ityevamuktvā bhagavān sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ / paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
sa ca śvā tatkṣaṇādeva smṛtvā janma purātanam / divyamūrtidharo bhūtvā taṃ rājānamupasthitaḥ
kṛtvā snānaṃ tato vainyaḥ pitṛdarśanalālasaḥ / sthāṇatīrthe kuṭīṃ śūnyāṃ dṛṣṭvā śokasamanvitaḥ
dṛṣṭvā veno 'bravīd vākyaṃ harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ / satputreṇa tvayā vatsa trāto 'haṃ narakārmavāt
tvayābhiṣiñcito nityaṃ tīrthasthapuline sthitaḥ / asya sādhoḥ prasādena sthāṇordevasya darśanāt
muktāpāpaśca svarlokaṃ yāsye yatra śivaḥ sthitaḥ / ityevamuktvā rājānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram
sthāṇutīrthe yayau siddhiṃ tena putreṇa tāritaḥ / sa ca śvā paramāṃ siddhiṃ sthāṇutīrthaprabhāvataḥ
vimuktaḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvairjagāma bhavamandiram / rājā pitṛṛṇairmuktaḥ paripālya vasundharām
putrānutpādya dharmeṇa kṛtvā yajñaṃ nirargalam / dattvākāmāṃścaviprebhyo bhuktvā bhogān pṛthagvidhān
suhṛdo 'tha ṛṇairmuktvā kāmaiḥ saṃtarpya ca striyaḥ / abhiṣicya sutaṃ rājye kurukṣetraṃ yayau nṛpaḥ
tatra taptvā tapo ghoraṃ pūjayitvā ca śaṅkaram / ātmecchayā tanuṃ tyaktvā prayātaḥ paramaṃ padam
etatprabhāvaṃ tīrthasya sthāṇoryaḥ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ / sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prayāti paramāṃ gatim
